reviewsWithKeywords.text: Simply Beautiful, clean, warm, super clear water, lots of water activities like jet skies, sunset boat tours, relaxing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soars
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Less commercial and busy than palm beach. Less water sport. Amazing sand and turquoise water. A few bars around. Lots of shelter under hot things. Have to pay for sun bed though. Beautiful beach really.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed near Eagle beach and loved visiting every afternoon. We never had a problem getting a palapa (opposite Aruba breeze condos). The beach is stunning, perfect white sand and turquoise sea. It was never very busy, always relaxing and beautiful. There's a park with play equipment for kids near the road. Very safe and enjoyable. Glad we stayed here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is made up of crushed shells, so it is not hot like Florida beaches.   The beach was never very busy and we never had trouble securing a free cabana within walking distance to Coco Loco, our favorite bar.  Not a lot of sea creatures, but did see a cushioned sea star on the first day.  We ended every single night on this beach to enjoy the gorgeous sunsets.  Ten out of ten.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean, white, sandy (shell) beaches. Go sit on the sand during sunrise & sunset. Water is always clear & warm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favorite Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love Eagle Beach. Beautiful sand and water. Not too crowded and noisy. Plenty of options for dining both fast food and high end.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a beautiful beach! The water is so clear and perfect for the warm days in Aruba. You may be able to see white angel fish while swimming and some other sea life. There are plenty chairs to sit from. Drinks from the bar are also delicious!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Turquoise water and white sandy beach. Not crowded and nice to relax. There are many restaurants around and shopping establishments

reviewsWithKeywords.title: worth the trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach that we visited , the water is ideal ans the sand is super smooth . I like this beach more than all the others.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Visiting a Postcard
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful, picturesque Caribbean beach. The sand is white and soft. The wind is at your back when facing the water. The water is turquoise, into a deep blue not so far out. It does get deeper here more quickly than at Palm Beach. It is also much quieter, although there is still an abundance of restaurants, many palapas and jet ski rentals. The sun is much stronger than you expect. We stayed at Oceana Resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a great beach, although quite busy. Perfect for a morning walk or to watch the sunset. There's also a bike lane nearby so you can bike too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle beach is awesome!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is amazing with lots of activities and dining options to choose from. The beach is clean and water very clear. Lots of trees in certain sections for shade and it does have some pavilions. One of the best beaches in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You have to visit to believe it. The sand just massages your feet and the water is so clear and blue it is amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach is a must!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So many words to describe but boils down to one!  Amazing, quiet, beautiful sunsets, great food, relaxing, all adults, wonderful staff!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: jet skis, Big Mable ride, sun sun sun , and beautiful blue water. I loved the relaxing atmosphere. Wear plenty of sunscreen and buy a floatie.  No life guards , however the water was calm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world!  Eagle Beach, Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is located in the “low rise” district of Aruba.  Less hotels & concentration of people.  Great for any ages for relaxing and taking in scenery.  Many turtle nests roped off (stay away & do not disturb).  The official divi tree is at the west top of beach near the Amsterdam resort.  Numerous parking spots both in lots & on the road.  Since all the beaches are public, recommend getting to the beach early for a great spot or a Palapa.  Take your snorkeling gear to explore some of the small reefs and all the underwater creatures that eagle beach has to offer. Don’t forget your sunblock & Enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in the world.                  Here for 2 weeks and will visit it every other day. Lots to do with jet ski, parasailing. Clear clean water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely, quiet, and expansive...Eagle beach is just what the doctor ordered if you need some quiet time to recharge in the sunshine!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach! Stayed across the street amazing sunsets every night ! Beach was clean and not crowded!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Calm and beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful, powdery white sand, and crystal clear waters. Our favorite beach, by far. Took the local buses there. It was calm and uncrowded. Just be aware, renting chairs and umbrellas very expensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Flawless Beaches by Darren Chaker
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not far from the Ritz Carlton in Aruba, is Eagle Beach. The water is clear, pristine, and cannot imagine a more beautiful place to spend the place in complete solitude. Wish everyone here a good 2022, Darren Chaker

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mother Daughter Trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was paradise- one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen!  Gorgeous!! We took a cruise and we went where they the cruise ship recommended and where not impressed- got a taxi and asked him to take us to another beach and he took us here!!! Wow!!!  The 1st beach had a large sand dune you had to get over before getting to the water but this beach was perfect!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just beautiful, the water , the weather and all! I could stay there forever. Looking out of my hotel window evey morning  was breath taking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 2 Stays
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I came in October and participated in the Halloween party. My husband and I had a good time so when I returned in April with my mother and sister, I figured we would return. My experience and impression was the same both times: -beautiful property -most of the staff is friendly - clean and spacious rooms- the service at Uncle Tony’s was horrible both times for each meal. You can wait an eternity to be seated or even addressed. Food is great though! Katie is attentive. - no casino within hotel (closed both times but no one advised us at check-in) it’s not a huge deal to me, but should be communicated - Double Down Restaurant is great (thank you to young man Jean and to Adonaida - they are impeccable and attentive). Meals are huge and delicious! - short walk to Eagle beach (need additional staff to help distribute beach chairs to guests, great that chairs and palapas included for hotel guests)If the service was improved at Uncle Tony’s, they would easily earn a 5.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PARADISE BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most famous beaches in the Caribbean and apparently rated one of the best in the world. Approximately 15 minute taxi journey from the Aruba cruise dock port. Absolute tropical paradise. A must see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I walk it every day - love the fact that all the beaches are public. This is a beautiful, sandy beach, and perfect for watching sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunscreen required, public beach, stay to the left of the water sports when looking at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in the area but you have to be to the left of the water sports if you are looking at the beach. Aruba can be rocky in certain areas. Also be mindful if you like to sit on the beach the sand is so fine it blows it around and you get sand stings. Beautiful sunset and Mamas food truck is there. Catch it during lunch time Waterproof phone case is a must.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: white sands
reviewsWithKeywords.text: probably the only actual white sand beach ive ever been on.  divi tree and blowholes were cool.  area kept spotless clean as well

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful, clean and the staff is very friendly. But if you want a good spot, make sure you go early to grab one - 5:30AM and remember there is a time limit on how long your things can be left unattended. This is so that people don't take advantage of saving their spot when others could have used it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever had the pleasure to visit.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches are beautiful in Aruba, the people make the island what it is. A friendly, happy vacation spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is beautiful, water stunning! Someone should replace, repair palapa roofs!!!  Our beach attendant was amazing. Made sure we had chairs daily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing odor
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have come here several times over 16 years, such a beautiful beach, however this time the sewer smell was just awful. We asked about it and the general idea is that the waste treatment plant us too small for all of the added hotels and businesses. I heard it suggested that one solution could be to dome over the plant to capture the methane and use it for fuel. Please fix thus or the resorts will be in  big trouble.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for swimming or snorkeling with family and friends.  Take an umbrella and chairs with lots of sunscreen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It has a very clean beach and water is crystal clear.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most gorgeous clear aqua colored water you will ever see.  Beaches are clean, plenty of lounge chairs, the palapas are well maintained along with beach staff who bring you chairs and are extremely friendly.  All the water sports you can think of there is offered.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach in the world. Not too busy, crystal waters and sugar sand beach. This is the only place for us now and in the future. Can't say any more!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: unpleasant day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: have to take taxi from cruise ship.  no signs stating you have to - or where to rent chairs and umbrella - with limited supply.  where we were was mostly beach, 1 bar/restaurant. bathroom.  otherwise had to cross street - few bocks to shopping center.  waves were very high this day - never seen this inn aruba and had unpleasant experience in water.  tourists kept coming throughout the day looking for chairs and umbrellas and were unhappy - no place for them.i will continue to stick to palm beach.  wish there were more day pass opportunities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet, white sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach, great palapa huts, not too busy at all. You can do water sports here away from the crowds. The water is clean and waves are low. Definitely a must do to spend a quiet beach day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paridise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach ever! Great water sand the weather is always great, not crowded very relaxing.  It’s my happy place. The fish and the pelicans put on a great show. The sunset is amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but rough for little ones
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is absolutely gorgeous, however it was a little rough for our daughter. We heard it was family friendly because it was less crowded then palm beach. It is good for kids 5+ unless you want to be attached nonstop to your little one. We ended up doing baby beach numerous times and had the most amazing time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean Beach at its best 😎
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No wonder Eagle Beach is rated regularly one of the most beautiful beaches in the world - it lives up to it! Pure white sand stretching for it seems miles, clear warm water in shades of blue an turquoise, more seagulls than people and funny pelicans that plunge into the sea for fish that you can see without having to snorkle.It's perfect for bathing - shallow at waters edge without rocks or corals, then soon deep enough for swimming with a li little surf. Every now and then you'll find rentals for sunbeds and umbrellas - not cheap. But if you have your own equipment - there's room enough.Hardly restaurants or bars, bring drinks and enjoy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Swim with the fishes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Another wonderful  beach!  We arrived later than we wanted, but still found an umbrella. They are first come, first serve and you can rent lounge chairs. Only complaint - These were not the most comfortable. Walk up bar, walk up water sports, restroom across the street in the hotel pool area. GREAT coconut shrimp served beachside. The water was so clear here you could see the schools of fish swimming at your feet. We were here 20 years ago for our honeymoon and it is still just as pretty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, soft sand paradise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A short taxi ride from the cruise terminal. this is a delightful little spot. The beach has a very soft, fine clean sand with no shells or rocks to worry about. It's an easy walk into the ocean with no steep drop off. Lounger chairs and umbrellas are available for rent. A great spot to plop down and chill. There is also a beach bar nearby with food and drinks available for purchase.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A must visit beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Eagle Beach since our resort did not have much of a beach area. We were so happy with the decision! The sand is powder soft and the water is absolutely gorgeous. It was calm and shallow for while from the shore. We rented chairs and an umbrella from one of the local stands for $40. Worth noting that this is a public beach so there are no restrooms, but we were able to use the one across the street at a hotel. Highly recommend visiting during your stay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The sand is white and the sea is transparent and calm.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a beautiful beach where some resorts are located. After the waterfront area, there are some lakes that are areas of environmental preservation. There are some unfinished buildings that have probably suffered the economic impact of the pandemic. The resorts maintain beach huts for their guests and bar services, but like all beaches in Aruba, there is no entry fee. The sand is white and the sea is transparent and calm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love! Great for beach not the best snorkeling.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach. As beautiful as can be. Not much to see when snorkeling but a great relaxing beach day. Restaurant and bar close by and some available shade.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aruba was great - Will go back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, clean and beautiful. Ocean a little cold for January 2022. Spent 10 days. It was a little expensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous Day at the Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had 4-5 hours to spend in Aruba on our cruise stop. We chose Eagle Beach. What a fabulous spot!  Long, white sand beaches with beautiful water.  Nearby restaurants a d shopping make it a great place to spend the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach on Aruba and the best beach I’ve ever been to! Not too crowded, mix of tourists and locals, sand that resembles powder, and crystal clear water. I love this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The place to go for sunsets
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this beach is the best place to go to watch a sunset. spectacular doe snot even describe the sun.  plenty of beach. of d and drink is right there. go hang out for the day and enjoy the warm beach and beautiful scenery

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Easy Beach for Cruisers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived in Aruba on a Carnival Cruise ship.  My daughter and I decided to go solo and find our own excursion.  Right outside of the cruise terminal is a taxi service.  For $5 one way an open air taxi will transport you to Eagle Beach.  They return every hour for the return trip.  I think it was about a 10-15 minute ride. They drop you right off at the beach.  It is beautiful!  The day we were there it was not crowded at all.  There is a rental place for umbrellas($25), lounges($10), and rafts($5). The staff places the umbrella where you want to sit.  They even returned to see if we wanted it moved back.  There were no vendors trying to sell, pictures, massages, braids, etc.  The beach had a food truck selling tacos and other snacks.  It was a low-key and peaceful experience. Restrooms were available nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach to Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is accessible to many resorts and hotels, near and far. It is such a beautiful beach. The water is clean, clear, blue and inviting. The sand is soft and warm. The workers, whether at the bar/restaurant or on the jet scooter or just cleaning the beach , were all very friendly. Even the creepy crawly inhabitants (lizards) appears to be friendly creatures.  The funniest thing. All in all I had many wonderful experiences at the Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach I’ve ever been to
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arguably the best beach I have ever been to in my life!  The sand is silky and not hot to the feet, and the water is a perfect temperature.  Loved Loved Loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great chillin' beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach to just chill - not super-packed and close to food & beverages. jet-skis and all the 'ocean toys' if you're so inclined. And if you need to stretch your legs, there's enough room to take nice long walks along the shoreline.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had an amazing week at Eagle Beach!  The sand is super soft, the beach is wide and the water is perfect!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the finest in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've been to most of the Caribbean islands in search of the best beaches the region has to offer, and Eagle Beach is right up there in the Top 10. Wide, uncrowded even during the Christmas season, and covered in fine white sand and lapped gently by turquoise waters, we can't wait to return and experience it again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our Favorite Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand is perfect water is clear and warm and so nice. Love how easy it is to get an umbrella too. Spend a day or a week like we did!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything you wish for, white sandy beach, very  clean, nice calm water and beautiful sunset. Because it’s huge there’s always a nice quiet place to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and full of life!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is about 2 miles long with access to chairs and cabanas. The water is gorgeous and draws you in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best vacation destination!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach by far… i visited..Clear blue water, calm and perfect temperature🙏The home of high rise building, lots of great restaurants, bars, shoppings, water sports and nice , happy people and perfect to unwind from busy life!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love eagle beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is huge which is a major plus! We were able to get a palapa (straw umbrella) on the beach every day we needed one. We were at the tropicana and la cabana and those 2 hotels share an area of the beach. BUT people go to the beach AT SUNRISE to reserve a palapa. A member from our group went down every morning at like 7am to grab one. Hotel staff are there to assign you one and bring your chairs over. If you leave a bag or towel marking your territory you have it basically all day. If you don't plan to be there all day though give it away because lots of people end up without one. The beach starts to clear out around 4 so when we went to the beach later on certain days we still got a palapa. They clean the beach every night (at least in our hotels area) so it's always great. There are snack and drink huts along the beach and places to book excursion and parasail etc. This beach was also our favorite to play in the waves. The waves can be HUGE but it depends on the wind, other times it was relativity calm. There were people of all ages, baby to adult. We spent a lot of time here. I will say, on our first day we wandered around looking for a palapa ourselves and people told us to go talk to a staff member in order to get one. Plus, the chairs are all locked up to prevent random people from taking the chairs... if you aren't staying at a hotel on eagle beach you will have to rent chairs and an umbrella (not palapa). This is a plus to staying ON eagle beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 2021 Aruba Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, clear and warm water! Having a beach bar is a big plus. Staff is there to setup chairs for you and find an shady area for you. Rental umbrellas are also available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This might be the nicest beach I've ever been to. Definitely the nicest swimming beach on the island--way better than Palm Beach, and much less crowded. Sand is soft, surf is nice, views are beautiful, lots of space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean beach with beautiful sand and lots of people. It can be windy here so the waves may be large at times. It can be difficult to find shade but all in all I think I prefer this beach over the others.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches I have ever been, you can see turtles there, white send, and crystal clear water. Big recommendation

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want quiet, peaceful, and yet close to many great eating establishments and grocery shopping. Perfect water with gentle waves breaking right at the shoreline. Like having a perfect clear wave pool to stand and chat with friends . I think everyone on this island are nice enough to rival Ireland, and that is saying a lot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dec2021 Travels to Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An amazing place to relax and enjoy your time here. The beach is white white sand and the water is blue blue blue. Very Nice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was less crowded than palm beach but the water was more choppy so if you like waves this place is for you. I enjoyed the  beach experience. Tip: Go on a day when there are no cruises. We went on a Saturday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and well-maintained resort!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Highly recommended!! Fantastic amenities! very helpful and happy staff! Stayed in the ocean front unit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach and we spent few hours swimming and lot of beach activities as well. Nice and clean water and you have jetski and few activities. There is crowded area and there is not so crowded area. You can spend time in relaxed way compared to Palm beach where there are lot of people in beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach  in the heart of the low rise area White sand that doesn’t burn your feet just the right temperature turquoise water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a taxi to eagle beach after a recommendation. Picturesque. Beautiful sand and water. We enjoyed spending some time here and wish it had been longer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was amazing and wish we would have went sooner than our last day.  Free hits and ten dollars a chair.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: EAGLE BEACH, A BEACH LOVER'S PARADISE!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White powdery sand.  Wide, wide, beach.  Crystal clear blue water.  Sandy bottom, no rocks.  Swimmable.   Very few people.    NO beach vendors.  Paradise found!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in Aruba! We stay at LaCabana right across a two lane street, easy to get to, very short walk. White sand and gorgeous water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun spot with gorgeous views
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Simply beautiful! Great spot to sun and swim while taking in some truly breathtaking views. There is lots to do here from laying on the beach to parasailing, boat rides and more. Prices are tight and guides are experienced.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s good to have choices
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s beautiful and calming you can jet ski or any other water sports or just relax under your polopa and enjoy all the good food and drink

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a water, what a sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Terrific beach. Sand is awesome. There aren't many people so you can have a beach for yourself. Water is perfect - clean and warm. In the evenings you can see hatching turtles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Every Day Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful!  Step away from the hotels right on the water and park closer to the jet ski rentals.  There are plenty of places to set your chair, blanket, and cooler.  I love the warm water, hues of blue, and breezes.  In the afternoon, like 1pm or so, the jet ski rentals can get a little busy- but they run farther out.  Just enjoy the waves! The sand is soft and there are very few shells.  I tried snorkeling, but no dice!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach across from our quarters (MVC-Eagle) is a great place to chill out and swim. Crystal clear water and great views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love it here this is my third time. The attendants are nice and there is cold water. Most of all the water is inviting and the snorkeling is good

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To die for
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is #2 but honestly should be #1. The beach is beautiful and the sunsets are to die for… stop by Passions on the Beach.. especially for sunset dinner.. (make reservations) just do it..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My personal favorite beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Soft white sand with crystal clear water and well maintained. This isn't a shelly or rocky beach which makes it easy to walk around barefoot. Tends to be less crowded than Palm Beach but not as many restaurants nearby. There are some beach bars you can pop into for a quick bite/drink.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful pool
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this huge swimming pool!  Light waves, sometimes heavy breeze but always beautiful crystal clear blue water that can get pretty deep the father out you go. Not a great place to snorkel. I suggest bringing chairs and food/water.  There are a couple of brown pelicans that like to scare the crap out of you by diving for fish while your back is turned.  There is a jet ski rental there. Very clean beach too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I LOVED Eagle beach. There were plenty of palapas, the beach was well maintained and there were waves, but not anything rough. The only drawbacks were that there were not many food options and if you want a chair and you don't bring one, you'll have to rent one ($10US)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My favorite beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was my all time favorite in Aruba for so many reasons - not crowded -  water was clear and calm -  no rocks in the sand -  trees for shade or you can rent an umbrella and chairs- restaurant on site - bathrooms and rinse off station - also small playground by parking lot -  so many fishes in the water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach ! soft white sand, warm clear water. This is a must visit area of Aruba. We will be back in the future.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: go for a walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked up and down the beach and some spots are better than others, but all in all its beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is my favorite beach in Aruba. It's so clean and clear. The sand is always white. My favorite part is that I always feel like it has the right temperature it was very refreshing. It's beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice long beach, fine sand, nice food options nearby
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easy to spend a day on the beaches here and dip in and out of the sea. Wide and long beach, with loungers etc depending which hotel youre staying in. We bought our own deckchairs on arrival and used them where we went.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and serene!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear water and white sandy beach. Though I have seen and experienced such beaches before, Eagle beach has more to offer than others - the water adventures, the no-vendors on beach rule, the availability of restaurants within walking distance,  facilities for the beach such as sunbeds etc, and the friendly locals make Eagle beach exceptional.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven’s Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is Heaven’s Beach. We stayed away from the main tourist area, and had the beach pretty much to ourselves. The sand was soft like clouds, the water inviting like an Angel’s song, and the water calm. There was nothing like watching and swimming as the sun sets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We are staying nearby, and the beach is absolutely beautiful. The sand is perfect, the waves are mellow, the water is a good temperature. There are some negatives, however. In some areas, there is an extremely powerful sewage stench that literally made me gag. This is not what you want to smell at the beach, particularly because it very likely means that there is drainage nearby and thus in the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Convenient beach for a cruise day in port
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were here for a day on the Celebrity Summit, and we took a taxi to Eagle Beach. We rented beach chairs under an umbrella for $10/person, and we really enjoyed the beach. There were quite a few people on the beach and in the water, but the sand was powdery soft and the beach is LONG. It’s a great place to take a long walk in the sand. The water was warm and calm on the day we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and less croqded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was bit more aggressive than Baby and Palm beach but we really liked the non-touristy aspect of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My fav beach in Aruba! Loved every moment!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We picked this beach 3 times during our stay (our hotel was 10 minutes drive from Eagle) because The Bar (next to Linda playa hotel) had happy hours between 12-7pm :D :D :D so guess what, we had a pretty happy time. For 8 or 9 dollars you got 2 pretty good coctails :) the beach is calmer than fe durf beach or next to the lighthouse north. You can see beautiful sunset in front of you, the sun goes down the the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: its everything that you would expect from paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Exactly what you think.  Gorgeous soft sandy white beaches, amazing crystal turquois water and a fantastic constant light trade winds breeze.  Doesn't get much better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Calm Clear Beach. The best beach on the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach.  We lived in Ocenaia Condos so we walked to the Eagle Beach every day.  We always could find a free palapa!  The beach is taken care of every day we saw maintanance people come and clean the debris near the road.   The beach itself is very calm, very spacious and water is an amazing turquoise color!   We also saw rainbow over horizon twice.  You can not go wrong by choosing to be here especially with young kids!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A little bit of heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful, the water was wonderful but the sunset was simply amazing. Walking along the beach at sunset was breathtaking and amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sandy beach. Great views not crowded at all. I get bored at the beach, but no fault of the site. It WAS beautiful though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach on Aruba.  Pure white sand and a wide beach to relax on.  Long Beach is ideal for taking long walks. Chairs and umbrellas available for renting during the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sun Sand and Fun
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent four hours.. we ate good, had good drinks got on jet skis .. had a awesome time make sure to eat at Blue Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved Eagle beach for the beauty,  quiet and serenity.  It was not as crowded as Palm beach.  Easy access to restaurants and shopping.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved this beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited several beaches and this by far was the best one because you don't need water shoes to enjoy it!  It does not have too many rocks on the bottom to hurt your feet and the cabanas are nice too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most Amazing Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most amazing beach on earth. Never seems overly crowded and not to wavy. Crystal clear water and it’s shallow enough to walk out a pretty good ways. My 6 year old daughter and I played in the water for hours and hours. Plenty of palapas to shade from the sun as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach, quiet. The only issues I had was there wasn’t anyone to assist with renting a chair. It was also very hard to get a taxi back to resort.  Other than that beautiful,quite beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Experiencing Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beautiful and pristine white sand beach offers a relaxing atmosphere for soaking up the sun, swimming in the ocean, great photo opportunities, and water sports.  If you want to stick your toes in the sand, lay back,  and let your stress drift away then Eagle Beach is for you!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: eagle beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: jet ski , swimming , walking beach ,eating at  restaurants ,site seeing ,,talking to other guess.ooooo ooo  ooooo oooo ooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White Sand and Blue Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a terrific beach for day use.  We got there early and stayed the morning.  The white sand and blue water is unbelievable.  Makes for a perfect Aruban picture.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is over-rated and not worth tourists visiting. The beaches near the resort are nicer and less crowded. There's also a great beach north of the resort hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This beach ruined all other beaches on the island for my family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For how many beaches I’ve been to, this is definitely hanging in the Top 3.  My family and I stayed in the hi-rise resort area and were so happy with Palm Beach; we were shouting out praises of how beautiful it was, how awesome the water was and how nice the sand was.  Then we went to Eagle Beach - and it just blows Palm Beach out of the water (sorry for the cheesy puns).  Here are some notes:- Crystal clear waters.  It’s cold, but not uncomfortable cold.  It’s that refreshing cold like drinking an ice cold coca cola on a hot summer day.- The finest white sand.  It was so pillowy under my feet.  I wasn’t scared to step anywhere, nor did we hesitate to build sand castles or bury my son in the sand.  There were no rocks, trash, creatures or anything hiding or littered in it.  - Waters are calm in the early hours.  From our experience, the waves started coming in when more and more people were out on jet skis (we went on a thurs, the waves got more and more around noon).  We showed up between 830a and 900a and had a few hours of pristinely calm waters.  I don’t know about you, but I don’t like to be in the beach during the hottest times of the day (12p-4p).  It might be nice and breezy but that sun is still a killer during those hours.- Show up early!  Bring your own chairs or beach blanket and get a palapa (they are free, the chairs are not).  We were told that the hotels furnish the chairs but we just saw people ignoring the ones already set out and plop their own chairs.  Some folks even set up under the divi trees.- Coming from the hi-rise area, we took a taxi (flat fee $9) and got dropped off at the 2nd parking area across from Chalet Suisse.  From our experience, there were less people here (and more at the first parking drop off).- At this same area, there was a white food truck named Mama’s Cooking that opened at 11:30a.  They served plate lunches consisting of rice, fries, a potato mash scoop, and one plantain with your choice of protein: chicken, steak, porkchop, fish (grouper), shrimp, combo.  There were also specials of the day.  All ranging from $9-$20.  For reference chicken was $9 and fish was $12.  Very good!  There was a lot so you could share 1 order with another person.  Sauces included garlic, pink sauce, peanut sauce, and aruban sauce.  Awesome food.- The areas on the beach cordoned off by red/white striped barriers are where turtle eggs have been buried.  Stay off. - We crossed the road to hail a taxi (thank goodness for the amazing Aruban trees that provided shade).  It was easy to hail one.  Even though prices are fixed between Eagle Beach and the hi-rise hotels at $9 the driver charged us $12.  Understandable because we were a party of 7 (2 kids sitting on laps) and we weren’t exactly dry.  We tipped him on top for the trouble.  We’ve seen a youtube video saying some taxis won’t pick up wet folks from the beach but it worked for us.I can’t say enough positive things about this beach.  If I ever go back to Aruba, I am going to stay in a property across the street.  Best beach on Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Choose Eagle over Palm
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, less crowded than Palm.  Passions restaurant had great breakfast on beach.  Rent chairs for $10 a day (or if you stay at nearby hotel..amsterdam, la cabana, eagle they are free)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bliss
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome sand, nice breeze, little hungry fishes around your feet in the blue, clear water, and very calm water for floating about. Perfect!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. Not crowded. Good for snorkeling with family. We took our nine and seven year old. Beach chairs Available but at a price. Pretty cheap though. Not rough water just beautiful. Great family place. Restaurants near by but not as accessible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great sea life to find here, all the neaches here in Aruba are great to snorkel in and I wish I had learned scuba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean quiet beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The very clean and private beach has beach attendants who make sure you have chairs if you're staying at PBV across the street.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Emerald Water and Soft White Sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with a soft white sand, the sea floor is sandy too, which makes for very pleasant swimming.  Uncrowded and relaxing, with a laid-back vibe.  The water is mostly calm, it gets deep fairly quickly, but gradually.  Absolutely delightful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, clear blue water...what more could you ask for? This is an absolutely gorgeous beach and a must visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband amd I, stayed at Riu Antillas. The beach was amazing loved it. Crystal clear and stays warm all day even I'm the morning and at night! Calm and clear or any seaweed...also the sand is a beautiful white sand and soft. I love this beach...this is my second choice after Baby beach! There is less wind at baby beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on Aruba.... actually best beach anywhere!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is just pristine with it’s beautiful soft, white powdery sand.  The water is crystal clear, since there is very little motor boating activity, unlike Palm Beach.  There’s just a few jet ski rentals.  Nobody bothers you or tries to sell you miscellaneous stuff or tries to braid your hair.  All of the beach bar/restaurants are part of a hotel or resort in some way and are so happy to welcome tourists.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand like marshmallows
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Softest sand I've ever walked on! Beautiful beach. Did the jet ski rentals, seemed they cut us a little short on time but all around fun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved our stay on Eagle beach. The beach is massive with very soft sand. The water isn’t as calm as palm beach, but crystal clear and still enjoyable

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach - Bucuti & Tara Resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bucuti & Tata on Eagle Beach is the penultimate hotel with awesome beachfront umbrellas and palapas.  Adults only makes this a special getaway.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach. It’s not crowded, the water activities are great and not expensive. Beach food and beverage service is great. Free tiki hut, but there is a chair rental fee.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful day at the beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! Water was incredible.  Not crowded.  Free cabana, only needed to rent a chair.  Parking was close.  Very safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped at Eagle beach during our day tour and it was gorgeous. We were staying on the Palm beach side. Eagle beach is great if you want a little more quieter beach vacation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing w reasonably priced activities do the jet packs and tubing! Also the water is luke warm and calm

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Sand Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love the beauty of Eagle beach as it is not quite so busy as Palm Beach. Just walking the shore & admiring the beautiful color of the blue & turquoise blue waters is amazing!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Okay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach! Very relaxing but the staff at passions were not the nicest and food and drinks weren’t that good for the price.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Staying across from Eagle beach, it is the softest sand on the island!  The water is clear, the waves are great.  I could call this home.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My son, wife and I visited eagle beach during our stay in Aruba and it’s one of the most amazing beaches! Clear blue water and soft white fine sand. Can’t wait to come back in the future!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, wide, uncrowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is very wide and deep, with papas on the beach that you can use for the day free of charge. The sand is soft, and not hot on your feet. This beach is quite, and not crowded. Palm beach a little to the north is the see-and-be-seen beach; younger crowd, busier, more bars and restaurants and shops.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful FREE beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All of Aruba beaches are free! This beach has a great view of the sunset and has a lot of area to spread out. The water has so many different colors that is breathtaking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach,
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have not found a more perfect beach anywhere in the world. Eagle beach is my happy place. The water is calm and clear and the beach itself is never crowded. There is a tiki bar right on the sand (near Amsterdam Manor) as well and activities (jet skis, parasailing, banana boat rides) for the kids. This what a family holiday should be!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Photoshoot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Would love to come back to this beach, not sure if we will have time but it was so beautiful! The photographer was telling us about the area. If we ever make it back to Aruba this is the beach I would like to be on. Seriously, beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at La Cabana Resort.  Eagle beach was across the street.  It was the most amazing beach ever.  Very clean in and out of the water.  Very sandy, clear water.  If you want to snorkel, this is not the beach for you, but we loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach, it what makes Aruba popular
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a nice long sandy beach to stroll, sun and swim in. It is not as crowded as Palm. There are places to rent loungers. Also, it has a walking path that goes along the entire length.  Look for the Peruvian food cart near one of the condos. It also has the famous trees with some mini blow holes at the north end

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, pure, peaceful and beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are looking for a place to unwind, relax, decompress where it's warm, sunny and beautiful, try Eagle Beach area in Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jet ski
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of fun in the sun and a great food truck to boot my husband and girls went they got 35 minutes of fun on the water, we took a boy taxi to eagle beach. Also so safe to walk around everyone is so friendly

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing and peaceful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So breathtaking, the water is so clear you can see the ocean floor. Jet ski rentals on the beach, but are not intrusive if you're swimming/floating in the tropical water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Bucuti and we were right on the beach.  It was so beautiful and we watched the sunset every night. The sand is white and soft and the water isn't too calm and isn't too rough either.  Loved it there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a hard tie with Baby Beach, sand here is WAY better than Palm, , little choppier than Palm but not by much, has less tourist stuff here as well

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Incredible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What can I say, nicest beach I’ve been to in my life and I’ve been a bunch of places. They say it gets crowded non COVID times but still worth it. Probably biggest most beautiful beach on the island.....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My friend and I stopped at Eagle beach our last day.  So glad we did! It was easy to get to, easy to park at, lots of space to spread out, easy to get in and out of, and even though my pictures show it a little dark while we were there, the sun came out and showed how amazing the water was...I just was in the amazing water instead of taking pictures then haha

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach enjoyed dinner one night and a beach day another! The water is such a gorgeous color!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is a beautiful , soft, white sand beach.  The sand does not get hot on your feet and there were not sharp stones or shells so walking on the beach was easy.  The palapas are great for keeping out of the sun and hanging your beach bag.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: good time in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: had good time on the beach, very clean, not crowed, i enjoyed the beach with its sand, and the sun, plus the water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice wide beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is wide and nice and not that crowded! A lot of activities if you like that or you can just relax in the beautiful water and soft sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful White Soft Sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I stayed up near Palm Beach, but occasionally drove down to Eagle Beach. Sand here is better and plenty of parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is beautiful. If you want to enjoy a day in the sun/tanning, swimming in the ocean or enjoying a ride on a jet ski this beach is the place to go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sandy beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This top ten beach in the world is perfect for vacationing and relaxing.  We stayed at the Costa Linda resort and enjoyed this beach immensely.  Great swimming and wonderful sand for walking the length.  Very few water toys at this beach which helps  versus others.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was clean,  white sand,  lots of beach water was a bit cold but very refreshing.  Had a delicious meal from the truck vendor. Overall very good experience at Eagle Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous, peaceful, serene.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented a condo at Oceania, perfect.  Walked out of our condo each morning, crossed the street onto one of the top 10 beaches in the wrold.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Eagle Beach - much quieter than Palm Beach. They have some options for restaurants and water sports on the beach. You can’t beach chairs for $10 for the day which is pretty reasonable considering it’s $60 per day at Baby Beach. The Divi Trees are so cool against the sand and blue water. Definitely Instagram worthy!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lovely beach all in all
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is another of Aruba’s great beaches . Sand and sea were gorgeous and I will definitely be back if I come back to Aruba

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pristine
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long perfectly white sand beach. Simple paradise, as a matter of fact the entire island is a paradise

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tranquil and Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took our family photos on this beach, we are a family of 5. We had an awesome photographer that recommended this location for our photo shoot. The view and beauty of the water is like no other. Highly recommend Eagle Beach either for dinner on the beach, pictures or to hang out for the day

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous beach than any other in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was not far from where I was staying in Aruba. This beach was - simply put - WONDERFUL! Sand was white and water blue and calm. You just need a towel to go to this beach.. umbrella was already there. There was a place to eat and drink near by as-well. If not, Super Food was in a walking distance! I had a wonderful time at this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aruba’s best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach on Earth! Well, at least of the dozen or so we’ve been to. Soft white sand that doesn’t burn your feet, gently merging into clear, warm aquamarine sea. Plenty of beach amenities, both active and purely relaxing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Family Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Get here early in the day to have use of one of the public (free) palapas.  It's a great place to spend any day of the week!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach sand is sooo soft. Schools of fish fun to feed out of your hand just a few feet into the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach was beutiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our entire family loved this beach.  Just got back from a NYE vacation here.  The water was crystal clear.  The beach was clean.  The water was refreshing.  Looking forward to coming back again!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach in Aruba. Clean sand. Easy entry to the water. Plenty of activities, showers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven on Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful  beach ever - You'll want to go back everyday! The water is crystal clear and the perfect temperature to relax in all day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Family vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in the world contender... I’d vote for this being #1.Sand is perfectly while. Long stretch for walking. Not overly crowded. Water warm, clear and sandy bottom. Very swimmable- surf not too rough.Restaurants/bars and hotels accessible if desired.Bring shade and a folding chair if you aren’t staying at hotel on eagle beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand as soft as your best mashed potatoes!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach. Not crowded. Ideal spot to chill and swim!You can grab a hut early (free) or rent umbrella for $25 if your Gang likes to sleep in!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to do water Sports Eagle is the beach to go. They had it all and a very cute beach bar.  If you want shade, make sure you get there early. Shade is free but you do have to pay for lounge chairs

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good place to visit for the end of the day. Not very young children’s friendly due to stronger currents and waves than other beaches in Aruba. But definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful to look at, Delightful to swim in
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One cannot visit Aruba and not experience some or all of Eagle beach. Clean, safe and peaceful. It tends to have a bit of a drop off about 20m in so it's great for strong swimmers. Water so clear you can see your toes and the white sand below even when you are out at a 20 ft depth. This was my absolute favorite beach to be at. I've been early morning, daytime, at sunset and at night. It even has a well lit walking/cycling path which is perfect for evening strolls. Put it on your beach hopping list!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach please stop littering!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been coming here for 11 consecutive years and I’m looking forward to as many more. The sand is silky and so white, the water is such a beautiful aqua color. My issue is the people who litter and are destroying this beautiful beach. Please pick up your garbage such as cigarette butts, bottle caps and other trash that belongs in a can and not lying on this beautiful beach. If things don’t improve my family will be looking for a less littered island. Makes me soooo sad!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach!Very clean atmosphere. Ocean was crystal blue, warm and I could of swam all day long! Along the beach is little huts with different activities. Jet skiing, parasailing, etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is so relaxing I like it better than palm beach, we were near the bar Passion so we can get drinks and also have a meal for lunch. We spent a full day just lounging, went into the clear clear water there is plenty of parking on the street. You won’t regret it come visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ranked 6th in the world, 3rd on trip advisor. The water is so clear and calm. We were in the water whenever we weren’t touring.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach is breathing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am biased because I am staying near Eagle Beach and the sand and water were amazing today!! This is a great place if you are traveling solo or with a group of friends. The white sand beaches and the most amazing aqua blue waters will have you believing you are in paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favorite beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We ended up coming here everyday on our trip! It was absolutely stunning—the water is so clear! The beach wasn’t crowded during our visit, which made it even better. It was so relaxing to soak up the sun and swim without a large crowd. The palapas were nice, too! There were some dogs that joined us and were very friendly!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The clearest, cleanest and warmest water I've ever experienced! Wasn't packed with tourist either. Went twice the week I was there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand, perfectly clear aqua water, no boats coming in and out of the area, just perfect!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rest and relaxation.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and peaceful. The water is so beautiful , spent all day just enjoying the serenity of the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots to do, jet ski, wind surfing, etc.. sand was beautiful and water was amazing. Take sun screen!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean white sands and warm sun abound
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sands and warm sun. What more can a northern boy ask for during the middle of winter. Eagle Beach is one of the best in Aruba and will continue to be where we come year after year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very calm and peaceful beach. There are water sports readily available if that’s what you feel like doing. The shaded huts are free to use and you can rent chairs for a small fee.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach we visited at Aruba. Sure we were at Bucuti and Tara but walked the beach from end to end and it was beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Favorite Beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: In my humble opinion, Eagle Beach blows Palm out of the water. While Palm is shallow, it is god awfully crowded with people and the shore can be a bit eroded. While a bit more wavy, Eagle is more majestic and provides optimal room to social distance and walk on the seemingly never endless stretch. When in Aruba, I will often opt to stay near peaceful Eagle instead of busy Palm but to each their own.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Can't wait to come back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is by far the best Beach i have ever visit. The pristine waters caresses your skin almost like foam...it is peaceful and even the fish are your friends. The white soft sand it's fabulous. Parking is free. Sparkly clean! Food trucks and bandages available for purchase. The views of the catamaran in the short distance. All king of water sports right there at your disposal to do for a fee obviously. Aruba in general is PARADISE! Eagle Beach is a clear example of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited both Eagle and Palm beaches.  More of a beach area at Eagle and seemed much less crowded. Your picturesque Caribbean beach destination!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our Favorite Beach in the World!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach has brought us nothing but smiles and good memories! It is very relaxing and tranquilo, incredibly clean, and family friendly. The water has been very shallow in some spots and good for young children to swim, the bugs/flies have not been a bother, and there is a very large space to spread out and have lots of room.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach. Good for swimming and water activities. They have several places to book activities. We booked parasailing here and it was amazing. There is also a restaurant with amazing burgers and a bar with great drinks with very friendly staff. You can also rent chairs here to have under the palapas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely breathtakingly beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a gorgeous beach!! Soft, white sand and pristine turquoise waters!! A definite must stop and hang out in Aruba!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Wide Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is beautiful! This quiet beach has such a wide stretch of white sand that it makes for amazing long beach walks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Impressive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If your looking for a short road trip from your hotel, don't miss out on this opportunity.  We just returned and experienced a rare event at Baby Beach.  The water was all the way to the restaurant steps.  Aruba is not known for a lot of rain fall but like everything else in 2020, nothing is of the norm and they are getting a bunch of it.  However the time was precious and the food was delicious and the weather was Baby Beach perfect.  Not to mention your children will love it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is a wonderful beautiful beach. Clean and fantastic. The sand is so white and the water has a turquoise color I have never seen before.  Breathtaking!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relax!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is my stress reliever!!!  It’s so beautiful and the sand is so powder like, that when I’m not there, I close my eyes and I relax.., because it’s one of the most beautiful places in the world.., one happy island!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning! Pictures and words will do it no justice! A must if on the island! I did not want to leave! If ever I hit the lottery I will move there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach of Aruba!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach indeed! Soft and white sand, perfect for a long walk, calm and clear water, places to eat, chairs and umbrellas available, jet skies, a great place to spend the day, safe for little kids.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of hotels and eating/ drinking places. Beautiful white sand , warm aqua color water,  be careful of undertow in ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my top favorite beaches! Soft white sand and amazing sunset views. Will be coming back to paradise!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must Visit Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was amazing. It was only second to Baby Beach. Water was crystal clear and even though there wasn't any coral close to the shore to snorkel, it was just great.Get there, pay $10.00 US to get a recliner, find a tree and just melt away. Pizza Hut even has people taking orders for the hungry. During Covid, there was plenty of parking and it is free. This beach is a definite must!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favorite beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went back to stay on Eagle Beach for our second trip to Aruba and spend each afternoon on the sand under a tree to watch the sunset. Great location and friendly people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches ever!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is by far the prettiest beach I have ever been on!! Beautiful white sand and crystal clear water!! We stayed right across the street from eagle beach and it was a gorgeous site to see every morning from the condo we rented! The beach was not crowded at all due to Covid so not sure how it will be when things go to normal. Several restaurants are across the street down the stretch so get a bite to eat was within walking distance. There are several spots with public palm tree huts first come first serve, didn’t have to worry too much in the morning but later in the afternoon you could rent a beach umbrella if they were all taken up. It stays windy most the day which is great to help keep you cool without noticing how hot it does get but low humidity. Beautiful sunsets from that side of the island!! A must see and do if you go to Aruba!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is very calm. Easy for swimming and snorkling. There are plenty of places as you arrive where you can rent beach chairs and umbrellas at a reasonable price. (if you are staying at a resort by the beach they may be included so check with your resort)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Paradise Villas and so this beach was on our back yard. This was the first beach we visited and let me tell you, it was beautiful!!! Pure white sand, very clean and very calm. We did parasailing, but they have all kinds of good deals on other water sports as well. We paid $40 for 10 min. This beach is definitely a must when going to Aruba. We also visited the Divi tree.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach,  but no eagles
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you come looking for eagles, you'll be very disappointed.  Only powder soft white sand, water that's both clearer than you can imagine yet bluer than the worst advertising hack could possibly describe, and a bunch of locals who are so friendly and helpful, they must be up to something.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Getaway
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beach!!! With an amazing sunset and soft white sand. Water was very pleasant and warm. Eagle beach is very quiet

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very nice and clean. I felt safe leaving my belongings. I wouldn't leave it fully unattended though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches on the island. Gentle waves and pristine sand. Close to restaurants and shopping.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No place I'd rather be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This will be our 8th trip to Aruba this September , I can never get tired of coming here . This year the water was the calmest , and clearest I have ever seen it . There was barely anyone on the beach . My timeshare at Aruba is one of the best investments I have ever made . Eventually I will definitely buy a home here . We rented a car this year . Super easy to drive in Aruba. I highly recommend trying. Definitely visit this beach when coming to Aruba. You will want to come back every year . There is no place like it . Most of the beaches we visited have a parking area on the beach .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven on Earth!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful and tranquil beaches in the world! Easy to see why it is always a top 10 beach in the world! Sand as soft as powder- easy access to water sports of just a lounge chair.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aruba 2020
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sixth time on the island. This is the best beach on the island. Wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else. Was quiet this year due to the coronavirus pandemic. But we’ll worth it. Very relaxing this year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved the blow holes
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great Beach. Beautiful sandy beach. Not much to see snorkeling but great swimming beach and just gorgeous area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Might be our most favorite beach ever!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach has the most clear water and soft sand on the island. The waves are good, sometimes big, but still kid friendly. We rode jet skis this visit ( our first visit was a cruise ship stop) and thoroughly enjoyed this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pristine Beach! Great to getaway from crowds of Palm Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach Aruba is one of the best beaches I’ve ever been to in the world, and I grew up in South Carolina and have spent time in Miami, Florida. The beach is clean and not crowded—and I’ve been 3 times to Aruba it’s never crowded like Palm Beach. The sand is fine and white. I had an unforgettably amazing photoshoot with Jimenez Photography (pictures below). Less food options than Eagle Beach but there is one beach bar and passions on the beach is here for dinner but pricey. Walking distance from the Mill Resort or Divi Phoenix.

reviewsWithKeywords.title:
Fantastic Beach! Beautiful white sand! Water is not as shallow as that of Palm Beach! 
Do not miss
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful! Please don’t miss visiting and swimming in this beach! In many ways, better than Palm Beach!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Honestly this might be my most favorite beach in the world. Especially now when the island is a bit empty. From the beautiful white sand to the gorgeous turquoise water, it really is an amazing experience. There is a quieter section by blue bar that i highly recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wave and sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach not too crowded great bar food friendly staff price is right! When you go you have to make sure you try to Aruba Rita and the wahoo local fish to die for must return very very soon !! Followed all social distancing guidelines beach not too crowded, did temperature checks , sanitized , very very friendly and attentive staff !!  Almost like we had the whole beach to ourselves!!! That’s another five star rating for the beautiful island of Aruba my new home away from home

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft white sand and beautiful blue waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow.   Just wow!   Not sure we will be satisfied with any other beach in the world.  Eagle beach has amazing white beaches and spectacular blue waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach at Paradise Beach Villas
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great stretch of beach, easy swimming, available water sports, easy access with a great new stretch of walking/biking trail in front of it, with what I call 'exercise sculputures' on the trail.  This beach is not as busy as Palm Beach and that was perfect for us.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach was so beautiful experience! I definitely enjoyed the water sports. The water is such a joy to see.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Came once, twice, and more!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed in a condo a stone throws away from Eagle Beach and was lucky to get to frequent this gorgeous oasis. Believe the hype, Eagle Beach is peaceful and much larger than it’s more developed neighbor Palm Beach. I found it to be much more beautiful and an all around better experience. If you are looking for a beach-centric experience, head to Eagle Beach. If you want more restaurants and bars by the water, go to Palm Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach at La Cabana Resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nicest beaches we have ever been to.Very clean with beautiful blue water. We hope to be back soon .😎🌴

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Calm and beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous white sand beach. Very calm and perfect for swimming.  You can sit under Divi Tree. Perfect place to take photos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved the area but the water was too rough for me.  I tried to sit to get wet and it was trying to suck me out to sea.  One wave dropped a crab right next to me and it took off running.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach and crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented a place across the street from Eagle Beach to avoid the Palm Beach/resort area.  It paid off big time.  Easily getting a shelter even in mid-morning.  It’s voted one of the best beaches in the world and they are right.  Skip the resort beach and head down to Eagle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow what a beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredible setting on most pretty beach in the most relaxed setting. Atardi restaurant by the way located on this beach as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: AMAZING BEST BEACH
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is my fav beach probably in the world!! It feels like you are on a deserted island!! Soft white sand , and blue waters!! Nothing else to say!! My wife and I went to beach by Manchebo and Bucati , we wasnt guest there, public beach cant kick you off but they wont let you us their lounge chairs, they have a public side where you rent chairs and locations. AMAZING BEACH!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an amazing beach! Beautiful water and sand is just incredible ! In love with Aruba’s beaches :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: At first, I thought the beach would be too wide, but it was great - the ambiance and the view were fantastic. Now I feel that Palm Beach, where the high-rises are, is even a bit too narrow - we must just be spoiled by Eagle beach. The water at Palm beach is quieter, but the waves at Eagle beach make the beach look more natural. As expected in Aruba, the water is clear, no rocks, no seaweed, just paradise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the world. Come here in Corona time to enjoy is most!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely white sand and welcome shades. No large reefs to snorkel, but for a breathtaking sunset come here

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water was refreshing and clean. I generally don’t like beaches but this one is worth it. There are all types of water sports available as well as beach bars.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely Breathtaking Water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The colors you will see in just the water alone are absolutely gorgeous. The water is the perfect temperature, the sand is soft and white, and the experience was awesome. Super clear water. There are chairs for rent by a local merchant, water sports as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My favorite beach in Aruba, really beautiful... amazing white powder sand, crystal clear water..  Great for sunset views

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Moving here!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most Beautiful beaches in the WORLD!!! I love it so much I bought a condo here and plan on spending the rest of my life between here and home in West Virginia. I think actually it will be more and more here than there!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great swimming beach, drops of quickly in spots, watch the little ones.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic public beach. Sand is super soft and white.  Beach drops off and becomes very deep, very quickly so watch out for the kiddos. ( We were at Bucuti and Tara) Waves come from all directions including sideways (which was new to me but after the first mouthful of salt water I quickly caught on) Waves are not very big and if you stay close to shore kids would have tons of fun. Not many shells but we did find a beautiful starfish that we quickly returned after snapping a cool shot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful and the water is crystal clear.  The only thing that marred the view were oil drilling platforms off the coast.  They don't belong to Aruba but they definitely take away from the view.  I pray that they never have an accident because the beaches will be ruined.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walking beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is a walkway along the resorts on the beach side which gets you to several restaurants and bars.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Eagle Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach, located in the low-rise hotel area of Aruba. It is much quieter and more serene than Palm Beach. Here, you can actually walk/run the entire length of the beach without tripping over a million people. You will find only a few water sport activities here, which is wonderful by comparison to Palm Beach which is just crowded with people and too many motorized water activities. It’s wide open and gives you the feeling of being on your own private beach. Eagle Beach is our favorite beach on Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach - lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! Not to big. And not to crowded. Nice play to stay and enjoy the sunbathing and the sea.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: World class beaching
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our family spent much of our spring break at this amazingly beautiful beach. There are many recliners and tables available on a first come basis. The aqua water is warm with gentle to moderate waves. The fine white sand is always cool even in bright sunshine.  Just a five minute walk from our nearby hotel, we were able to catch some epic sunsets along with many other guests.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach in Aruba is one of the best beaches. The sand is soft white and there are chair/umbrella stands and little pop up bar and lunch stands.The water is tranquil and the ocean breezes are perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came to this beach ten years ago and were fascinated at the huge Iguanas running everywhere.Not so many now or so it seemed but a lovely place to relax and swim in the warm water.Just love Aruba and Eagle beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sand was soft to the feet, water was calm & warm, sunset was amazing; over all the experience was overwhelming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My daughters and I were very excited to have the opportunity to visit one of the best beaches in the world!!  The morning we went to Eagle Beach was cool, rainy and windy.  It was a pretty beach and we made the most of it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a public beach with powdery white clean sand and an amazing beach.  The water is cold but so refreshing about being out in the sun.  I took the local bus f($2) from the Holiday Inn Hotel. It takes approximately 15 minutes.There is a resort accross from the beach.  Many people from the resort are at beach but not crowded.  Lots of space. You can rent a chair and umbrella for $10.  It is a must do in Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: we were there in october
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we were there in October. eagle beach is deep and wide, lots of room to sun.  surf is mild unlike the east coast in Maryland. sand is soft , the sun is hot and very powerful, so bring the sunblock and rent or bring a sun shade if you plan to stay for a while. the rentals are a bit expensive at 25.00 us

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven on Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stay at Divi All-Inclusive on Eagle Beach. It is always so beautiful and not real busy! The best beach in the World for Us!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but way too crowded.  Best to go just about 2 km to the east at Divi Beach. Smaller but less people and water just as nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had one day in Aruba and chose to spend the entire day at Eagle Beach. The sand was white and the water a beautiful turquoise, but chillier than we would have imagined. Very windy. Not much to see if you want to snorkel. We were able to get chairs for $10 each near Paradise Villa.
