If you get there early enough, there are some free umbrellas and thatched roof covers - otherwise you can rent umbrellas too. There is a great restaurant, Passions, that serves lunch on the beach and has some shade to escape the sun.Kids had a blast playing all day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but needs more bathrooms
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here while on a cruise ship stop. It was free and the water was a beautiful color and water was calm and warm.  We did find shade for our towels under a tree so we didn't pay for beach chairs.  But our main problem was that we couldn't find any bathrooms or changing rooms.  I asked and was told that I could only use bathrooms if I was the guest of a hotel so that limited how long we could stay here.  But the beach itself was beautiful.  Free parking along beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach > Palm Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is gorgeous, and way less populated than Palm Beach. While Palm Beach is situated among busy hotels, Eagle Beach provided a pleasant, down-to-earth and relaxing environment to spend an afternoon. Plus, much more romantic -- few children, mostly couples/small groups, and much quieter. Chair rentals near Amsterdam Manor amounted to $30 for two, but the palapas/umbrellas were free -- HOT TIP: bring your own chairs and beach it up without shelling out $15/chair. Plus, Amsterdam Manor has a mini-mart for all your sunscreen, medication, cigar and random contraceptive needs! 10/10.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: How can you go wrong by staying on one of the best beaches in the world!! The sand is unbelievable!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent 3-4 days here while we stayed in the area. Water is great and the beach is long and sand is pretty smooth and clean. Some shells but less than other beaches for sure. We stayed under our dilapidated palapa and felt like we had the beach to ourselves which is nice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Every morning I would walk five km along that sandy beach and then dive into it.. HeavenWatch the cruise ships arrive and stare at the magnificent colours of the sunrise

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our favourite!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: At Eagle Beach, the water is beautifully clear with no rocks or seaweed. There are chairs and umbrellas for rent, or you can bring your own chair and find a quiet spot a little further along the beach. It’s a great beach for families, with lots of room to play or build sandcastles. There is not a lot of shade, but there are a few trees along the edge of the beach. Out of all of the beaches we’ve been to in our 4 visits to Aruba, Eagle Beach is definitely our favourite!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach on island this is my 2nd time to this beach. Always clean and friendly staff only a short walk from La Cabana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Always windy, always clean both in reference to the sand as well as the water. There’s a pier that provides food, drinks, souvenir shopping & washrooms for paying customers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfection
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is so beautiful there is nothing like it! Since I live in Florida and go to all the beaches here on every coast,I didn't exspect to be impressed, was I wrong!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: always beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have had the pleasure of staying in aruba a few times and visited many of the islands in the Caribbean , I always find aruba to be clean and friendly with beautiful beaches. I do however favor the beach at the Hilton due to the beach being wider and less rocky.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our Favorite beach for swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand. Calm clear water. Easy to park. Free palapas if you can find one. Chair and umbrella rentals available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Did not spend a lot of time here, but it is a beautiful beach and the water is gorgeous. The ocean was a little rough at times but there were no drop offs when walking in the water. Plenty of space not crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been here before and the biggest problem is the wind. It is a beautiful beach but when it's windy you get sandblasted!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the Best Beach in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I will recommend this Beach more than the Palm Beach although they are both nice beach except they have more parkings.  It's across MVC Eagle Beach Resort... Make sure to go there early to find good spot. We rented umbrella and 2 chairs for USD $10 for all day. Try to find the guy in blue shirt because he has the best deal..do not rent the umbrellas and chairs from people at the cabana because they charge more for large umbrella $35, small umbrella $25 and $10 for each chair. If you can find the guy in blue shirt will be best and he's there early until noon.  You can also buy snacks and drinks from the cabana but they're a bit expensive. So bring your own food and drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A little piece of heaven!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you dream of warm sandy beaches with soft white sand, then this beach should fill your bill! What a wonderful area! Eagle Beach is really one of the best in the Caribbean. You will not be disappointed as it is also enhanced by the clear turquoise water of the Caribbean ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took the local city bus from the cruise port to Eagle beach. The price is about $2.50/person one way. It is free for children under 70cm. We bought the bus smart card from the bus terminal near the cruise port. The ride was very short and scenic.  We got off near the Chalet Suisse restaurant. We saw a woman renting chairs and umbrellas.  She wanted $40 for 2 chairs and a large umbrella.  We decided to look somewhere else  Nearby we saw a jetski rental place. He offered 2 chairs under a tree for $20 so we took his offer. Water was nice and cool. There were lots of waves. The kids enjoyed playing in the waves. There was a restaurant nearby where I bought 2 frozen drinks for $20 and also used their wifi.I would recommend Eagle beach and would go back there again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful stretch of beach, surpasses Palm beach in my opinion. We were staying close by but it appeared to have lots of free parking as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I can see why this is one of the top Beachs in the world.  Soft white sand. Calm clear water. Plenty of beach bars and resturants

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed right on Eagle Beach... nice wide beach with soft sand and beautiful water. Not nearly as crowded as the high rise area which we love.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is VERY windy. Put your sunscreen lotion on before going to the beach. Don’t take items that could blow away easily. Wear a hat and sunglasses as the wind and sand will hit you in the face. You can rent chairs and an umbrella for $10 per lounge chair and $20 for the umbrella. The guys will set it up for you. There are no restrooms close out on the beach - there is one somewhat close but they charge $1.00 to use it. There is a small beach bar near where you enter the beach. The beach is large so not too many people during this time. Water sports and restaurants up and down the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this beach because it’s not so busy. Clean, shade is what I always look for. Need to get to beach early, like 6:00am to get a hut for shade.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean and beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a taxi from our cruise ship and were not disappointed!  The sand was clean, and the beach was wide.  We stayed next to Costa Linda, where there was actually a wedding which we saw and heard.  Drinks, bathroom and showers at Coco Loco which got VERY crowded and the lines for drinks were long.  We rented 3 beach chairs and an umbrella for $40, which Ii thought was reasonable.  Beautiful beach, which never really got too crowded because of its size.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: GREAT FOR FAMILIES
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The waves aren't too rough, the water is clear and the beach was huge. Even when it seemed "crowded" we never felt on top of others. Overall, we can see why its so highly rated!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White (!) sandy beach like you have never seen before. All natural. Water is crystal clear be it somewhat current, but nice small waves to play in.Unforgettable

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I see why this was rated top 10 in the world.  Clear blue water out of this world!  The white sand beach and quiet area make this very enjoyable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Super fine sand, beautiful water - but took down my rating because it's crowded. This was our fist time to Aruba - and we  were put off by the amount of people there. Maybe it's because we traveled during February, maybe that's just how it always was.... this beach would have been perfect if there were less people and if the water were a little warmer. So nice!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach with beautiful water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our first beach we visited in Aruba and started with one of the tops ones. Water is so clear, great for swimming and relaxing. We rented an umbrella for $20 which is needed. Even in the shade you'll still get burned.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach has plenty of white sand and beach area to enjoy.  If hanging out on the beach for awhile, renting an umbrella and chairs worth it. Beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wedding
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best Beach forever.The Ocean ist top.Very Naturaly and Not Overrun.Chillen and enjoy the silence.The sandybeach is so beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the Caribbean!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Free access, pristine water, white sandy beach, with chairs and umbrellas available for rent. Close to ports and the city....just do it at Eagle Beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand is fine and white.  Beach stretches as far as you can see.  The water is gorgeous turquoise and darker blue.  Not rocky

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the Best Beaches in the World
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent three days at this beach, a couple days around the pool at our house and one day at Arashi Beach. This is the best- a large umbrella for $55, a nearby eatery offering a $5 grouper sandwich and all the rental toys anyone could ask for. And the place wasn't that crowded on any of the days we were there. Of course, the cruise ship arrivals are the determining factor there. Smooth sand and clear water- what else

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was an amazing beach with white sand and crystal clear turquoise water!!Watching the most unbelievable sunset!!Loved the beach!!❤️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most Beautiful Beaches in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach although not near where we were and required a cab ride.  Not too many people there.  It was great

reviewsWithKeywords.title: La Cabana resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very nice white sand beach a short walk from our resort La Cabana. A nice Long Beach to enjoy a morning walk. We also had a sunset dinner on this beach at Passions on the Beach, very nice!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! Was afraid it would be too crowded but it fine. Water felt great, beautiful and clear. The bar/restaurant has great drinks. A day well spent

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches we have experienced
reviewsWithKeywords.text: For four years in a row we have stayed at Bucuti and Tara Resort located on Eagle Beach. One of the many reasons we stay at this resort is the beach. It is drop dead gorgeous. It is clean and well maintained. The sand is like sugar powder. There is no seaweed. The water is crystal clear. It is not too cold or too warm. It is very refreshing.The beach is great for walking as it is about a mile long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles and kilometres of fine white sand with the odd weird tree thrown in. Great for a long wAlk on the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White Sand, Wide Beach, Lots of Waves....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is lovely -- there's no other way to describe it. The sand is soft and warm and white and the water is Caribbean blue with lots of waves. You can walk and walk and walk and when you get hot, you can run into the water and jump the waves. Perfection is perfection and Eagle Beach has it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply the Best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you like soft sandy beaches and miles of walking in your barefoot this is the beach for you.  Beautiful water for swimming and water sports.  There is also a boardwalk if you wish to run or bike.  Sunset viewing from this beach is stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over priced but not overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As all the reviews will tell you this really is a fabulous beach. Clean, spacious and safe areas for swimming. Great place to watch the sun disappearing over the horizon with pelicans flying around and boats bobbing in the water. My only concern is the ridiculous prices being asked for sun beds and umbrellas. $50-$60 is not a reasonable price. People are travelling from all over the world to Aruba not everyone is staying in a condo or apartment with beach chairs available. Live up to your motto “one happy island” and reduce your prices!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches we've seen.  We rode bikes down from the Palm Beach.  Great Ride.  Easy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably a mile of white powdery sand. In some areas it's a very wide beach.  We tucked ourselves under a grove of trees for shade. The coast has very little coral, so getting in and out of the water is easy. There are a few beach bars and offerings of chairs and umbrellas are available for rent.  Also available are watersport rentals. Great if you enjoy walking the beach, or just hanging by the waters edge. One of the most beautiful beaches in Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Forever Sea sun & sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although it was quite windy this is a fabulous beach with sea birds a plenty ot above the waves.   Plenty palm trees for shade and very attentive waiters who appear when you wave a pennant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stopped here on a Norwegian cruise.  We were on the huge, over crowded and noisy Epic, never again, but that will be for another review. :)This was our second visit to Aruba and it wont be our last.  We were on Palm Beach last time, which is just a continuation of Eagle beach.  You can walk it forever, up to the California Lighthouse.The beach was clean soft white sand and the water was clear and blue.  I think, of all the islands we have been to, Aruba has the most salt in the water, you are very bouyant.  Bonaire is a close second.You can rent loungers and an umbrella for about $30.00 - $40.00 for the day.  It is a large beach and we did not feel crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Last stop on our Best of Aruba Tour
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach, Swimming is excellent and those that need a little shade there is tree cover. A great last stop for our tour

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are looking for a great swimming beach, a few trees to get under for shade this is for you. Parking beside the beach and good bus access as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach a fantastic beach! great swimming and not crowed! great beach to spend the entire day at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Loved this beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Despite being here in February, the beach wasn’t crowded so there was plenty of space available for sun soaking and for wading. The water was refreshing despite its warmth and the sea was calm. There was a little bit of drag when I was wading but not enough to topple you. The sand was smooth without shells. Be sure to watch where you walk. I picked up several large, fresh looking pieces of green glass while there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy beach but pristine waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is crowded but beautiful sandy beach snd beautifully carrinbean waters   Most hotels are here.  Lots of hotel umbrellas and hotel chairs only for guests

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have to say that Eagle Beach on Aruba is probably one of the most beautiful beaches I have had the pleasure of enjoying & being  the fact that I’m an owner of a timeshare at the wonderful Costa Linda Beach Resort which is onEagle Beach. Aruba is without a doubt : “ One Happy Island “ !  😄

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Peaceful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best sandy beaches in the Caribbean. So much space it doesn’t get crowded. Hire a chair, grab a drink and chill.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach on the Island - $10 Chairs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the best beach I visited on the island. It wasn’t too busy like Palm Beach and if you park on the southbound side opposite the Chalet Swisse you will find convenient parking and cheap beach chair vendors - $10 for a chair. Fantastic calm waters and wonderful sand. A must visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Took an island tour with a guide and on the way back to the cruise port....asked to be dropped off at Eagle Beach. Restrooms are available across the street and internet (if you buy something). Water is perfectly clear and sugar sand very comfortable to walk on. It is approx. 2 miles from the cruise port. We decided to walk back to the ship after our day in the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach on Sunday & Monday all day the rest of the week after 3 pm due to busses. Great little bar on the beach called Coco Loco. Umbrellas are over priced at $50.00 for the day and they will take it for you at 3:30 / 4 pm.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definitely deserving of Best Beach ranking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You will not find a beach with more fine, white sand than Eagle Beach!  Lots of people on loungers but the beach is so big its not crowded.  Bring your own food and drinks if you are a plan ahead person.  Not much in the way of food service available other than one small beach restaurant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best AREA on the ISLAND
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nicest resorts on the island, clean with fabulous restaurants.    Huge pool the best beach on the island voted by ARUBA.com.    No crowds at beach or pool with drink service at BOTH!    Great casino on-site.    One of the best values and places we have stayed at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is a must visit when you are in Aruba.  The water is clear, the beach has white sand, and there is plenty of room to spread out.  Even if you are not staying at nearby hotels, you can rent chairs right at the beach.   The water was so refreshing and the sand feels great to walk on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful big beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is a beautiful, wide beach.  We enjoyed walking it.  There are spots by resorts where there are more people, but still lots of space.  Other parts you see few people.  Comfortable sand.  Scenic views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent  17 days in Aruba and eagle beach was beautiful. If you are looking to enjoy the beach and not have too much of a crowd around you this is the beach to go to. The water is different shades of blue gorgeous

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach in Aruba convenient to our hotel.  Nice restaurants and bars on the beach.  We enjoyed the swimming and water sports.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sand!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand here is amazing! It is soft and plentiful. Beaches stretch for miles!  All of the beaches in Aruba are public beaches, but the various hotels do have their own lounge chairs and shade huts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach for relaxing in all of Aruba!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So clean and quite. Even on a busy week the beach is so huge that you won't have more than 2 people near you. Great for walks with loved ones as well!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely Quiet Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in Palm Beach where all of the nightlife excitement is along with all of the resorts, so the beaches are very busy. Taking a 10-minute bus ride to Eagle Beach provided a delightful contrast where the beach was quiet with plenty of space to set up chairs. When you've had enough sun, you can pop into one of the hotels/resorts across the street for a happy hour bite and drink. When you're done that, you can walk five minutes to get groceries at Super Food which is the only large grocery store in the area. Definitely worth the visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, good for long walks and pedlar free!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach  is away from the hustle and bustle of the high rise hotels.   The water is cleaner because less boats travel this area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with deeper water for swimming
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I heard a lot about Eagle Beach being more natural and wider than Palm Beach.  I did like the famous trees that you see when you first see the beach but found it to be even more crowded than Palm Beach.  There were a lot of jet skis and other activities happening as well and just felt busier.  The water was beautiful and got much deeper than the area I was in at Palm Beach and that was a nice change.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We snorkeled on our own, saw two sea turtles, an eel and a trumpet fish. Gorgeous water! We had so much fun!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach, gorgous white clean sand. Stunningly clear turquoise water. Busy beach in front of several resorts with designated umbrellas/palapas, but you can rent a sturdy umbrella and lounge chairs for $40 USD all day or $15 USD for just chairs. Not a ton of food/drink options but bringing cooler is just fine. Suggest towel clips as the wind can be quiet strong at times.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As expected, this is a beauty! Gorgeous white sand, perfect surf and turquoise waters. This is Aruba!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, if you like very busy beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One's opinion of Eagle Beach is based primarily upon two points: the beach itself and... the many, many people crowding onto it.Let me start by saying the beach itself is gorgeous, probably the nicest on Aruba-beautiful white sand, broad and long. The water is clear with a beautiful blue hue, and a gentle surf. What's not to like about that? This attractiveness is reason for its main negative, however. The place is overpopulated with people! Some visitors embrace this, while others prefer things a bit more subdued. I personally prefer more private beaches, so we went to Eagle Beach only once. There are several other beautiful beaches which are far enough away from the crowds to allow for a more serene experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of sand and space. Clear water. Clean swim area. Wear sunscreen everyday. One of the best places anywhere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach, very clean water, good prices for loungers/umbrella
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Short taxi ride from the port, excellent beach location with very clear water teeming with aquatic life. 20 dollars for sun loungers and umbrella, quite busy but pelicans diving for fish in amongst the bathers, lovely location.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing powder white sand and clear blue waters.  Some of the best snorkeling i have ever done.  Plenty of parking if you have a car.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, white sand but it doesn't have much structure like chairs and umbrelas to rent. But it is very nice

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spend a few there and we enjoy the beach but we seen no turtles . They should try to level the parking since high water puddies .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed within walking distance from this beach - couldn't ask for a more perfect place. Good for swimming, walking (shore or trail).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Much prettier beach then Palm beach. It is quiet and the sand is gorgeous. No seaweed or water sports around.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely beautiful beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean,  safe and the clearest turquoise water with white sand anywhere! Great for walks and there's enough room for everyone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful day relaxing on Eagle Beach. Had a mudslide at the Paradise beach bar at the end our day. The waiters were very polite.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is stunningly beautiful! The soft, pure white sand and the gorgeous turquoise Caribbean Sea make this beach perfect! The Arubian people are the nicest I've ever met in any Caribbean Island!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white sand beach - no seaweed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love Eagle Beach .... the white sand and turquoise blue water .... way nicer than any beach I’ve seen in Mexico.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great for swimming but not snorkeling
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You'll need to reserve your chair and parasol very early.  The beach was very clean and free of detritus.  For some strange reason I accidentally stepped on a bee in the sand but other than that I did not experience any other insects.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunningly beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White powder sand that doesn’t get hot on the feet. A great swimming beach with turquoise blue waters. No water shoes requires as it’s all sand. Lovely day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach is beautiful, the white sand and the aquamarine waters are worth the trip if you are staying at the Palm Beach resorts, plus i recommend sunset dining on the beach at Passions on the Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Exquisite beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved spending time on Eagle Beach. The sand is clean and soft, the water is swimmable the entire length of the beach, and it never felt crowded. Sunsets were memorable!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is absolutely stunning. The sand is soft and the water is crystal clear! Definitely a must see while in Aruba! Make sure to get there early with cash if you want an umbrella and chairs. We got there later in the day and had a hard time renting a spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lots of Unclouded White Sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lots of room to spread out. A beautiful long stretch of uncrowded white sand beach. Shallow out to about 50 yards. If you are looking for a place to rent a chair and an umbrella they are abundant at about $20 per person for the day. There are lots of hotel bars and restaurants across the street , and a few on the beach.  Beautiful place to watch the sunset

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach Close to Pier
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took a cab to Eagle Beach from the pier where our cruise ship docked. Seems to be a set fair: $15 each way. We asked to be dropped off across from the Amsterdam Manor. We arrived early enough to get two chairs under a permanent umbrella.  It costs $15 to rent a chair. The beach is quite long, and great for walking. Beautiful white sand, but could use a grooming, as there were cigarette butts, bottle caps and miscellaneous stuff around our chairs.  Very nice, helpful beach guys on duty.  Jet skis and parasailing are available at several locations on the beach. We had lunch at Passions on the Beach, the restaurant right on the beach. We had coconut shrimp with an amazing pina colada dipping sauce and grouper tacos. Both were quite good with the local beer, Balashi. The food is actually cooked across the street, and then brought over by a waiter.  When ready to leave, the bar will call you a taxi back to the ship, so no worries about not getting a taxi.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy Eagle
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been coming to Aruba for years and Eagle Beach is one of our favorite beaches. It is getting busier and the few palapas that are left are already occupied early in the morning by towels and bags from tourists, who come to have a look around 11 am. Annoying, but now as a "part-time" - local, just like Arubans, we are going to lie under the trees in the shade. The beach is very clean, soft and because of the separate composition it is never hot underfoot. The sea is generally clear and calm, sometimes when it storms, some wildlife and seaweed is washed up. Incidentally, that is quickly cleared by DOW. Eagle Beach therefore remains our favorite.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in Aruba, you can rent chairs and have wifi and restroom in front of La cabana and Amsterdam Manor. Excellent restaurant at the beach, with bar and water sports. The beach is really extensive. I went to the Amsterdam Manor area because of the restaurant for lunch and bar. Not crowded in January. Better than palm beach area were people are close to each other. It's the perfect beach, water is the same temp as outside. Some waves on windy days.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We found a tour bus at the cruise pier that was willing to take us to Eagle Beach for $10 round trip.  The beach was gorgeous and the sand super white and soft.  The water was very clear.  They had people that you could get umbrellas and chairs from.  We had a group of 6 and got a large umbrella and chairs for everyone for $115 plus tip.  You could get a small umbrella for two people for $25 and chairs were $10 each.  I’ve seen many beaches and this is definitely up in my top picks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sand.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The ocean here can be very rough so it is a place to take a lot of care when swimming. Also the entry to the ocean is very stony for the first 30 feet. This can be painful on both your feel and the rest of your body if you get caught by a big wave and get wiped out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well worth a visit. The public beach is a little busy but just walk down by some of the resorts because it is all public beach. If you’re cruising it’s only a few dollar taxi ride.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand as soft as baby powder
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our taxi driver recommended this beach as we were in port one day off our cruise ship. Taxi fair from port was about $15. Beautiful stretch of beach, VERY CLEAN sand and water. There are a limited number of free permanent sun shades or there also are umbrellas and chairs for rent. Chairs were $10 each; we were lucky to utilize the free shade. There is a really nice beach club across the street for drinks and snacks; they also have a clean restroom for use for $1.00 per person.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach!!  We took a sunset cruise that was super fun. Met lots of great people too. Highly reccomend

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous but very busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is amazing but VERY busy.  There are many palapas with built-in tables as well as chairs. Beachfront goes on & on. Many activities are available there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definitely earns it's title as top beach in world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was by far the most jaw dropping beautiful beach on the island.  Furthermore, Eagle beach was a clean rock free beach.  There were plenty of cabanas at this beach and water sport rentals available.  Best part is the famous Divi trees that are worth checking out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The best beach on Aruba. Beautiful white sand that does not get hot. Water was clear and gorgeous. Not crowded like some of the other beaches. There are scattered restaurants along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach & Relaxing at Oceania Residencia
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 450 steps from Eagle Beach! #3 in the world!!  Safe and gorgeous, and the thing not found elsewhere: calm rolling waves in shallow stand able depths.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This broad, long beach has soft, fine white sand that doesn’t get hot.  It’s easy to walk along the shore.  Many people went for walks.  There are not too many hotels next to the beach, and most of them are not large, so this beach never seemed to get crowded.  Far less crowded than Palm Beach.  Oddly, Saturday had the smallest crowd.  Public parking is available.  The beach gets visited by locals.  People of all ages are there.  The beach is fairly clean considering the use it gets.  I did see a mechanical cleaner in use one morning going up and down the beach.  There were just a few water sports vendors.  Other vendors of beach chairs and umbrellas are scattered along the length of the beach.  You have to find them, they are located back toward the road.  Good, because no one bothers you trying to sell something while on the beach.  The hotels provide chairs and umbrellas or palapas for their guests.  Still not sure who gets the palapas located near the hotels, but if you are coming for the day, then you are better off renting an umbrella with your beach chairs, and they’ll set you up closer to shore.  A wide range of languages were heard.  Americans were in the minority.   The swimming areas are well marked.  There are waves, but not strong.  Plenty of children swimming.  However, there are no lifeguards or patrols.  Still, it seemed safe.  Just beach goers.  Everyone was respectful of others.  A wide range of beach attire.  I had the only g-string swimsuit and got several compliments.  There were some thongs and many cheeky bikinis.  Everyone was having a good time with a variety of activities, relaxing, walking, or just enjoying the views.  Very peaceful and enjoyable.   Nice unobstructed views along the whole beach.  Nice sunrises and sunsets.  The winds were strong the week I was there, but the wind is cooling, so it never seems too hot.  Also, no insects at all.  Never a need for repellent.  Rain showers were infrequent and brief, usually at night.  Mainly mixed clouds and sun during the day.  Perfect weather.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most gorgeous beach in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What makes this beach special in addition to the beautiful white sand and the sea is it’s length. One can walk for over a mile. Unlike many beaches in the Caribbean which are contained to the hotel you are staying at Eagle Beach is contiguous with palm beach so you can walk forever. It is also in area of low rise hotels. Thus there is plenty of room to sit under your umbrella and not have other people on top of you. This lends to a very relaxed atmosphere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand. Not rocky. The ocean was calm. Not too crowded. Nice beach to take a long walk along

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach and a a lot quieter then the beach in the high rise area.  There are a couple nice restaurants and bars to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice beach, fine white sand. Wide and long so not congested. Lots of shade trees. Some busier areas than others but still not crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach is the Best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best Beach I’ve ever been to.  Sand is soft, not hot, and very clean.  Water is clear with no seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Idyllic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A long stretch of pristine white sand, warm blue sea, safe swimming and uncrowded areas if you avoid the areas next to the resort hotels. Perfect for a relaxing half day trip and easy to access from Oranjestaad by bus or taxi. This must be one of the best beaches in the caribbean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had dreams of going to this beach from the minute that I found out that I was going to Aruba and it did not disappoint. We were dropped off just before sunset and captured some of the most amazing photos. These photos were taken with just my Samsung note 9 and several people have mistaken them for stock photos because they are so good. It has to be one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach day
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our entire family took a cruise this past Christmas and all 22 of us loved this amazing beach. The white sand ,beautiful turquoise water and gentle waves made for a perfect day. Restaurants close by and chair and umbrella rentals too! Can’t wait to return😀😀

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Less crowded then Palm Beach. Water sports are available on the beach. Great places to eat close by.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Okay if ya want to sit join top of your neighbor.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I like more space and peace and quiet....It is close to all the resorts and is nice in that aspect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not to crowded. Get there early (8-9am) for a palapa, they are first come first serve and free. If you don't get there in time, there are some trees that offer some shade and a portion of the beach has a lot of vegetation that provides it as well. Umbrellas and chairs are also for rent. Umbrellas were $25 when we were there. We did not rent chairs so I do not know the price. Water was awesome.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice long white beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ive been here in the first week of 2020. Lovely beach where you can take a nice long walk. It is crowded compared to other beaches on Aruba. However it does not feel too crowded, perfect for family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on the island, perfect location for sunsets!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach on the island, fine white sand and  perfect location for sunsets!!  You can get cocktails too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our first day in Aruba we went to check out Eagle Beach.  Beautiful sand, a bit more windy but we walked the beach and sopped to have a drink before heading back to where we were staying for the week

reviewsWithKeywords.title: World Class Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Surface white sand...much activity...crystal clear water...good food options close by...and legendary trees...what else do you need?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Be careful lots of jellyfish
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited a couple of weeks ago in search of good snorkeling spot. Both kids got badly stinged by jellyfish. Both had fever and rush. My advise: go to Catalina Beach by 9:00amif you are looking for a great snorkeling spot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Friends and family we catch New Year’s Eve with the fireworks are amazing. Great people, great food, love coming back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jet Skiing at Eagle Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome time jet skiing! Had so much fun. The instructors were very informative about how to operate the jet ski. My entire family got to go out together on the jet skis. Also, it’s a beautiful beach. Crystal blue water and soft white sand. Enjoyed my time there!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach. Water is clear and really blue. You have areas with bars and chairs that you can use or just lay your towel down under a palapa.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lacks amenities, too crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came here as part of a broader tour from Royal Caribbean and the tour guide just dropped us off and left for two hours. The beach and water were beautiful but so crowded they were impossible to enjoy; the water was so packed with people you couldn’t swim without elbowing them, and there were no deck chairs or umbrellas left. People were huddled by the dozen under trees to try to get a little shade. We ended up spending the entire two hours at the only facility open on the beach, which was a bar with no food, checking our phones and waiting to be picked up again. At least there was free wifi. What a waste of a day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We had the best photo shoot here!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is incredible. We had the best photo shoot ever. At sunset, it’s so breathtakingly beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach. Cabs charge a fortune to take you there. You can get a bus pass for five dollars. Bus drops off at beach. Pass is for round trip.Go to the far end of the beach. Much less crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow sensational .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just perfect,clean,tidy,nice people around ,not over crowded whats not to love .An absolute must destination if you visit Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Obvious why it was rated one of the best beaches in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous turquoise blue water! Lots of food and drink choices available on the beach. The white sand is powder soft, and the constant breeze makes sitting in the sun and playing in the water perfect!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was very clean.  It was nice to have a restaurant and bar on the beach, however, it would have been nice to have restroom available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just wonderful, can't even explain the experience  you just need to go.... the beach sand is so white and soft when your in the  ocean it's truly  paradise. The huts are for the resorts, but you could rent umbrellas  and lounge chair. Stay for the sunset it will be breathtaking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rented chairs and an umbrellaHad access to water sports and Passions hotel food and wifiGreat  warm water and easy beach to take a walk onFound parking on the street

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such an amazingly beautiful beach with the clearest water I have ever seen and warm! Definitely will return!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and quiet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was in doubt even after all the reviews I read whether a beach this popular could actually be so quiet. It was. We always got a cabana (from the hotel) , and there was so much space to enjoy the beautiful warm water and soft sand. I do not like crowded beaches so for me the fact that this beautiful beach felt so secluded was a wonderful surprise. Not any services as such but a great relaxing spot to enjoy the Aruba sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Best Beach Award for sure!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach, the dense white clean sand, blue water and the nicest people in the world!!! Will be back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beauty
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The water is pristine and warm. The beach is wide making a long beautiful walk.  It is a wonderful walk from the high rise hotel district with bars and restaurants to quench your thirst and hunger. You cannot miss it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand but many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can find anything on Eagle beach- rentals/chairs/food/drink....obviously part of hotel strip so there are many people but it is worth a half day to enjoy this beautiful stretch of sand and blue ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is amazing. Wonderful view and they have a lot of activities. Parasailing, tubing, jet skiing, banana boat, skydiving, and more

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband and I just came home from Aruba where we stayed at Bacuti and Tara Beach Resort on beautiful Eagle Beach.  This beach is exactly how a post card would look with its white sand and teal water.  The water was a nice temperature especially after bathing in the hot sun.  I noticed that in the early morning hours, the water was a little rougher than I'm comfortable with but as the afternoon arrived, it was calmer.  By no means was it rough like we've seen in Hawaii but I did get knocked down once.  For other people, it may not seem rough at all.  The beach was wide and had a lot of room on it and where we were, it was not crowded in the water at all.  We look forward to returning next December and enjoying another week on this beautiful beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful long white sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach! It’s so large and long that you never feel crowded. Lots of options for chair rental but also lots of trees with shade. We didn’t rent chairs or an umbrella cause we found lots of shade in the trees. The water is beautiful with nothing but a sandy bottom. Great chill beach with beautiful sunsets and easy to get to. I get why it’s one of the best beaches!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach, shallow water so great for kids. But we thought Baby Beach and Arashi were better. Location is great - smack in between Oranjestad and Palm Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach for us Beach Bums!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is excellent quite similar to Palm Beach. The waves come in higher and the entry point into the water may fall off quickly at times depending on your location on the beach. It should be on your radar to visit while enjoying your Aruba vaction.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the world's best beaches for a reason!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easily the most perfect beach I have ever been to. The water is a gorgeous cerulean turquoise and so clear. The sand is like light pink powder and the water temperature is perfect - cooling but easy to wade right in to. I stayed at the Amsterdam Manor, which is located at the top of Eagle Beach and they had a great set up with the palapas etc. I also love that all of the beaches in Aruba are public and this gorgeous spot is enjoyed by tourists and locals alike - but off the beaten path of the cruise ships that dump their passengers at Palm Beach! Eagle was far and away my preference between the two. The low rise hotels are across the street so the beach is much more accessible and the whole area is more relaxed. I can't wait to go back to Eagle Beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely love this beach!! Soft white sands with gentle waters.  Other Caribbean locales may have those turquoise waters but nothing beats the weather here.  Low 80 s Fahrenheit with gentle breezes almost a guarantee everyday and Aruba is below the hurricane belt !!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My recent trip to Aruba.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love Aruba.  I love that everything is in English, the American dollar is the currency, the cab drivers are honest and don't screw you over on pricing and the place is beautiful!!!!!Bucuti & Tara is my place of choice.  Greg does a nice job at the bar And Alex did a wonderful job at the Chop House.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Picturesque
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and peaceful. There is not much shade, so bring sunscreen. We had a wonderful time swimming around and enjoying the scenery.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrive to the cruise terminal and there are a lot of tourist operators.  But we walk 300 ft. to the Aruba bus station Aurbus. And we take a public bus around $2.5 per person each way. And take the bus around 15 minutes. Till we arrive to the beach. Beautiful place but there are local vendors for chairs. And some drinks

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful! Love the atmosphere and location. Very nice weather. Me and my husband only spent few hours there love that it was close to big Supermarket, which was far from our Resorts Caribbean Palm Village.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have said it before but this beach is great.  Nice white soft sand.  Plenty of space on the beach to do what you want.  Easy walk from our room at Costa Linda right onto the beach.  So pleasant here with super clean/clear water and enjoyable waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We spent the day touring Aruba and ended the day on Eagle Beach. One of the most prettiest beaches I been on. The people on ARUBA are super nice. We are going back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Terrific beach, great water, though a bit cleaner would be nice, a 4.5!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went on a cruise to Aruba and took a taxi for $20usd each way to Eagle Beach, about a 10-15 minutes from the cruise port.  This was much cheaper than what the cruise offerings were, the driver took seven of us, so $40 was a deal!  The beach was beautiful and picturesque.  The water was splendid, beautiful and blue.  The sand was white and powdery.  We were lucky enough to get a palapa on the beach with a bench, so it made it comfy for us.  There are hotels that allow you to use their change rooms nearby, but at a cost of a dollar per person.  We had great weather, which only made our day better.  The one thing I would caution people is in out palapa area, I found a screw and a shard of glass.  I know with the size of the beach, it’s tough to catch all this stuff, but this type of garbage could really muck up someone's day at the beach.  I’d say at least the palapa area should be properly cleaned to get this stuff out of harms way.  That’s why, I’d say Eagle Beach is only a 4.5.  I highly recommend a visit to Eagle Beach if you are in Aruba, for a day or for longer!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach in Palm Beach area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful quiet beach in the Palm Beach area of the island.  Calm waves, white sand, hot, and close to the hotels and tourist areas.  Locals love this beach and fofoti trees are all around.  Great for sunning and away from the noise beaches.  There is a strip mall nearby and the local bus runs through the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tranquil
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand and water. Very tranquil. Do have to rent chairs and/or umbrella. $10 for chair and $10 for umbrella. Well worth it. Take the $3.00 Arbus

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply beautiful !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I discovered last week why Eagle Beach has been named one of the most beautiful beaches in the world: it has powder soft and cool sand, aquamarine clear and very warm water with almost no waves, and goes on for approximately 3.5 kms, which is great for taking long walks along the beach. It is also much quieter than Palm Beach as most hotels are located across the street. What's not to love about Eagle Beach?!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: My fave!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Best beach in Aruba! Shady, clean sand, and oh my! That beautiful water! You can pull up in your rental car and park in the shade, bring your own drinks and snacks and just relax!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach Ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing! Very quiet and peaceful.  If you want to relax, this is the place to go and enjoy the best sunsets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is one of the best/nicest beaches we have ever visited. It's clean, water is clear and the sand is like the finest powder. The only neckside is, that 2 Sunbeds and an umbrellas are $40.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I can see why this is the #2 beach in the Caribbean. Absolutely loved coming to this beach everyday.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach - our favorite
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were able to get palapa’s mid day and drinks and bathrooms at the nearby hotel. Crystal blue water and powdery white sand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful 9 da stay
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is  clean with a beautiful sandy white beach the consistency of soft flour under your feet. The sand is not hot to walk on and provides miles of coastal beaches that are along the many shades of turquoise Caribbean ocean water. It is a much smaller pace than its neighboring northern Palm beach. Transportation is easily available by local buses and taxis that are affordable. Restaurants are not plentiful but a short bus or taxi will open the door to just about  any kind of food you’d like to explore. I would stay at this beach on any future travel plans to Aruba.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Top , clean, calm, spacious, white sand,turquoise color. Some watersport offers are provided from local businesses.  Dinks and Food in the Passion Bar or one of the other Bars along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach EVER
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have traveled to MANY Caribbean beaches and this beach is the best! Wide, white sand, walkable, clear turquoise water, nobody selling things to you, nice locals and tourists, good nearby across the street....you can't beat it! Amazing sunset views too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, clean and easy to get to
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our hotel was across the road from Eagle beach so it was very easy to get to. For those not staying near by, there is convenient parking and plenty of space to lay out.   The beach is very clean and the sand is very soft. There doesn’t seem to be a whole lot of coral/rocks in the area so snorkeling isn’t the best. This is a nice beach for long walks and viewing the sunset... beware of the sand fleas that come out after dark though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Azure Residence and walked 5 minutes to the public beach at Eagle Beach.  Beautiful, not busy, clean and friendly.   You can rent jet skis, parasail, ride a float behind a boat, rent kayaks, and chairs.  Such a great day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love this beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing soft sand, crystal clear water and even some shade.  This beach was across from our condo and it was so wonderful.  There were paloppas for shade or you could rent an umbrella.  Wasn't extremely crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most Beautiful Beach in the Carribean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is the most beautiful beach in the Carribean!  The water is a beautiful turquoise color.  There is an abundance of places to stop and eat along the way while walking the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning soft white sand, blue water, a must see when in Aruba. Many water sports available, not over crowded, a really nice beach. Careful with the currents, if wind is strong the sea takes you out and there are no life guards.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful teal water and wide beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful teal water and sand. Highly recommend. Drinking is permitted on the beach since it’s public.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach for family!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rented chairs for $5 and was able to seek shade from palms or palapas. (Umbrellas were $50 due to Thanksgiving week!!) Shallow water entry so good for kids, but take water shoes, rough on feet. Rented paddle board and other rentals available.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is almost everyday calm white sand beautiful.Some days there are some waves that can be a little rough for senior people watched a couple of waves take some down. Be careful but 90 percent of the time its calm and gorgeous

reviewsWithKeywords.title: MVP hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Super place to stay with great restaurant(four+star food), sooo close to the beach and the big grocery store!!  Quiet, classy, and relaxing.  The staff was awesome here and really helpful with our last minute plans!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There are plenty of trees for shade. It's common to share the shade with people you don't know. Anchor fly away stuff, due to the winds. If you want the sunset experience,  Google the time for sunset and arrive 45 minutes before that time.  It's a gorgeous beach, with wonderful picture taking views.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We where there first week in August.We stayed at the Divi Tamarin Resort and took the shuttle.One  of the most beautiful Beaches  I have seen.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet Spot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach was the best spot in Aruba in my opinion. It was quiet and pretty. Pinkish Sand and turquoise water. Extra tips:Do not use cabs in Aruba. they are not metered and the drives charge whatever they want. You can get around the city by bus. The big bus $2.60 or the little bus $2. Make sure you have change for the big bus. You can take the bus to and from Eagle Beach, Palm Beach and Down Town.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfectly white sand for miles and miles, clean, safe and welcoming. Crystal clear  turquoise water, warm and calm. One of thes best in world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful beach.  The sand is white and soft.  The water is absolutely beautiful.  Calm soft waves, crystal blue water.  Never very crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in a condo across the street from the beach.  This sand and water were wonderful.  The location is quiet and south of the high rise hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful beach but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Easy access via local inexpensive buses (we did a day trip off a cruise ship).  Wonderful powdery white sand, clean calm water.  But very little natural shade , crowded and rental of chairs ($10 each) and umbrella ($25) was just outrageous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean, Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While the beach is one o the most popular, it was not packed. The water was glorious and my husband and I were able to hang in a section all to ourselves. The one downside was that there was no bathroom around besides at local bars.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful laid back beach perfect for relaxing and if you want some excitement they rent jet ski's, boat rides etc.. The beach bars have 2 for 1 happy hour too!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach was & is one of the most beautiful beaches on Earth !! Powder white sand , pristine turquoise water make the most beautiful beach I’ve EVER experienced!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved this beach & the weather. We ate at the Passion on the beach restuant which has decent food. Service was a little slow but it was still a nice scenery to have lunch. We ended doing the water tubing which was so much fun ! I initially wanted to do fly boarding but they didn't have it available that day which was a bummer. The beach was packed but not crowded. Would still recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Aruba by cruise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We came to Aruba by cruise so our time was limited.We bought an unlimited bus ticket for the day $10 each.  First we visited Arashy then in the way of coming back to the pier we visited Eagle.It was crowded has a lot of paid chairs and umbrellas. Water motos and other things to do in the beach.Drinks and food too. Please drink a lot of water and bring sunblock. If you use the bus be aware of the time the bus arrives... Every 45 minutes aprox. Going back to the pier is a 20 minutes drive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have really enjoyed few mojitos in the bar, and relaxed on the beach, which have great white sand and azure water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although it was raining on the day we visited, the beach is beautiful and clean.  It requires transportation from the cruise port to get there .. but there are plenty of vendors to choose from and it’s a short 10 minute ride.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just Lay Back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The perfect laid back experience with a few trimmings. It’s just easier if you can hang closer to the bar and grill area. Food is quick and pretty good. Watchful security seems to keep an eye on things, outhouse, beach boy, all in good order. The bus is an easy way to get to this beach area from town and on the way to Palm Beach. We stayed here for a week, traded via Holiday Systems. We had a cheaper studio and was great for two people. Thought for a moment about an upgrade but we hardly spent any time at Paradise Beach  Villa. We were always going someplace, on the move. I also recommend at least a half day of island tour from De Palm Tours or whomever. . We paid slightly more for an air conditioned bus and glad we did.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Is a beautiful beach but....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is a wide beautiful beach but bring your own chairs, very little shade.  The low rise hotels have chairs, shade and other amenities there but for their guests only.  Some areas you can rent chairs but they are low and difficult to get out of.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One Of The Best Beach's We've Been On
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We've been to several Caribbean Islands, Mexico and Costa Rica and spent many hours in the sand.  It's not hard to understand why Eagle Beach was voted one of the best beaches in the world and you won't get an argument from me.  Not only is Eagle Beach large, spacious and beautiful, its also convenient.  The beach has it's own access road separated from regular traffic and it includes ample parking along the way.  Coral sand beach which is incredibly soft at the waters edge where you will find a slight surf step.  No coral heads or rocks here like some beach we've been to like in Cancun.  There is shade available under palm huts or natural shade from foliage along the back beach.  The water is of course that beautiful Caribbean blue that never gets old.  There are several areas where the cruise ships drop off bus loads of cruisers.  No snorkeling here but there is plenty of that elsewhere on the island.  No question one of the best beaches we've been to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely one of the most beautiful beaches in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No! Forget I said that! You don’t want to visit! We don’t need more crowds! Awww crud….  We’ve spent 3 vacations at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort on Eagle Beach. We love it! Especially in November when the ocean is almost warm. It’s wonderful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 10 years of marriage
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a wonderful time celebrating our anniversary and my husbands birthday with our children and grandchildren.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful clear blue water and soft white sand are what you will find at Eagle Beach. Truly beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I’ve visited! It does get busy but it’s worth it! Riu staff did Zumba on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Calmness
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Slow Rolling Waves, And plenty of Calm AreasEasy Entry most spots but there were a Drops Like All of ARUBA Sand  Stays mostly Cool to walk on , But water Shoes  Are A Help Too!! Great place tTo Watch The Great Aruba Sunsets

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stayed at Amsterdam Manor and just walked across road to this beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beachSand beautifulAlways a sun bed and brolly Loved the Passions mango smoothies and coconut smoothies Beach just lovely,  no boom boom musicDon’t like jet-ski’s too many for my liking but they kept outside the swimming area

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Blue ocean and white sand by far the most beautiful that we saw.  More crowded than most but a great place to hang out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Hate to leave it is such a beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I just pray they don’t ruin it with overcrowding like Palm Beach. Do not let it over develop. Perfect weather and perfect water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not all it's cracked up to be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Over the years I repeatedly heard that Eagle Beach is one of the best beaches in the world but I just don't see it or get what all the hype is about.  It is a large beach but by the time you arrive there  you'll be exhausted after working your way into the ocean.  Way too many people for us.  With so many absolutely beautiful beaches in Aruba I just wouldn't waste your time with this one.  Palm Beach is way more beautiful with calmer waters and much more socially active area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We enjoyed the afternoon at Eagle Beach. It wasn't crowded and the beach was very clean.  It was amazing. I would definitely reccomend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand, water beautiful not at clear as some other beaches but the sand was beautiful and nice to swimming

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best place to do your wedding or renewal!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the place to be to do your renewal or wedding! It's so romantic and beautiful with the divi divi trees and the white sands and blue sea! Everything was like in a fairy tale, a wish that came true!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As always this beach is beautiful! Clean sands and water. Water usually calm and so clear. Seen some larger fish swimming close to the shore which was cool.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Getaway
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing as usual!  Aruba never disappoints — in every aspect:  gorgeous beaches, nice people, beautiful weather— and great food!   What could be better?!?!🍾🎉🏝

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girls Trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We got on the jet ski at Eagle Beach  had a great time there.   The folks were friendly and the beach was beautiful  .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautifull beach ever. Long white sand beach with light blue waters. I love the smell of the beach.Nice birds and beautifull view of cruiseships arriving..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Jet Ski
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Rented a Jet Ski from Eagle Beach.  Wonderful waters, great staff and easy to get to.  Beach is amazing.  One of the beat on the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girl’s Trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is where you want to stay in Aruba. Gorgeous and tranquil! Tradewinds keep the heat at bay. Water is crystal clear and beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches !!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying very close to this beach and went just about every day.  Watched the sunrise and spent the better part of our days enjoying this beautiful beach and the wonderful sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a tranquil beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of my favorite beaches on the island. Beautiful white sand You can walk for mile on this beautiful beach. A must for couples who want to walk on the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beauty.  Deserves top beach rating in world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The bluest of blues of water.. clear water.. white sand.. amazing beauty.  Eagle is right next to Palm Beach and both are the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach I’ve ever been to!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Once in Aruba, Eagle Beach is a must! Soft sand and clear water, and the best part, it’s not totally crowded! (Visited during low season two times) snacks and beverages can be bought close by. Possible to rent out shades and beach chairs as well as ski jets and other activities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful sand and lots of beach which makes quire uncrowded for the most part.  It gets busier when the big ship tours get in.Waves are more forgiving than many other warm water locations.Water is nice and warm.....in the 26 centigrade range which makes it great for extended water time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach on the island
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed within walking distance of this beautiful beach. There are lots of sun huts, which are free, and chairs to rent. Gorgeous aquamarine water and white sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Montreal Sunlovers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went for elegant dinner.   Many fine choices.   Beautiful beach.  Low rise hotels.  Just a jeep ride away.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just on a cruise and we decided to go to Eagle Beach on our own (no cruise excursion).  Grabbed a quick cab ride there, only 10 minutes, $3 each, each way.  A small bar/restaurant was there with a single bathroom and 2 head shower.  2 chairs and an umbrella cost $40, very substantial.  The beach was breathtaking l!!!  Beautiful white sand, turquoise blue water, NOT crowded.  Water was rough in the morning, big waves (my sunglasses are gone!) but settled down as the day went on.  Current was strong for little ones-- I would not let them in the water without a life vest.  Would go back in a heartbeat!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mixed review
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When I visited the last week of October, the beach was beautiful as always but the water was unusually little rough on a few days. There were storms off in the distance that were kicking up the waves and more than one person had to be escorted out of the water. Many people were knocked down and rolled out....and one young lady was thrown out onto the beach. Some of it was just comical.  Nonetheless, on the days where the water was perfect, it was amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was one of the stops on my Aruba tour and it was gorgeous. Beautiful clear water and pretty clean. The sand was really hot, but it was a nice experience. I just wished they had fountains to wash the sand off my feet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Plans To Come Back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We left our cruise ship and had a mini tour of the west coast of the island and then spent 4 hours on this fantastic beach. I area was wide and open between  2 large resorts and not that crowded. The sand and the warm blue water were great and we have plans to come back in April, this time a little farther north to the Palm Beach area. The rates for 2 chairs and umbrella were high at $40, but the vendors have you under these circumstances. Across the street there was a little bar and restaurant with a very limited menu, and the lone employee couldn't have been any slower. They also charge you $1 to use the bathroom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing on the beach and in the water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved hanging on Eagle Beach.  We were able to get a hut or put chairs under the Divi Trees.  The sand pretty clean not much washed up on the shoreline and minimum garbage.  The water is just lovely, it was the breeze that was chilly.  A Bar is set-up at one of the entrances so you don't have to go far to get a cool drink.  We loved the atmosphere, sandy bottom and clean ocean water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful white sand beach, was windy though. Beware when swimming I found the current quite strong and I am a good swimmer

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By far the most beautiful beach we've ever been to its very clean and quiet and the water crystal clear. Absolutely breathtaking!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle Beach is one of the great beaches you can spend all day while in Aruba. We spent a lazy afternoon just listening to the calm waves while enjoying the sea breeze and sun. We felt safe in the area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean and beautiful beach.   Was a bit crowded...I suggest an off time to visit. Aruba is beautiful, though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: the beach is gorgeous and the water is warm like bath water, a must see. snorkeling or just swimming around is great

reviewsWithKeywords.title: interesting lighthouse on a wonderful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great to visit and take pictures from the lighthouse. walk to the beach it is beautiful and uncrowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beyond perfect location!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We rented a fantastic Penthouse steps from Eagle Beach. The beach was absolutely incredible!!  Soft sand, refreshing water, great amenities. I can’t imagine a better location!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just wonderful beach. I understand that it's chosen to one of the most beautiful beaches in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation 2019
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I really enjoyed eagle beach with my husband and 2 year old son. It has calm blue water with a fine white sand. We usually went out there in the mornings when it is cooler to walk and swim. It's a 5mins walk from where we were staying at Eagle Aruba Resort and Casino. Great place to be indeed. Will  be visiting again next year.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was off our hotel and it was amazing. Very clean and easily walkable. Accessible through several hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing !! Very relaxing !! I also did the jet ski's which was fun. There are bars and food places right on the beach and places that rent chairs and umbrellas

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great big beach.  Not crowded at all. Fantastic water as it was everywhere in Aruba.  Less vendors here compared to many other beaches.  Good for long walks or just hanging out.  Several resorts/condo litter this beach and have their own personal seating areas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Beach But...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am going to be the nay-sayer here with some caveats. I recently went to Aruba for the first time in October 2019, and the trip was amazing. I relied heavily on Trip Advisor and other sources to plan my trip. I had seen so many great reviews of Eagle Beach, and even reports that it's in the top 5 beaches in the world. I was very excited to try it out. I want to be clear that it is truly a beautiful beach, and there's nothing particularly wrong with it. In fact, all of the reviews that tout it as amazing are accurate, but, if I had it to do over again, I would have spent 100% of my beach time on Baby Beach. I went there later in my trip, and I found it to be far superior to Eagle Beach. The water is even calmer and you can wade out SUPER far because it's so shallow. The sand was even nicer, and it was less crowded since it's about 30 minutes away from the hotel high rise area. Plus, the cabanas, umbrellas and chairs were a little bit cheaper. There was a guy who came up to us and offered cabanas and chairs, and proceeded to bring us drinks and food all day delivered right to our cabanas. We paid $60 for a cabana which comes with two nice lounge chairs. So $30 per person for all day. Just don't forget to tip the guys for their service. The one downer is that there aren't a lot of food and drink options like there are on Eagle Beach. In fact, there is just one option: Big Mama's Grill. But the food and drinks are good, so it's not the end of the world, and like I said, if you get a cabana and chairs, the same guys that rent those work for Big Mama's so you can order from them and have anything you want delivered to you. Also, I should mention the bathroom situation at Baby Beach. You have to pay to use the bathroom unless you are a customer at Big Mama's since the bathroom is owned by the restaurant. There is a woman who sits in the bathroom and takes either money or bathroom tokens from paying customers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach is Fantastic!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. Less commercial than Palm beach. Although there is development in process there's no big hotels yet. White sand, gentle entry to the sea. Beach chair and umbrella was a little high for us so we spread our beach cover on the soft sand, spent most of our time in the water, and stayed for a few hours. Sunscreen is a necessity. If you walk the beach to the point you might see some turtles at the right time of year.We took a taxi but the bus from Oranjestad is still cheap ($5 round trip).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pristine White Sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredible,  Beautiful soft white sand beach, with the right amount and size waves that enhance the warm clean clear tropical ocean experance.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Eagle Beach is Simply Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is our second visit to Aruba and Eagle Beach is our favorite spot! Beautiful sand, fantastic waves, gorgeous sunsets! Eagle Beach has it all! The security is top notch...we always felt safe and welcome! Definitely a 5 Star beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach nice surf hot sun!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A Must go beach, very different from the east coast beaches. Sand is very soft, waves gentle. Sun is hot, be sure to bring a sunscreen or pay the price later...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and Spacious Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove our rental car to this beach and parked in free parking right next to the beach.  Since it was already early afternoon we only paid $10 for a palapa and 2 beach chairs.  The beach is spacious which means less people around you.  The water is beautiful and calm.  Definitely the preferred beach if you want to avoid the more crowded but equally beautiful Palm Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mr
