reviewsWithKeywords.text: I presented my wife with new wedding rings to mark our 25th anniversary.l asked her to spend another 25 with me at sunset on Eagle beach. It was beautiful. Oh yeah she said yes!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After cruising over a dozen times, we found the most beautiful beach. Not over crowed, white sand almost like baby powder!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach anywhere!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is pristine with soft white sand that’s pretty to look at and easy to navigate for walkers and swimmers alike. The water is warm and crystal clear. It’s hard to imagine how a beach could be more beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely Beautiful!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Softest Sands, no vendors, very relaxing area away from Palm Beach craziness.  No beach shacks at South end, still unspoiled.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just ok
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked over a mile from Divi hoping for good snorkeling. Seems the better place was further north. This was ok fpr spme fish viewing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice pretty place to relaxed and enjoy your self with a lot of activities for kids and adults great

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: ALL the beaches in Aruba are public and beautiful! I could (and have) walked for miles. What distinguishes the beaches in my option are what has sunk relatively close to the beach, and how many resorts are within vicinity.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach for a cruise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very pretty wide beach. Not overly crowded, but there are a lot of people there. About 15 minutes and a $15 cab ride from cruise port. Chairs $10, toilet $1

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nicest beach in Aruba
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Truly a treasure, if you visit this island you must walk this beach at least once! Very long, very wide, the sand is soft and clean. A great place to walk anytime in either direction. Nice spot for sunsets. Fewer people to be found here, plenty of places to park nearby and much less commercialism versus Palm. Pack a cooler, bring your beach chairs and lotion and have a great day on Eagle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed nearby.  All of the beaches we visited were great, but Eagle Beach was the best by far.  The sand is super soft and not hot at all.  There were a few people around, but there is plenty of space to spread out.  The water is crystal clear and it is gently sloped out with few waves.  If you’re looking to windsurf, this isn’t for you.  If you want to relax and float, Eagle Beach is it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Eagle beach is just fantastic.  Nothing compares with the white  powder sand that stretches over 150 feet from our resort cabana to the water.  We travel a lot and this is by far the best beach anywhere.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From the cruise terminal, we went across the street to the Arubus terminal, bought a day pass($10) and hopped the bus to Eagle Beach, the bus driver told us he would drop us at the best spot on the beach(it's very large) and boy did he! the beach was phenomenal! Beautiful water, great sand, not too hot(we were there from 4-6pm) and not crowded. My kids(4 & 6) loved playing in the sand and snorkeling in the shallow waters, there were tons of tiny schooling fish to watch. Everyone we had talked to on the island said that Eagle Beach was one of the best, they weren't kidding. None of us wanted to leave, and we are already discussing going back to stay for a week!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful blue water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand was white and the water was so clear you could see thee bottom. It was not a lot of people on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent quiet beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A stretch of beach away from the tourists and the big hotels and almost empty. Plenty of parking space. Beach chairs for rent. Section along the beach only for bathers. There are a few jet-ski rentals along the beach. We had our beach-chairs, plenty of water and sandwiches with us. The beach is safe from pickpocketing this usually happens on the crowded beaches in front of the hotels, and there is always someone who can keep an eye on your goodies. There are various bus stops along the beach but the service can’t be trusted.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water crystal clear, warm like bath water and absolutely no waves, absolutely perfect beach in every single way!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation!!!!!!!!!!  Oh yeah!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean beach!  Clean white sand with hardly any shells, stones, and other debris. Clear warm water. Beautiful. Less populated than other beaches near resorts and hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful colors in the water, gorgeous white sand beach. Loved every minute of it. This is the less busy section of the beach but there are still some watersports nearby.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: espectacular beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach! calm warm waters, clean beach, confortable beach chairs, it is ranked one of the top ten beaches in the world for a reason.!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am a beach lover and this one is extremely beautiful and very kid-friendly... there are some areas that are very populated because many of the hotels are along this beach but if you walk a little far toward the north of the island you will find a paradise... If you are like the one that likes water sport so stay in the hotel area.  Just be very aware any sport or water entertainment there is expensive... like 10 or 15 minutes in some kind of boat .. can be like 20$... but this is the bussines in the area. Also be aware you need to pay for the chairs ... the only thing you can take and no pay are the huts... those are free.. just go early... the beach is also easy reach by public transpostation..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is everything it’s said to be. Absolutely beautiful, stunning, picture perfect. The swimming is great and the tiki huts are first come first served.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: AMAZING!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very few beaches compare to Eagle Beach.  Soft, white sand lead into perfectly calm blue water.  There are plenty of good hotels and rentals and there is always a spot to lay out along this stretch of beach.  We stayed at the Divi less than a mile down the beach, which has a nice beach, but the main Eagle Beach area is much nicer and worth the walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the LaCabana on Eagle Beach. Beautiful views and miles of beach that you can walk. The water is so clear!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of the best beaches i have ever been to clear blue water, white sand, fofoti tree, and i felt very safe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful, amazing, super clean and white sand. I highly recommend it. It's a must go. I will definitely visit this beach again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long white sand beach. Sea water is blue and very warm. Just an amazing beach to spend the day relaxing and soaking in the beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A day at the beach is always a pleasure but most of all if it is a beach in aruba, pure clean water and amazing white sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful. I had a lovely time. The water felt like pool water. I cannot wait to go back and visit this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We was staying in Oranjestad so wanted to spend the day at eagle beach. It’s absolutely beautiful, the sand the clear water was amazing. We walked all the way along and back. We paid for sun loungers with a umbrella which cost 15 dollars each which I thought was quite expensive. Had a couple of drinks in passions and my husband popped down the road to the super market to have some food and drinks on the beach. Was a lovely but expensive trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Passions on the Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went to Passions last Friday at 6.00pm. It is a restaurant on the beach where you eat your meal at a table set on the sand on Eagle Beach. We ate and watched the sun set over the sea which was beautiful. The area is lit by flame torch lights and lights around the surrounding trees. There was a saxophonist playing soft music in the background. The food was good and it was an unforgettable experience. Would recommend a visit

reviews.title: Happy Place
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with the perfect blue waters of the Caribbean. This is the best beach in Aruba to walk, if you’re into that kind of thing. Walk it just before sunset, memorable believe me. At one end you’ll find Divi beach with the beach bar holding it all together. On the other end you’ll find the two most photographed trees in the island. Your choice two miles of sand white beaches to make you forgot why your walking 4 miles on vacation.

reviews.title: Over rated
reviews.text: We chose that beach according to the Tripadvisor # 7 ranking among the best beaches over the world. I must tell my disappointment as I expected more and much different. Of course there is no question, this is a beautiful beach, very close to Oranjestad, a nice and long beach with beautiful waters and quite safe bathing despite the vendor's jet-skis that make noisy demo too close to the supposedly safe protected swimming areas.Beaches in Aruba are public like in many Caribbean islands, free access and there are some straw jacals that are state owned and you can hide under from the sun free of charge. But thee are not too many, then they get occupied very early by locals who know the game. AND the water is nice but not cristal clear beaucause of the small waves that stir the sand blurred.A large boulevard runs along the beach with lot of hotels and vacation residencies on the other side, but nothing really enjoyable not fancy, just tourism industry.And worst are the loungers and umbrellas prices, because of the beach fame. loundgers are $10 per person but not guarantied under a thatch roof. And if you need an umbrella they can fix it for you for $35! only!Last point, if you want a high grade beach I would recommand for instance Jollly Beach in Antigua, Grande Anse beach at Deshaies in Guadeloupe or also all the beaches along the North side of la Pointe des Châteaux, or even Sainte Anne beach in Martinique, or the absolutely gorgeous Yachtsman 1 mile long beach on Nevis island, or in Europe some wonderful beaches such as La Baule-Pornichet beach, a more than 5 miles beach along the very safe half moon bay improperly called Baie de la Baule which actual name is Baie du Pouliguen according to the Atlas maps or Google Maps.

reviews.title: Beautiful sandy beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach, powdery, wide so more spacious than a lot of beaches we have been on during our Caribbean cruise. You can get here from the cruise port easily by taxi fixed at $15 each way unless carrying it seems more than 3 passengers then 5 bucks a head. The sea is beautiful and it is a sandy walk out through the waves. Biggest downside of the beach is the rip off price for sun beds and an umbrella $50 for a day package! …and there’s a limited number of them so can be sold out early in high season.

reviews.title: What more can we ask
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is a beach with white sand and calm sea. It is there, more precisely at the northern tip of the beach, that I found the Fofoti trees, which are a postcard of Aruba. It is a species that feeds on sea water and has a unique shape, shaped by the breeze of the sea.The Eagle Beach sand strip in Aruba is wide. I visited Eagle Beach on a weekday in November when the tranquility prevailed.In addition to the amazing beach, it has: Natural Beauty: Thin white sand, calm and crystal clear water, ideal for families and swimming.Tranquility: More relaxing and enjoy the moment.Infrastructure: Clean bathrooms, showers, fresh water dispensers, children's parks and beach restaurants/bars.Security: Feeling safe to leave belongings while if nothing.What more can we ask

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: So clean, not path at all and the view is just beautiful, can’t complain about this place that I’d consider the paradise in the earth.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world
reviews.text: If you have ever visited Aruba you have heard of Eagle Beach.  The sand is perfect crushed shells that’s soft and never burns your feet. The ocean is beautiful and a perfect temperature consistently averaging mid 70s to 80 degrees Fahrenheit. If you are going to the public beach there is ample parking just get there by 9am. The palapas are free to use. Hopefully your resort air b&b or resort has chairs. If not you can rent them there.  The sunset is breathtaking and if you are super lucky there is a green flash just as the sunsets.  Mind the pelicans dive bombing.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach
reviews.text: The beach is very clean and easy to access. Water and waves made for a great time. Park at the north end of the beach (if available)

reviews.title: Rubbish not sure what hype is
reviews.text: Lovely white sand and sea but to spend the day here there is only one place to rent beds from and get drinks from which is Coco Loco beach bar - research that before you come and you’ll change your mind. Waste of a very expensive taxi (they rip you off)

reviews.title: Crowded, happening beach locale
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is located in the heart of Aruba’s west coast. It is flanked by hotels inland across the street. There are tiki huts for shelter from the sun. Beautiful beach and location!

reviews.title: Delicious beach at any time
reviews.text: What an absolutely amazing beach!!!Without a doubt that makes much judgment to the rankings it occupies.Public beach with various amenities such as bathrooms (always clean), fresh water dispensers (free), etc.Beach of fine white sand and clear turquoise blue water. There are some "resident" pelicans that make going to the beach even more funny and make the flashes fire 😀Also known for the divi divi trees that are an excellent shield from the burning sun that is felt there.Delicious beach! Matavilhosa! Linda!

reviews.title: Excellent beach. Busy, well organised, and ideal for families.
reviews.text: Eagle Beach fully earns its reputation.Taxi fares from the port are fixed and transparent at $15, which removes any uncertainty on arrival and sets a positive tone.The beach was busy when we arrived and all sun beds were already taken. Natural shade from the trees along the shoreline made a real difference and provided welcome cover from the heat.The sand is a standout feature. White, soft, and cool underfoot even in strong sun. Comfortable for children and for walking barefoot all day.Drinks are sensibly priced for a prime tourist location. Local beer costs around $6 a bottle, which feels fair compared to many Caribbean beaches.Jet skis add a fun option for those who want activity. $95 for two people or $85 solo for half an hour. Well run and genuinely enjoyable.The sea temperature is spot on. Cool and refreshing without feeling cold. Safe, calm, and suitable for families.The beach itself is free to use, which matters.A popular beach done well. Clean, accessible, well managed, and a great choice for a relaxed family day out.

reviews.title: Beautiful island beautiful people ❤️
reviews.text: Dolfi did an amazing job touring our group around the island. He has a great sense of humor and bubbly personality we really enjoyed him. I look forward to seeing him again on my next trip!.🥰

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but needs some cleaning up
reviews.text: We loved it here as far as swimming and amenities. Stayed by Coco Loco and rented chairs for $15 each.The beach needs some cleaning up which is typical in the Caribbean. Bottle caps and cigarette butts everywhere as well as other detrius. I saw no glass but was concerned about it so I kept my shoes on.

reviews.title: The best!
reviews.text: We highlight the good service of Jeandrick at breakfast and Mr. Pablo the Bellcaptain upon arrival and at the departure of the hotel are very friendly make us feel at home equally team housekeepping always smile and is always clean the hotel that good work thanks

reviews.title: Lovely beach ripoff priced
reviews.text: Lovely beach but jam packed with 3 cruise ships. Quite breezy but the worst thing was the total ripoff prices for 2 beds and umbrella today - US$50!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach, large with wonderful public waters .....of course it has sun loungers + umbrellas with 50$ if you go early you find shade and trees.There are toilets

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach, especially the stretch in front of Manchebo hotel, where you have enough space to swim and sunbathe. There is ample parking and you can get tasty snacks and drinks at Cocoloco.

reviews.title: Dream Eagle Beach
reviews.text: For my taste the most beautiful beach! We stayed at Eagle Beach Resort one and a half blocks from the beach. It is a busy beach where you can request to be approached for lunch. The palapas are free, only the restrooms have to pay them as in the other beaches, we for staying in the Eagle had the access to the restrooms at no cost. Of course it is styled to tip at all times to those who provide a service. Beautiful for bathing and walking. Unmissable!

reviews.title: Beautiful white sandy beach, for water activities a must do!
reviews.text: Beautiful white sandy beach, very wide!Plenty to do in terms of water sports, but loses out to the less crowded beaches that have more charm.The fofoti trees were not really to be admired because bathers were under and on them.

reviews.title: Amazing Aruba
reviews.text: Look at the color of this happy island sea. It's stunning.And I who am from Salvador and thought that I would not find more beautiful sea... I was able to get enchanted with the turquoise sea of the Caribbean Arubano.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Really that the beach leaves you speechless, worth its assessment as one of the best beaches in the world. White sand, beautiful turquoise water and a spectacular sunset. I definitely want to go back.

reviews.title: Best beach in Aruba.
reviews.text: Eagle Beach: Listed in 2025 by TripAdvisor as the second best beach in the Caribbean, and believe me, the recognition is fully deserved. The beach is wide, with white sand and crystal blue-turquoise waters, ideal for swimming and relaxing. A unique detail are the famous fofofoti trees that, twisted by the wind, have become an iconic symbol of Aruba and give a special charm to the landscape. The only thing to consider is that the cost of renting chairs and umbrellas can be high; in my case I preferred to enjoy sitting directly on the soft sand when I was not on the water. Undoubtedly, a must-see place for those looking for a true Caribbean paradise.

reviews.title: Of the best
reviews.text: Extensive beach, with plenty of place for everyone. Quiet and safe Mood. Good beach to relax on. Calm sea. Places to eat and drink something very good.

reviews.title: Single waters
reviews.text: The charm, mainly happens by the color of the water, but I like to highlight the cleanliness, how tidy it is.Also warm water, ideal temperature

reviews.title: ideal for family trips
reviews.text: The best beach on the island. It really is beautiful the quality of the water, the beach is wide and has different services offer you drinks and meals from chringuitos and nearby restaurants, there are public palapas and you can also rent there restroom and umbrellas, it really was the best

reviews.title: Stunning beach
reviews.text: Maybe the most acclaimed and known beach in Aruba. It as a lot of wind, maybe because of its size and length. If you visit Aruba, eagle beach  is mandatory. White sand, clear blue water. Because of the size, even if crowded you wont have that feeling of an over crowded beach.

reviews.title: Awesome beach in Aruba for palapa lounging and swimming.
reviews.text: Perfect beach in Aruba for lounging, swimming, picture taking. I'm sure every adjective of wonderful has been used to describe this stretch of powdery, white sand beach in Aruba. That is how great it is, we spent 3 hours under a palapa renting lounge chairs from Amsterdam Hotel for $15/person all day. The beach stretches more than a mile with the same fine sand which under a sunny, blue sky gives the clear water a dreamy emerald blue color.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach
reviews.text: We took the bus from the port to this beach during our cruise stop to Aruba. It did not disappoint. The beach is one of the most beautiful we've ever seen. The sand was white, super soft and the beach pristine. The water was crystal clear, and markings were present, creating a safety barrier between swimmers and those making use of watercraft. Chairs and umbrellas can be rented for a nominal fee. We really enjoyed about 3 hours here.

reviews.title: Of the best I've seen and seen many
reviews.text: One of the best beaches I've ever been and I've really been to many.That day there was a bit of wind but the white sand and that green sea served to leave you relaxed and take a spectacular swim in the best company.Chiringo near with beer with super friendly people as always and the sumum.I recommend it 100% if you come through Aruba... it's miles and miles of beach with 100 parking spots 20 meters and no problems.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach. Water is clear, clean and warm   and lovely sand. Not too crowded either, plenty of space to enjoy. I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Beautiful and very long beach with white sand and clear water, ventilated, uncrowded, must-see

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text: I SIMPLY ENJOYED MY ENTIRE STAY!!! THE PEOPLE HERE ARE ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL!I WILL DEFINITELY BE RETURNING TO THIS BEAUTIFUL PART OF THE WORLD!!!!

reviews.title: Eagle beach Aruba
reviews.text: We visited Eagle beach as our first stop on carnival cruise ABC tour. We took a taxi for about $5 a person near passion restaurant. The beach is a public beach. We purchased 4 chairs and umbrella for about $60. Beautiful beach! Only one complaint , sewers smell was overwhelming . Beach was clean and beautiful. Took taxi cab back to cruise ship for about $5 per person. Then back on ship changed and ate . Went back out as ship did not leave to 10pm . Did some shopping at luxury stores and sight seeing all within walking distance of ship. Great port stop.

reviews.title: Great meal
reviews.text: Amazing food, atmosphere and service.Able to spend time with family and watch a great sunsetThank you Floyd and staff!

reviews.title: Cute but busy
reviews.text: It is one of the most recognized and sought after beaches in Aruba. With its famous Fofoti tree, and waterfront hotels, it usually fills with tourists and that makes it unattractive to my taste. The beach is beautiful, but as I said, somewhat busy.

reviews.title: This is Paradise, Hun.
reviews.text: We recently stayed in Aruba across the street from Eagle Beach - rated as one of the top beaches IN THE WORLD!Our expectations were realistic when we visited. I mean I’ve seen best of lists (have you seen rewards shows lately - lame!) but this beach meets the praise. Beautiful! A few tips:Aruba is sunny. Like intense sun, son. They have huts you can grab but lemme tell you, bring an umbrella! I saw a few idiot HOOSIERS with their skin well on its way to lobster boil who did not get the pre-brief on the tropics. Come early if you want to grab a free hut or other shade. Not island time early…7 AM early. Bring snorkeling gear. On my first trip I swam next to a sea turtle!!!

reviews.title: I love Aruba specifically Eagle Beach , this is our second time and definitely not last
reviews.text: My children for the first time don’t aske me for stay in swimming pool of hotel , eagle beache the water is so clear and no waive so they are enjoying it

reviews.title: Be aware it is crowded
reviews.text: Super white sand and clear water! It is a beach dream! It is super crowded so make sure to pack chairs and an umbrella unless you want to pay 70 dollars for 2 chairs and an umbrella.

reviews.title: Best Beach in Aruba
reviews.text: Best beach I've ever been to. Very beautiful, crisp, clean water. Best beach in Aruba. Not at all crowded compared to some of the other beaches on the island

reviews.title: Unsure, be cautious.
reviews.text: My photographic equipment was stolen while I was swimming in Eagle Beach. I left my things under a palapa for a few minutes, as many do, and when I came back I was gone. I found the empty bag lying nearby.No surveillance, no lockers, no warnings. The beach is nice, but security is very low for a tourist destination of this level. Take precautions.

Eagle Beach is great it wasn't too crowded and there are nice permanent palapas. Not sure if it was because we were staying at a resort but the only cost to using the palapas was to tip an attendant to bring chairs over. There is also waitstaff who will bring food and drinks to you.My only complaint is the obnoxious attendant from Julio's Watersports who walks around the beach being very loud and acting too familiar with everyone. If they got rid of him it would perfect.

reviews.title: If you have to choose one, make it Eagle!!!
reviews.text: We visited Eagle Beach frequently during our stay in Aruba as it was the closest. It is an extensive and wide beach, with space to avoid crowding. Its waters can vary (depending on the weather and currents) from very transparent and calm to clear and somewhat more moved. It also has ample space for parking and a thoroughfare that pedestrians and cyclists use to travel its extension. The beach has palapas that, although free, must be reserved early, as they are occupied by the renters of restrooms (and this is not controlled by the authorities). Having been to this beach previously (in 2013) I would say that it is a shame to allow indiscriminate rental of jet skis: I know that many people enjoy this activity and it is okay, I just think that there should be greater control to limit the amount and thus take care of the beautiful landscape that characterizes Aruba.

reviews.title: One Happy Island
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. The most beautiful in Aruba. I deserve your award for the best beach in the Caribbean.We stayed in a condominium at the height of the JOIA Iberostar. There were free palapas and there were almost no people. A success.We saw turtles born and they went to sea along with the island protection initiative.Just don’t go to the Amsterdam hotel area and the fofofoti tree, at that height is the drain of a sewage lagoon is unbearable smell

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Stunning beach!!  Crystal clear water, great sand, clean, very spacious, etc and I am born and raised in Daytona Beach, FL

reviews.title: Pure Paradise – Eagle Beach is a Must-Visit in Aruba !
reviews.text: As a local living in the island of Aruba, I can confidently say that Eagle Beach is the best beach on the island – and that's saying a lot, considering how many beautiful beaches we have here ! My family and I come here regularly, especially on Sundays or whenever we feel like spending a relaxing day by the sea. It’s our go-to spot, and for good reason.Eagle Beach is incredibly spacious, so it’s easy to find your own quiet patch of sand, even on weekends. The beach stretches for miles with soft white sand, gentle turquoise waves, and that perfect Caribbean breeze that keeps things cool and comfortable all day long.One of the things I love most is that it's never too crowded, even when it’s busy. Whether you want to relax under a palapa, go for a swim, or enjoy a peaceful walk along the shore, there’s room for it all. Plus, there are great beach bars and restaurants nearby if you want to grab a bite or sip a cocktail with an ocean view.Don’t forget to check out the famous Fofoti trees, which are uniquely shaped by the wind and make for the most iconic photos in Aruba!Whether you're a visitor or a local like me, Eagle Beach is truly a slice of paradise. It’s the kind of place that makes you appreciate the simple joys of island life – sun, sea, sand, and family.Highly recommended – you haven’t truly experienced Aruba until you’ve spent time at Eagle Beach ! 🌴☀️🌊

reviews.title: The Best Beach!
reviews.text: Eagle Beach Aruba is breathtaking—soft white sand, clear waters, and unforgettable sunsets! The best beach of the world!!

reviews.title: One of the best in Carribean Islands
reviews.text: One of the best of Carribean Islands. Warm water, clean as cristal, long and nice walkside on the beach. Absolutely not to be missed!

reviews.title: Awesome week!
reviews.text: Great stay. So much fun and such nice employees of the resort. Pablo the Bell Captain was great upon arrival and when leaving.

reviews.title: DON'T MISS IT! They're gonna want to come back.
reviews.text: Undoubtedly one of Aruba’s most beautiful beaches, it’s the Caribbean’s No1.The sand, the color of the sea, the palapas, and the sunsets!!!! They are all that is right in the world!

reviews.title: Beach day
reviews.text: White sand, clear blue water. Great place to hang out. Plenty of activities to do if you’re into that or just sit on the beach and enjoy the sun.  One of my favorite beaches.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Love this beach clean and less busy than palm beach. Great place to hang out for the afternoon and see the amazing beach and water.

reviews.title: Complex, Island and weather, just perfect
reviews.text: The complex is really well-kept, clean, and recently updated. The service is great, and the units are fully equipped with everything you need. There’s a supermarket (Superfood) really close by — it’s well-stocked and has reasonable prices. Eagle Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches on the island. It feels super safe, and the best part is that the weather is pretty much perfect all year round — no hurricanes and no seaweed.

reviews.title: The best beach!
reviews.text: It is my favorite beach in Aruba! It is very quiet, super clean.We left everything on the beach and went to eat at the Superfood. The public toilets are spotless.

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: This is one of the nicest beaches we have ever been to, right up there with the best beaches in Hawaii!  Soft sand, warm, clear water, and beautiful views.  Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Great beach when the cruise ships aren’t visiting Aruba
reviews.text: Have gone to Aruba 50+ times over 27 years. Walking on a quiet, clean beach used to be magical.Eagle Beach is NOT what it used to be. The cruise industry has destroyed it; when there are ships are in it looks like Coney Island w people crowded along the shore, panting like dogs as the sun can be brutal. Not enough chairs to go around at a price that many families can’t or won’t pay. $50x4 for 2.5 hours is steep for many.   It’s sad to see middle aged, overweight tourists walking up and down the length of this great beach looking for their piece of ‘the number one beach in the Caribbean’.  One cruise ship limit/day would help.

reviews.title: One of the beast beaches in the Caribbean
reviews.text: This is a very beautiful beach and probably one of the best in the Caribbean.  The water is crystal clear, very calm, with no waves and white sand.  It is a long, wide beach and quiet with no loud music.  We visited from our cruise ship.  Cost of taxi was $15 flat rate and was a 10 minute drive to the beach.  That area of Eagle Beach is called Coco Loco.  Cost for 2 chairs and 1 umbrella was $50, which is not cheap and was not negotiable.  We got there at 8.45am and the beach quickly filled up, so it is important to get there early, as there were 2 cruise ships in port that day.  We left at 12.00 noon and by then the beach was packed.  Taxis were waiting, and very easy to pick up for the same return fare of $15 for the taxi.

reviews.title: The best beach
reviews.text: One of the nicest beaches of the world, hands down! White sand, turquoise waters. Just beautiful, and it's a long beach, it's huge. Space for all. You can rent chairs/umbrellas. But my friend and I brought our own beach chairs, cooler with snacks and drinks, and LOTS of sunscreen!!

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world!!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful and quiet beaches in the world; it is worth every minute.... perfect climate and ideal water temperature

reviews.title: Our requirements far exceeded
reviews.text: It's hard to write in 100 characters. All our requirements have been far exceeded. Everything worked as advertised. Digital workflows worked great. Friendliness and service excellent.

reviews.title: Hotel Eagke beach
reviews.text: I stayed at Eagle resort beach excellent location spectacular beach very good breakfast and very nice rooms

reviews.title: Deserved your beauty title worldwide!
reviews.text: How wonderful!!!. It's really shocking to get there and see the color of the sea, the sand, soft and white.  The incredibly exquisite water temperature.  Beautiful, large beach with calm waters.
100000% go.  Unbelievable scenery. Water is wow! Restaurants/bars/hotels all around. Free PALAPAS to lay under. But you play 10/ chair. Just go! Can ride 15/pp from cruise port!!  Very safe!

reviews.title: Ok beach with great service but loud Julio Activities guy all day
reviews.text: Staying at LaCabana Resort. Palapa (palm umbrella with table) are first come first served. Got up early to get nice close to water for relaxing day. Bar on the beach and food can be ordered to Palapa like "room service".  Chairs are free with LaCabana wrist band. Not sure of the hype....#1 Beach ?!?! Water was cold and not clear. (APRIL 2025) The activities hut was overly anxious and LOUD, selling his activities (jet ski, umbrellas (overpriced!!) & tours. It was cute at first but honestly annoying to hear his loud obnoxious rant all day long. If you want a nice quiet experience, steer clear of the Julio WaterSport Hut....sit far away, plenty of space on this beach! The beach is wonderful. La Cabana is close and their security is on top of it all. Wait staff is so happy to bring lunch etc. I just dont see the hype of #1 beach. Passions is a lovely restaurant so close to walk to. I love Palm Beach & High Rise area more. Younger crowd & more activity. Julio's rental is great but not quiet!! I love peaceful quiet beach experience hearing only wind through the palapa palm fronds. Xoxo Aruba!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: took the bus from the cruise port for $5 RTWe were able to get an umbrella and four chairs for $70 for the day from Julio's watersports (and they took a credit card)Bring water and sunscreen!

reviews.title: Nice but…
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but not sure what it’s rated one of the top beaches in the world. The company renting jet skis was whipping around d on them through the swimming area and came  uncomfortably close to us. We didn’t stay long.

reviews.title: A most beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with lots of clean, white sand and a long shoreline good for walking. Great people watching   Very popular beach offering a number of places to sit in the sun or the shade. You can rent lounge chairs. There are also a few fetched roof umbrellas that you can tuck under to escape the strong sun. The roped-off swimming area is somewhat small, and beyond that are quite a few jet skis and boats. It is no wonder that this is considered one of the best beaches in the Caribbean.

reviews.title: Beautiful white Caribbean beach with clean sand and clear water
reviews.text: We spent a day in Aruba as part of a cruise and took our rental car from GMAX on a beach hopping tour across the island. The last beach on our day trip was Eagle Beach, where we also enjoyed the sunset with a sundowner. We perceived both the beach, as well as the water and the seabed there as very clean. I pay close attention to seaweed or rocks in the water and on the beach, but here it was almost perfect. Also, there were not many people on the beach at that time, which is why I can not judge how populated the beach is during the day.We enjoyed our stay there anyway and can definitely recommend this beach

reviews.title: The best beach in the Caribbean - really?
reviews.text: Aruba is considered one of the Leeward Islands—here, a constant easterly trade wind blows year-round. The island's sewage treatment plant was built directly east of Eagle Beach. As a result, the northern part of the beach is constantly plagued by a sewer odor.

reviews.title: *Kilometers of white powdered sugar beach!*
reviews.text: Visited the beach within a booked tour for about 1.5 hours Unfortunately, it's way too short. The white sandy beach is very extensive and can get very hot underfoot. Had a place near the road, lots of shade under the trees. Liege +Umbrella would have cost 35$!!!! per person.Light swell; for the ideal swim there are better places, but still very worth seeing!

reviews.title: Over rated beach experience
reviews.text: Beautiful beach however not easy to find a place rent umbrella/lounger.  Most of beach areas are “owned” or claimed to be by the hotels and condos.  Barely any shady areas for people just visiting the beach.

reviews.title: Crystal clear waters
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is stunning!! My friend and I enjoyed the Joia Iberostar beach service. We ordered delicious Miami Vice virgin drinks and their kale salad was yummy and healthy. The snorkeling was just okay that day but I loved being in the crystal clear water!

reviews.title: Bella!
reviews.text: Definitely beautiful but for me not the most beautiful .. bring an umbrella and two chairs... minimum are 50 dollarsThe white sand is wonderful and long walks await you

reviews.title: Stunning Beach
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful beach.   You have to get there super early in the morning to claim a palapa, however there are plenty of shady areas under the trees a little further back from the water line.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach Overrated
reviews.text: The user who noted the sewage smell was dead on. It’s pretty annoying. We are at Eagle Beach off the only cruise ship in port today and it’s still super crowded. None of the insider tips we received about location helped. Hotel guests reserve chairs and palapas (umbrellas) early. If you aren’t in the first two rows, you may as well be across the street.The island is pretty for sure but Bimini and Grand Cayman beaches have Eagle Beach beat. We came to Eagle because it’s “one of the most beautiful beaches in the world” but I suspect a day pass at a resort on Palm Beach would be a much better option. Will let you know next year!

reviews.title: Natural pool
reviews.text: Clean beach, perfect natural pool to go relax one afternoon. There are huts 🛖 or caves formed by the same vegetation to camp from the sun at no cost. I recommend taking an icebox with drinks and snacks.Bonus track: mango balashi is spectacular🍺🥭

reviews.title: One not so friendly island!
reviews.text: The island is getting very crowded! Need to get to the beach early to claim a spot. Not such a friendly island any more, nearly hit by people on bikes on our walking path.

reviews.title: Sewage Smell Ruined our Vacation
reviews.text: The sewage smell on Eagle Beach is oppressive. We stayed at Amsterdam Manor the last day of our vacation, the smell was unbearable. One poor couple got married on the beach this evening and the smell was enough to make you feel sick to your stomach! We won't be back.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Wide and quiet beach, almost without waves.Spectacular sea colors.There's rent of chairs and umbrellas, somewhat high prices, but it's what's left if you don't have yours.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: This is one of our favorite beaches. It was easy to get to from the Blue Residences where we stayed, just a leisurely walk. Beautiful clean water, nice sand... What's not to like? Will be back for sure!

reviews.title: Next step to Heaven
reviews.text: Been to Aruba 34 times.  People ask me why...because it is beautiful.  The weather, the people, the food...it's about having a relaxing fun time.  Palm Beach is up the street and my wife and I always walk the beach. The turquoise water and clarity can't be beat. I ❤️ Aruba.   In may this will be our last time for awhile. On to italy.   Then to Bora Bora.  I don't know if I will ever have the time anywhere like Aruba...Heaven

reviews.title: Best beach
reviews.text: An amazing beach with a clear sand and a blue sea.Much better than Palm Beach as it is away from the crowd of people at the resort. It is a beach where you can sit and hear the noise of the sea without loud music and people screaming.

reviews.title: Eagle beach morning run
reviews.text: Kicked off the day with a morning run at Eagle Beach, and it couldn’t have been better. The soft white sand, the calm ocean breeze, and the sight of the Fofoti tree made every step feel special. There’s something incredible about running with such a breathtaking view, definitely a place worth experiencing!

reviews.title: Picture perfect beach!
reviews.text: This white sand beach with the palm trees and  clear water is picture perfect!  The beach was not as busy as some of the other beaches that excursions go to. It was clean and was such a relaxing  beach. It ranks as one of my favorite beaches ever!

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach I have been to!
reviews.text: White soft sand - that stays cool! Turquoise water, sea breeze, tiki huts. Does not get much better than this! Courteous attendants help locating a hut and getting you lounge chairs. Some people come down in the dark hours of the morning to nab the front huts. We have always got a hut no matter what time we come across to the beach.

reviews.title: Perfect beach
reviews.text: It's a perfect white sandy beach, soft, cold, clean and wide, free palapas, no street vendors, there's security, water sports and entertainment options, refreshing winds, there's nice tree shadows if you don't get palapas, the temperature and color of the water are ideal. It doesn't seem overcrowded the beach and there's no bustle.

reviews.title: Gorgeous Beach Destination
reviews.text: Fantastic beach.  One of the most beautiful we've ever visited.  Close to the cruise port, and free.  Water was perfect and beautiful blue.  Truly a breathtaking beach, and definitely worth the visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beach is clean, quiet and beautiful!  The water was clear and warm with mild waves.  Great beach for walking and swimming

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with beautiful, warm clear sea. We visited for a couple of hours as part of an island tour and would happily return.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach Aruba- one of the best beaches to visit
reviews.text: Eagle Beach never disappoints no matter which season I visit. Litereally winter spring summer or fall it is alway beautiful and the perfect temperature. The sand is always cool and the water crystal clear.

reviews.title: Fly high like an eagle
reviews.text: Ditto to the positive reviews about this being a great beach. A couple tips - the resort Las Cabanas has easy access clean bathrooms & Eduardo's which is a great spot for smoothies & bowls. It's right across the main drag from Eagle Beach. Eduardo's is not crazy expensive & we weren't staying at Las Cabanas, just happened upon the clean bathrooms. Also they have a water fountain 2 refill your bottles. If you happen to end up near "Passions On The Beach" they take a section of the beach over around 3p & start setting up for dinner service which happens right on Eagle Beach. So that can put a damper on your chill beach vibe when they start rolling in tables & chairs & a small army of staff people. I would've tried to score a palapa elsewhere had I known.

reviews.title: Great Public Beach
reviews.text: Amzing sandy beach with lots of room and never crowded. Away from the busy tourist area of Palm Beach, this beach offers free parking, personal watercraft rentals, and even sunset dining. Water is clear with no seawood but isn't shallow for very far, so younger swimmers have to stay close to shore.

reviews.title: Bellaa
reviews.text: This is the second time I come to Aruba, I like almost all the beaches, but the most touristy and considered the most beautiful in the world is Eagle beach. I recommend it because the water is crystal clear, the white sand brings out the color of the sea. The only flaw that the bars are only at the beginning or end of the beach km, the rest are things that are part of the resorts. If you don't want to spend millions, don't take the umbrella with the deckchair near the Coco loco, but go further ahead that prices are much more affordable.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach
reviews.text: Eagle Beach é ótima. Beach not very busy but with less infrastructure than Palm Beach. But it's charming, too. Only has stronger waves. But it's a beautiful beach

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach but Pricey
reviews.text: No doubt about it, this is a beautiful beach. The waves are gentle and sea breeze refreshing. My main gripe is that $50 for an umbrella and 2 chairs is way too expensive.  There is a little shade on the beach. I suggest you lay on a towel under one of the trees. It was still a good time.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach Aruba
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, great to walk, beautiful water.  Yes it is ver windy.  An umbrella is recommended.Safe, clean and not crowded.

reviews.title: Fun day at eagle beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with white fluffy sand and turquoise waters.  Chairs and umbrellas are available, but bring lots of cash as they are expensive. Short Cab ride from downtown.  Food and drinks are available and are a good value.

reviews.title: Beautiful 😍 🤩 👌
reviews.text: Thumbs up!!!! Prepare to enjoy a really nice beach with soft sand, the wave are perfect to keep you having fun on the water. The surrounding restaurants are literally at the beach, we had a great time, another place on my bucket list of places to enjoy in life....

reviews.title: Eagle Beach of the best beaches
reviews.text: It is the largest beach in Aruba, white sand, clear and blue sea, close to the most important areas, perfect for a relaxed day of beach listening to music, setting in the sun and lying on the sand. It has parking.

reviews.title: Overrated
reviews.text: You can access for free, and they lend you chairs to pass the challenge, the costs of food and drinks are quite high I would say the highest in Latin America, it is a beautiful beach, but I do not think it is the second most beautiful in the world.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach
reviews.text: It is the most beautiful beach in Aruba. The white sand and turquoise water is wonderful!Quiet beach with all services.

reviews.title: Magnificent
reviews.text: It is the best beach in Aruba, a thousand times more beautiful than Palm Beach and Arashi. It is very quiet, the water is beautiful and the sand is also.

reviews.title: It's a no from me
reviews.text: Don't bother. 55 dollars for an umbrella (ripped) and two sunbeds old saggy and ripped. You had to get them yourself from the stack and drag them to your spot. Very rude arrogant people

reviews.title: Went with family
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, great waters, and awesome snorkeling, highlight of all beaches, really would recommend.  Awesome trip.

reviews.title: There are better beaches in Aruba
reviews.text: We went to Eagle Beach with the expectation of a beautiful beach and it is definitely very nice. However, due to the large influx of people the place is dirty and people drinking more than they should. I do not recommend her to go with children much better are Baby Beach, Arachi and Surfside.

reviews.title: Beautiful crystal clear water & soft white sand!
reviews.text: Travel expert here & I was honored to spend new years day on Eagle Beach! Easy to get to from the cruise port.. lots of busses for $5 a person. Crystal clear water and beautiful soft white sand!! Fairly spacious so plenty of room on the beach & in the water! I could float here for days! Bring your sunscreen!!

reviews.title: Great beach.
reviews.text: Very pretty beach. Parking wasn't a problem at 11am. Can rent umbrella and chairs -but very expensive. Met someone who rented chairs and umbrella for week from coconut rentals and was very pleased.  Sun is very strong so need coverage. Water and sand lovely.

reviews.title: Great family photo spot!
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is always a great spot in Aruba to enjoy the sunset. Take family photos or just hang out by the beach during the day.

reviews.title: Float
reviews.text: Beautiful calm water beach with white sand. Best beach to just float on a donut float and relax. Most people are from the local resorts but beaches are open to the public in Aruba. If you get there later in the day you can use their lawn chair under a palapa that people leave behind. We were never pressured to rent a chair. People were relaxed but timing was not high season. There is a food hut 🛖 with great healthy affordable options and drinks🍹

reviews.title: Better beaches elsewhere
reviews.text: Super crowded on a Friday afternoon - there are definitely better beaches on Aruba. Lots of boats and jet skis buzzing around close to shore.

reviews.title: Better than Palm Beach
reviews.text: We visited Eagle Beach after disappointment at Palm Beach, which was too touristy and busy for us. Eagle Beach is home to the low rises, and they are actually across the road from the beach, so you don't have that chaos. The physical beach and water was similar at Eagle Beach, but Eagle Beach was so much more laid back and peaceful. It is a very long stretch of beach which is great for walks, and the sunsets are quite nice here.

reviews.title: Amazing beach
reviews.text: You MUST visit this magnificent beach.  My husband and I hunt for the most beautiful beaches in the world and we can say that this one ranks high.  the beach is more than spacious, white, crystalline sand. The endless turquoise sea.  There is no crowd, you can find a secluded place and enjoy.

reviews.title: Murky water, white sands, no shades, NOT the best beach in the world
reviews.text: Overrated in my opinion, but, not a bad beach, reminded me of South Miami Beach, but the sands are much whiter here.  It's a long strip of beach, no shades you can cool off.  The beach bed/bench is $60 all day and you do get an umbrella.  There is a public free shower place.  There is a public bathroom but we didn't use it, I read some reviews saying that it's $1 fee.  I also read that the sunset is one of the best, but I didn't experience it, had to leave early.  No big waves when we visited.  Clean beach and no one trying to sell you stuff.  Water was a little warm, but very murky, not pristine at all.  We snorkeled and found no fish, also not many seashells, so how could this be one of the "best beaches in the world"?

reviews.title: horrible experience- scam beach
reviews.text: Scam Beach- Not worth the hype. Beach is $50 for two chairs, waves were a bit high, and the restaurant is horrible. so expensive and a 45 minute wait for a quesadilla. save your money and skip.

reviews.title: Amazing beach and wonderful scenery, and some advice.
reviews.text: My experience was amazing and the sun was shining even in the winter, the water and beach was clean and beautiful. I would re apply every hour though because I am dark skinned myself but I still burned. Overall amazing 10/10 would recommend.

reviews.title: Aruba not worth it
reviews.text: Aruba is an island that is not worth visiting, it is very small, it has only 3 beaches, one of which is rocky and the others are full of people, without much appeal regarding a Miami beach. You have to fight for palapas, the sea is normal, I would go to Curacao 20 times more than there. To go to Palm Beach you have to be in the mega hotels, and anyway it is not very nice beach.

reviews.title: 50$ for a beach bed
reviews.text: Nice beach, wide and long. White sand and beautiful clear water. But... 50 $ for two cots and a screen?!?! That's against scams. We'll never come here again and, judging by the reactions of those around us, we're not the only ones. Afrader!

reviews.title: Pristine white sand beach....
reviews.text: Amazing beach and island Aruba. Rated as one of the best beaches in the world is indeed so true.... I loved Aruba very much!!

reviews.title: Take your own chairs and umbrellas!
reviews.text: As far as a beach goes, it was just okay. We were only there for a few hours on a cruise so we needed to rent a couple of chairs and umbrella. $50? Yeah, nope. We used our towels and soaked up the Vitamin D. The beach is clean though and the sand is soft. The waves can get a little rough at times so beware with littles. FYI: there’s only porta-potties for bathrooms. 🥴

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Only our second beach on island but if you’re a beach walker this is it. Activities offered jet skis. Snorkeling possible. A couple food options.

reviews.title: The Beautiful Eagle Beach in Aruba
reviews.text: The crystal clear waters and powdery white sands of Eagle Beach in Aruba, in itself insures you will long to return to Aruba... again and again. We're hooked, you will be too, save us a spot. Enjoy! E

reviews.title: Angry Beach Chair Attendant
reviews.text: Among the beaches we visited in Aruba this was the only bad one due to an overly aggressive, extremely rude beach chair attendant with some anger issues. He screamed at my wife for sitting on one of the many empty beach chairs while I went to the booth to pay for it. Apparently that was the incorrect protocol for beach chair rental here, it must be paid for before you select where you want to sit (?). With so many other beautiful beaches to visit and vendors who appreciate their customers, we cut this one short and moved on.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Awesome location,  breakfast package is a great value.  All staff extremely helpful.   Quick 5 min walk to Eagle Beach. Bell Captain Pablo Hoyos super efficient.

reviews.title: The best sunset
reviews.text: A wide and very nice beach...it was easy to get place to park...seeing the sunset on this beach is just spectacular

reviews.title: Beautiful eagle beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with great calm water and soft sand. Rental umbrellas and chairs available, along with a bar that serves food

reviews.title: Horrible Horrible Horrible Experience
reviews.text: These people need training and really should have been reported.  To the tourism Board of Aruba. Again it is my experience that white people get seen and respectable treatment than others. Horrible horrible horrible experience which has left me severely traumatized. Extremely disappointed and hurt by the level of service and treatment given, was an embarrassing experience that I cannot even fully express my way through. I was doubled charged for my room from my original booking and I had to leave without a full explanation or an account for the charges. Change your dollars to local these ppl take serious advantage use there money!!!!

reviews.title: Eagle Beach: Soft sands
reviews.text: It is Aruba's largest beach and very famous for its soft sand. It has infrastructure: shaded areas, a few tents and many options for the practice of water sports.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach experience
reviews.text: Eagle beach was beautiful . There was plenty to do whether you wanted to relax quietly or rent jet skis ! Plenty of shadeOptions as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful stop off on cruise
reviews.text: Gorgeous, clean beach. Great for sunbathing and swimming. There's some nice beach bars and you can rent a jet ski etc or pay to go on a speedboat/inflatable ride!

reviews.title: Awesome Beach and Axccomodations.
reviews.text: OMG, it's such a cool beach with all the accommodations one could expect.  Our first time here and there is everything: cabanas, recliners, wifi, electricity (after 4:30 pm), bathrooms, and a Bar/Grill.  We are in awe of this place and will be back.  No need to be crowded on the Marriott Aruba Surf Club Beach.  v/r, Dr. and Mrs. King.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: An amazing beach in Aruba to spend the day with the family with a beautiful sunset, you cannot miss it, we will surely return to enjoy it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and clear warm waters
reviews.text: Stunning beach, and my favourite on the island. It definitely lives up to its reputation of one of the best in the Caribbean.  We caught the bus from Oranjestad where we were staying, which was an easy and cheap way to get there.  The beach is a great size, and it's easy to find a quiet spot to yourselves.  There ate plenty of options for water sports etc. Definitely recommend a visit.

reviews.title: Great Beach if you know where to go.
reviews.text: Great beach if you choose where to go. Large stretches have hotels on them spoiling it. However there are still some areas with no hotels which are much nicer. We found a lovely stretch with virtually nobody on it. It tended to get busier after 1.pm but not too much. The sea was very safe to swim in.

reviews.title: Spectacular beach
reviews.text: We arrived on this island for our honeymoon, this beach is spectacular you can not explain it in words. It's the second day here and I don't want to leave. Super recommended , a crystal clear sea, white sand.... I've never seen better.

reviews.title: Relaxing Beach
reviews.text: This beach is nice and flat with no rocks. A couple of places to get lunch within walking distance. Would recommend going in the morning to put out your chairs.

reviews.title: Looking for the best beach
reviews.text: I have travelled twice to Aruba, this time as a couple. Unlike Palm Beach, Eagle offers wider, mostly natural beaches (I mean less commercial invasion). Top-rated contrasts between the sand and the different shades offered by the sea.The problem I find is that being all public, some are very much invaded by jet ski rentals (more in Palm than in eagle).

reviews.title: Excellent , paradise beaches
reviews.text: Beautiful, it is expensive to serve highchairs and umbrellas, us 35. Because it is not advisable to stay long on the beach, the sun burns!!

reviews.title: Stunning beach!
reviews.text: Eagle beach has not gained its reputation for nothing. We booked a hotel just by the beach and it was a great choice since me and my husband totally loved this beach!

reviews.title: The best beach for afternoon
reviews.text: The most popular beach because on this one you find all the condos and hotels. The sunset view is simply spectacular. Additional waves are low and almost zero

reviews.title: For a Relax Day
reviews.text: Excellent beach, one of my favorite beaches, very clean beautiful perfect for relaxing with family and friends.Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Over rated
reviews.text: So it’s great but over rated. I like it a little less busy. But the sand and sea are as goodas it gets. I prefer palm beach, but that’s just me and we splitting hairs. Aruba is a wonderful location for any beach holiday, and all the people are wonderful.

reviews.title: Eagle Resort- Amazing place
reviews.text: An amazing place, rooms are clean & spacious, staff is knowledgeable and very helpful. They make your stay so relaxing and comfortable, especially the front desk with Joenna, Melissa, Lucy & Ryan. Tony's outdoor restaurant convenient with very good food and service. Compliments to our servers Nieves & Carla & Michael the supervisor who are some of the finest on the island they are caring and attentive to all your needs. Mario the pool attendant was super also. Nelinda the reservations manager went out of her way to find us the perfect room along with her competent staff. We could not find any issues with the resort. They attempt to make you feel a part of the Eagle family. very reasonably priced.

reviews.title: The most incredible beach
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Aruba! We visited quite a few beaches and kept coming back to Eagle. By far the most beautiful, sand like flour, very gentle waves if any. Absolute perfection. VERY hot, so make sure you bring or get shade.

reviews.title: beautiful beach, nice clear water and white sands
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with some waves but not a lot.  Go early so you can grab a free palapas.  No bathrooms but plenty of restaurants nearby so you can use their restrooms.

reviews.title: Definitely worth the visit
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful! We got there early in the morning and rented chairs and an umbrella feet from the water. White sand is soft and water was pristine and refreshing. I understand why it's such a popular beach. Only disappointment is that the area we were at only had 1 bathroom for such a popular beach resulting in a 30 minute wait.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach!! Sunsets are breathtaking, water is beautiful, and the area has nice food and drinks. The fofoti trees are so unique too!

reviews.title: Paradis
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It was unfortunately cloudy but still nice. Nice and warm water. We will be back.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Incredible beach with beautiful sand. We were surprised that the water was quite cool even on a 90 degree day. We did this beach break on an excursion after an island tour. We give the beach a 5, we give Royal Caribbean a 0 for their crappy and less than acceptable beach chairs that your customers have to drag across the beach and set up themselves.

reviews.title: Friendlies Beach In Aruba
reviews.text: The main reason my wife and I love this beach is because it is amazing for swimming, for us it is perfect.  Also, it is not as commercialized as some other beaches like Palm Beach, but you can get there by car in 5 minutes. On Eagle Beach you can have your privacy or socialize as much as you want, everyone is friendly.

reviews.title: Love Eagle Beach!
reviews.text: Friends week at Paradise Villas with the beautiful Eagle Beach across the street. Beautiful white sand and blue clean water. Couldn’t ask for more!

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: A very nice beach. Busy on cruise days and very windy in August but still highly recommend. Beach chairs can be rented and there are plenty of places to eat.

reviews.title: Don't believe the hype.  Consider going elsewhere.
reviews.text: Pleasant beach, but there are better.  No idea how it got it's high rating.Poor facilities.Exorbitantly priced loungers and umbrellas.  $50 for 2 rusty loungers and an umbrella.  These guys are blatantly ripping you off.Very windy the day we went, felt like you were getting sand blasted.Not too much to look at if you are wanting the day snorkelling.The immediate area along the road behind the beach looked shabby.Wish we'd have gone elsewhere.

reviews.title: Eagle beach is truly spectacular
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is truly spectacular, living up to its reputation as one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The sand is incredibly soft, and because it's made of coral rather than rocks, it doesn’t heat up under the sun—meaning you can walk barefoot without worrying about burning your feet. The water is a stunning aquamarine, crystal-clear, and free from algae or jellyfish. It’s perfect for snorkeling with kids, as the calm, wave-free waters are safe and filled with tiny fish. The water is also pleasantly lukewarm, making it ideal for a relaxing swim.As for amenities, the beach offers free umbrellas, though these are often claimed by early risers around 6 a.m. However, there’s no need to worry if you miss out—private companies along the coast rent out umbrellas and recliners. The coastline is also dotted with various restaurant options. I highly recommend *Passions on the Beach*, a must-visit spot. While it’s on the pricier side and even hosts the occasional beach wedding, the live music and excellent food make it worth the splurge. For a special meal with your toes in the sand, you’ll need to book a table about three days in advance, but even the walk-in tables offer the same breathtaking views of Eagle Beach.Another great feature is the free parking available in the beach area, making it convenient to spend the day here without extra hassle. Overall, Eagle Beach offers a perfect mix of natural beauty and convenient amenities, making it an ideal destination for families, couples, or anyone looking to enjoy one of the best beaches in the world.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and tip in General de Cartagena
reviews.text: Very nice hotel and tour. Just beware of those who work there want to put you consumption that you did not take and in the port from where the boat leaves; beware of those boaters who are scammers and use the modus operandi of selling you tours through the free and when they are going to charge you they want to carry thousands of Colombian pesos and threatening you knowing that the authorities will do nothing. Cartagena is cute, but take tours with operators from your hotel. That's safer.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach!
reviews.text: The views were amazing! We stayed at the LA Cabana on Eagle Beach and it was a walk across the street for us. The most beautiful beach I've ever seen in person.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: The beach itself is beautiful but the day we went it was extremely windy and that was not enjoyable because of the amount of blowing sand so not sure if that is an everyday occurrence or not. Lots of water sports to choose from if desired.  The beachside bar is good for snacks and beverages.

reviews.title: Eagle beach
reviews.text: This beach is amazing!!!! Very big beach so you can find a quiet spot away from the crowds - we rented chairs, umbrella, and cooler for the week so we were able to sit right by the water - if you sit next to the water be ready for strong wind gusts. Not a snorkeling spot but crystal clear water!

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Beautiful and calm blue water, clean and safe beach, powdery white sand, free palapas on our section (place chairs by 7:00 AM to be sure you get one!), short walks to beach restaurants/bars, plenty of room for Spikeball and other beach/water games on our section of the beach near Oceania Residences. Loved it!

reviews.title: Beautiful and serene
reviews.text: I'm from Florida so I know beaches. What a beautiful, fantastic stretch of white sand and cool water. Several hotels dot the area. Stay at one and enjoy this world class beach.

reviews.title: Best beach of Aruba
reviews.text: Eagle Beach has been rated as one of the best beaches in the world and a top beach in the Caribbean time and time again. This pristine long stretch of beach with soft white sands and aqua blue waters features a variety of water sports and some palapas. Eagle Beach is a favorite among locals and tourists and is located in front of the low-rise hotels.

reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text: White sand, crystal clear water, the perfect description of the Caribbean Sea. Worth a visit, busy beach but free parking in Aruba

reviews.title: The best beach.
reviews.text: We had the possibility to tour the whole island and its beaches. The first place is shared with Baby Beach. Eagle Beach is beautiful, full of fish and many activities to do. We never missed a place to sit, there was always a palapa (as the umbrella is called here) available. Best beach I ever knew.

reviews.title: Wonderful Beach
reviews.text: Just LOVE Eagle Beach!!!  The beach is so beautiful and the area is so clean.  The Tiki Huts are just awesome to have some shade, but can get plenty sun if you like.

reviews.title: Wordless
reviews.text: What a beach! Crystal clear, ample water, white sand to spend a beautiful family time, you can do water sports, sunbathe or walk.

reviews.title: Stunning! Right out of a travel magazine.
reviews.text: The water is absolutely stunning! You've stepped right into a dream. The sand is white, so it stays cool under your feet. There is always a breeze in Aruba, which is nice because it cools you off without the sand blowing. I do recommend towel clips! Water clear and great for swimming, but not much snorkeling. Definitely a relax, read and swim type of beach. Plan to arrive before 10am if you want a good parking spot and under one of the free public thatched umbrellas (palapas) as they are first come, first serve. Otherwise, there are ample umbrellas/beach lounges for rent. Parking is free. Probably best to avoid cruise ship arrival days if you want fewer crowds.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, white sand. The water so clear and calm. For snorkeling not much. They have water sport too. Jet ski, boating.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach at sunset
reviews.text: Busy beach, but we came later in the day and many were leaving.  Bar with food, drinks and bathrooms nearby.  Sand is amazingly soft with clear water.  No water shoes needed. Enjoyed the beautiful sunset and saw baby turtles hatch (random event).  There is a group of volunteers who watch the roped off areas. We happened to be in the right place at the right time.

reviews.title: Extensive and beautiful
reviews.text: Far the largest beach in Aruba, is extensive, has palapas and the water is crystal clear, you can see Silver fish, very beautiful

reviews.title: Beach with calm and crystal clear waters
reviews.text: It's a really beautiful beach. Calm waters, transparent sea, warm water. It is quite quiet compared to Palm Beach, where most resorts are located, since Eagle is a 30-minute walk south of Palm and downtown. So the decision about which area to stay will depend on whether you are looking for more tranquility or being closer to the center to go for a walk or enjoy bars and restaurants that I must say are very expensive

reviews.title: Not “2nd best beach in the world” worthy
reviews.text: Not sure how it got the 2nd best beach in the world title but if that’s why you’re coming, you’ll be disappointed. I mean, it’s pretty, but that’s about it.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach we’ve been to!
reviews.text: What a beautiful beach! We also checked out tres trapi, Boca Catalina, baby beach and Mangel Halto. The beaches in Aruba are stellar! We didn’t like the rocky bottom at MH but all others were awesome!     At Eagle Beach especially the ocean and beach were so beautiful hardly anyone was at the pool, which we’d never seen before in other places the pool is always packed. Aruba’s  Beaches are more beautiful than Oahu or Kauai imo and Mexico’s (playa mujeres or Cancun) beaches are no comparison to  Hawaii or Aruba. Aruba water is shallow, warm and waves much less aggressive than we’ve ever seen.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: It is a beautiful beach with its white sand and turquoise water.  We did a little snorkeling and saw some nice fish. The water was just right.

reviews.title: Beautiful BUT be careful
reviews.text: It's beautiful here! Definitely worth a visit - BUT be careful! Our bag was stolen there - so it's best to leave all valuables in the car!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, with services to eat and drink. Rental of umbrellas and chairs. Water sports are not offered out of respect for marine fauna.  You may be lucky to find turtles swimming next to you. Follow the recommendations if you come across them.  It is the southernmost beach on the island, I hope the hotel complex under construction does not ruin it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches on the island. Quite wide.  With aquatic services, rental of chairs and umbrellas. Drink and food purchase points.

reviews.title: Perfect Beach in Aruba
reviews.text: Nice public/free beach not far from the Cruise terminal. The water was perfect, the beach was rather clean and seemed safe, the sand never got too hot. Was a great beach to just hang out and drink and catch some sun.

reviews.title: Beautiful Caribbean Blues
reviews.text: This is the most amazing beach in the world. Long expanse of white sand which allows it to never feel crowded. The idyllic water which displays three dominant colors of blue will simply take your breath away

reviews.title: Excellent tour guides! Very exciting tour and experience!
reviews.text: Jersey and Carlos were THE BEST! Funny, happy, entertaining, thorough, and grateful. Lots of history in his talks. And they changed a flat in only moments. Experienced and polite. We enjoyed our tour very much.

reviews.title: My Favorite Beach
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in the Caribbean, No Seaweed!!! Calm waters, long beautiful walks on white sand with gorgeous sunset views. We alway stay at the Oceania Residences right across the street.

reviews.title: Nice walking boardwalk/path
reviews.text: Calm waters with no seaweed. Not very many dining options on the water. Gorgeous sunset and safe relaxed atmosphere. Will be visiting again.

reviews.title: Fantastic Beach
reviews.text: Eagle Beach had the softest sand and was beautiful.  The water was three or four different shades of blues and turquoise each day. Since it is on the low rise side of the island, it was peaceful and relaxing. However, when the waves kicked up, it was fun to bounce around in them. Valuable lessons - bring an insulated cup for your drinks (everything gets warm quick) and get yourself a pool noodle to float in the water. We will definitely return.

reviews.title: Perfect beach day.
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful.  The beach is clean, the water is clear. No water shoes needed. There are chairs and umbrellas for rent.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches and it wasn’t crowded. We went on a Saturday afternoon. Sand was so soft, beautiful water and a quiet beach.

reviews.title: Bring your sunglasses!
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach to catch a lot of sun and play. Take the time to walk the  entire beach! Go on a jet ski and visit other beaches and resorts.

reviews.title: La Cabana resort....the beach with lounge chair avalability.
reviews.text: When you get off the cruise ship and take a taxi to Eagle Beach they will typically drop you off at Cocoa Beach Bar area. All the cruise passengers are typically directed to this beach by the  taxi drivers. Once you get there, there are no chairs or umbrellas available. Best to go down to La Cabana Beach across from that hotel there were plenty of chairs available at 11:00 when we arrived

reviews.title: Stunning beach one of the best in the Caribbean
reviews.text: Second time on Eagle it’s worth the effort. Top tip stay up near the Fofoti trees there’s not much to see past there. The water is crystal clear & a beautiful hues of blue as you’d expect in the Caribbean. We’re glad we’ve been however were surprised by the lack of facilities.

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: We went to this beach 5 times during our stay in Aruba. It is the 2nd most beautiful beach on this earth according to many. It is very long. The sand is fine and pale. The water was a little cold, but it was also refreshing. The water was cloudy.

reviews.title: Lovely beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with nice calm waters. The people keep it clean and provide comfortable chaise lounges. I felt so comfortable that I fell asleep on the chaise lounge. And unlike other beaches I’ve been to, it wasn’t that crowded and you felt like you had enough room to enjoy the water and the land. Definitely recommend this beach to check out if you are in Aruba.

reviews.title: Family beach fun
reviews.text: By far the better beach vs Palm. Also better than Noord beaches. Quiet, wide sand area, clean, no seaweed water. Some wind & slightly strong waves but not too wild

reviews.title: Eagle beach how to get there
reviews.text: An excellent beach and easy to get to from cruise ship. Just walk around the back of the shops to the bus station. It is only $2.50 fare each and drops you at the beach in 15 mins.Beach chairs and umbrellas $20 for daySuperb swimming and water sports.

reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: What a beautiful place! It doesn't get any better than that. White sand, blue ocean. The best of the Caribbean sea. Also has a very nice structure and the famous trees

reviews.title: Crystal Clear Water!
reviews.text: Definitely one of the most beautiful beaches I’ve ever seen! This was our first port and it didn’t disappoint! The sand is soft and the water is clear! If your short on time like we were ask your taxi driver to take you to see the famous Divi tree! It was located on the other end of eagle beach.

reviews.title: The best beach on the island
reviews.text: The best beach on the island. A little breeze. The wind is a bit strong but it can be a very good experience. Don't forget to visit it

reviews.title: First time
reviews.text: Cute place... The food is delicious, the animators and vendors are nice, the programs are good... The beach and the pool are nice and clean, but unfortunately the rooms are the opposite... They could be cleaner...

reviews.title: Summary i like the place, and like more then the peoples.
reviews.text: We are here 10 days termin. The hotel is good, but the service team are the best. The animators, the managing director, the seesecrets guys, shisa, coctail boy. They supported our hollydays to perfect level. We see lot of see animals, dolphins, and many more. The eats are also realy good, and the evening programs are very interresting. So fully we has a very nice 10 days here, and i hope we’ll meet again. Weak point maybe the room vleankng and wifi, but that was forgetable. :)

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: Eagle beach was great! Clear and calm water and not crowded. If I were to rank the beaches it is Baby beach then Eagle. We went to Eagle beach most days because not only is it beautiful but close to our condo. The have water sports available and chair and umbrella rentals.

reviews.title: Stop busing cruise passengers
reviews.text: Still beautiful but cruise ship daytrippers are having an impact. On certain days buses dump enough cruise passengers to make it look like Coney Island. On a positive side we took 2 hour walks most days and enjoyed the beautiful waters.

reviews.title: Awesome Beach!!
reviews.text: During a recent cruise stop, we did a tour that ended up at Arashi Beach. It was too rocky so we asked the tour operator to take us t another beach and drop us off. That is how we ended up at Eagle Beach. It is minutes away from the port and such a beautiful beach! It is what I expected a beach in Aruba to look like. As soon as we got there we were greeted at the entrance by Juan Hernandez. He made sure we had seating and we also did some water sports through him.
