He was so helpful and sociable, everyone was shouting him out. The best art about this beach is that there was ample shaded areas to sit and relax. If you go to Eagle Beach, make sure you look for Juan!

reviews.title: Beautiful but does smell
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is gorgeous.  The sand is so soft and powdery.  The water is calm and clear. But…the sewage facility is near by.  It definitely stinks.  Paradise shouldn’t smell like poop.

reviews.title: Best beach in the Caribbean
reviews.text: I loved Aruba, Eagle Beach is one of its best beaches. Our hotel was on that beach. Super recommended!! Since it is a quiet, large beach I loved it!!

reviews.title: Aruba is amazing!
reviews.text: The Caribbean is unique! Aruba then, no comments needed - just going to find out! Take a tour around the entire island! It's so worth it!

reviews.title: If you like the smell of sewage, this beach is for you!
reviews.text: The beach itself is beautiful (blue calm water) with a lot of amenities. However, the beach smells like a sewer. It is a strong smell. It is not a top beach—no way.

reviews.title: Best Beach Experience in a Long Time
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach. Two chairs and an umbrella will run you $50 and only cash is accepted. It's well worth it. The bar was hopping and there was a party going strong in the middle of the day. It was Aruba's Flag Day, so maybe that's why the celebration was big on a Monday afternoon. I recommend this place for a day in the sun, the sand, and the ocean. The water was warm and calm.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach is a MUST!!!
reviews.text: The water was so clear!  The bottom of the ocean was all white sand. The colors of the ocean at Eagle Beach were amazing!!!  It’s hard to capture it in photos 🏖️🏝️🩱♥️. We rented an umbrella and two chairs for $50 (usd), no time limit. Beautiful being words.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is amazing! Beautiful white sand that stretches for miles! The water is crystal clear and views are breathtaking!

reviews.title: Wonderful experience, beautiful island, go to relax and have a good time
reviews.text: The happy island, beautiful, safe. To go as a family, with a partner or alone, beautiful beaches and beautiful places to take photos and admire

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Sunny, cool breeze, crystal clear water, powdery sand. Just like a movie! People were friendly. Beach was clean. Just the relaxing experience we were hoping for to get a break from the New England snow.

reviews.title: Enjoyable, beach day!
reviews.text: We took City bus to Eagle Beach. It’s an easy walk from the cruise port. We were on a carnival ship. This was our first time walking to the bus station and using it to go anywhere. This beach was one of the first stops. The sand is really soft here and we didn’t need water shoes. There is no racks when you’re walking in to the water although there is a pretty big drop off in the sand to get down from where your chairs are to the water the day we were there, the waves were strong And we still enjoyed the water but it helped to have a floaty to hang onto. The temperature of the water was wonderful in January and there was no seagrass. We rented a lounge chair for $10. There were also restaurants where you could order drinks or food although we did not partake in that. The bus stop is right next to one of the restaurants , and easy to find when you’re ready to go back to the port area. This was a really good day for a very reasonable price!

reviews.title: Excellent Beach - Close to Cruise Terminal
reviews.text: While cruising to Aruba, our group went to Eagle Beach. as it came highly recommended.Now, you may think, well everyone from the cruise will be here and the place will be packed. True, a lot of people from your cruise ship will be here but, the beach is huge. There is a lot of room to spread out.On the downside, umbrellas run out quickly (never understood this, don't you want to keep a big supply of umbrellas and make money?). So, if you don't get there early, you will have to camp under one of the trees that puts you not close to the water.Second down side, limited facilities. Two Port-o-potties and a single occupancy men's room and ladies room, do not facilities make.Overall, this is an excellent beach to go to from the cruise. Could use a little more but still worth the visit.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, but the sewer stink will ruin your day.
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in the Caribbean, bar none. However, they have a serious sewer issue here and it smells terrible. Aruba needs to step up and correct the over development and insufficient infrastructure. Its really an issue, not occasional, consistent.

reviews.title: Aruba beach
reviews.text: The beach kept going and going.   It was exceptionally clean. Plenty of restaurants nearby.   The water was beautiful and inviting.  The nearby bar was fun and active with an outside shower to wash the sand off.

reviews.title: Great time in ARUBA
reviews.text: Had a wonderful time in Aruba, Clean beaches, Very, Very friendly people. Great shopping district. Said my wife.$$$. The Beef we ate their was so much better that in the USA. No Added Hormones nor Antibiotics. I mean CLEAN beef.Awesome.

reviews.title: Loving today!
reviews.text: Loving Aruba Enjoying Eagle Beach. Just relaxing, gorgeous, one of the best beaches in Aruba. Bring your drinks, food and chairs.

reviews.title: Worth visit
reviews.text: Very nice beach to have long walks and collect shells. Not necessarily the quietest place to visit , music can get loud. Spectacular view

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: Nestled along the serene shores of Aruba lies the pristine paradise of Eagle Beach, a tranquil oasis that stands in stark contrast to the bustling energy of Palm Beach. Having experienced both, I can confidently attest to the incomparable beauty and serenity that Eagle Beach offers, making it a standout destination for those seeking peace and relaxation.Unlike its counterpart, Palm Beach, which is often crowded with noise and commotion, Eagle Beach exudes a sense of calm and tranquility. Here, the gentle waves lapping against the shore provide a soothing soundtrack, creating the perfect atmosphere for unwinding and rejuvenation.Moreover, the atmosphere at Eagle Beach is one of natural splendor and unspoiled beauty. With its pristine white sands and crystal-clear waters, it's easy to see why Eagle Beach consistently ranks among the top beaches in the world. Whether you're strolling along the shoreline, basking in the sun, or simply taking in the breathtaking views, every moment spent at Eagle Beach feels like a true escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life.Additionally, the ambiance at Eagle Beach is far more laid-back and peaceful compared to Palm Beach. Here, you won't find the crowds or noise that often accompany tourist-heavy areas, allowing for a more intimate and authentic beach experience.In conclusion, while both Palm Beach and Eagle Beach have their own unique charms, it is Eagle Beach that truly stands out as a haven of tranquility and natural beauty. For those seeking a peaceful retreat away from the crowds and noise, Eagle Beach is the perfect destination.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: One of the best beaches I've ever been to!!!There is always wind, but it is never bothersome. We spent very nice days in Aruba.

reviews.title: Aruba is now our family tradition
reviews.text: Already purchased our room for next January. Aruba is beautiful,  friendly, and adventurous,  with some of the finest dining. Beaches are georgious with soft, cool, white sand. The breeze keeps the feeling of humidity way down. No hairspray! Let the salt air give your hair the body and natural look it needs!  We felt very safe to explore the island. The residents and natives are the nicest people we've experienced anywhere. The beaches and resorts are first class!

reviews.title: One of the best in the world
reviews.text: Easy access.  Smooth beach for walking. Lots of activities.  Little choppy in the water when the pleasure boats zip by - but nothing objectionable.

reviews.title: Nice but massively overpriced
reviews.text: Visited for one afternoon from a cruise ship. Nice beach, strong current in sea but outrageous pricing of sun beds. Quoted $50 for two beds with one umbrella..then asked for one umbrella and one bed instead and quoted $40. (At coco loco beach ).Arrogant attitude of sun bed attendants was truly shocking and the greed of them is unbelievable. Grand Anse Beach in Grenada is much better at $30 for the same.No idea how this can be said to be the 2nd best beach of the carrier as clearly isn’t

reviews.title: Beautiful, picture perfect, clean
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. White powdery sand, crystal clear water. I did not try snorkelling here so cannot comment on wildlife. It is a long beach with a number of palapas. (Straw roof shelters). These are free for public use but if you want beach chairs, you need to bring your own or hire them from a beach attendant. We were charged $37 for 2 at 15:30pm. The sea was lovely and warm to swim in and the sand very clean. It was picture perfect and a very enjoyable place to swim

reviews.title: Beach day.
reviews.text: Definitely a happy island, We have so much fun every time we go It is my favorite in the Caribbean There is a lot to do every time I'm looking forward to going back every time highly recommend 🌴🌴🌴

reviews.title: Favorite beach
reviews.text: Favorite beach ever! Beautiful turquoise water, soft white sand, friendly people. Everyone claps as the sun disappears beneath a pastel sky. The weather was perfect every day, with comfortable temps and a constant warm breeze. Stayed across the street at Eagle Aruba, so chairs were provided and beach access is free. Needed lots of sun protection but not a mosquito around and almost no seaweed.

reviews.title: Definitely NOT  THE BEST BEACH
reviews.text: Not sure from where to begin… very disappointed. First time for Aruba and we had a different expectation about the water on here . We had a breze day but the water is nothing like clear just has the turquoise colour, the waves were quite big is an open long beach but expensive too . They  are charging $30 for umbrella & $10 for a sun-bed chair . Facilities are just in 2 places, where you can have a drink , use the toilets & showers . A beer price is $7 , taxi $7 pp one way . Not sure why is a number one best beaches in Aruba but not for us . Then we visit Palm beach too, please don’t go just if you are part of the hotels around , as you can’t rent a chair just if you are staying in the hotel . Best to spend your day probably is to go to a private Island 🏝️ like Palm Island , where the water is clear ,you can do snorkelling, see flamingo on the beach and have the best of what Aruba can offer .

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in Aruba
reviews.text: One of the best beaches in Aruba with crystal clear and calm water like a swimming pool. It has facilities for water sports and is well connected with public transport from the center of Oranjestad (5 dollars).

reviews.title: Cute but not the best.
reviews.text: It is a very nice beach, but I highly recommend Divi Bech and Manchebo Beach, they are less crowded and I found them much more beautiful.And if they have a car, baby beach is also very cute

reviews.title: Amazing sunsets
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, not too crowded, great place to take in a sunset. The nearby jet ski rental makes for an awful lot of noise, so not a 5-star experience. Pro-tip: people who live in the nearby condos donate extra beach chairs by placing them under the palapas early in the morning, free for anyone who may need one! At least, I can only assume they are giving away their Tommy Bahama chairs, because they certainly wouldn't be attempting to reserve a palapa for much later in the day, that would be an unbecoming display of entitlement…

reviews.title: Must see beach. You won’t regret it
reviews.text: Definitely visit this beach. Beautiful soft sand, wide beach. Great for a long walk. You can rent a lounge chair for $10 each for the day. Umbrella $35 (a little steep). Get there early enough and snag a palapa or under tree. The beach is clean and there are places to grab a drink or food if needed.

reviews.title: one happy island
reviews.text: You can dare to say that it is the quietest and safest place you can be in the world, it is like being in paradise, there are no street vendors interrupting your tranquility. It is the maximum

reviews.title: Great place to spend the day. I would recommend this beach to anyone who wants to enjoy a day in the sun.
reviews.text: Eagle beach is great for an individual or an entire family. The beach is clean and well maintained. We found the people on the beach to be very friendly. There are plenty of places close by for eating or you can bring your own food. It is a great place to spend the day relaxing or just having fun in the sun.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful. Very clean. Wide beach area. As we walked down the beach we noted very little , if any, seaweed or debris. This beach is rated the top beach in Aruba for good reason.

reviews.title: A unique day at the beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, its crystal clear water, its white sand, the comfort of not being bothered by vendors and being calm. Its sunsets, everything is spectacular.

reviews.title: one more beach, but with the best sunset
reviews.text: overrated beach. It is very pretty, yes, but it is not one of the best in the Caribbean. It is wide, the sand is clear, the water depending on the wind and the day (like everywhere) is more turquoise. I highlight that the landscape at sunset is one of the best I have seen in my life.

reviews.title: A beautiful wow
reviews.text: Beach 4.8 km from the terminal by taxi at a good price. Chairs at $20 for 2 and umbrella (which we didn't take) at $35. The water is magnificent and the beach is very long for those who like to walk. There is supposed to be wifi but we were never able to connect.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Very disappointed. Beach was very dirty. Chairs and umbrella rental $50.00.They were rusty and dirty. Not at all what we expected.

reviews.title: Bucuti & Tara - Closest thing to heaven on earth.
reviews.text: We stayed at the Bucuti & Tara resort in Eagle Beach - it was the epitome of luxury and hospitality without any pretentiousness.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Very good view nice beaches .. breezy and nice.Would love to visit this area soon.Recommendations to visit this place.

reviews.title: Excellent for swimming and sunset
reviews.text: Fine sand, clear water, pleasant waves and a breathtaking sunset. Certainly a must-visit for anyone in Aruba.

reviews.title: Eagle beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that was not over crowded at this time of year. Cool vibe! Easy to get to from most hotels. We had drinks at Passions beach bar.

reviews.title: Must See Beach in Aruba
reviews.text: Eagle Beach in Aruba is like stepping into a dream – soft, powdery sand, clear turquoise waters, and those iconic divi divi trees create a serene paradise. It's not just a beach; it's a genuine escape where time slows down, and every sunset feels like a masterpiece.

reviews.title: A movie beach
reviews.text: Eagle beach, like many other beaches in Aruba, is a movie set, a beach of fine white sand with a spectacular turquoise sea and where you can do many water activities.

reviews.title: An amazing beach!⛱️
reviews.text: It is a calm, relaxing beach this you would LOVE to go on! It's so quiet, [on most days] and it is fit for the whole family. I would go there any day!❤️

reviews.title: Wonderful Eagle Beach
reviews.text: wonderful landscape, sea water so blue and so beautiful that the photo doesn't do justice to reality. clean and very very safe beach.

reviews.title: That beach is the best to spend the day with beach umbrellas
reviews.text: Wide beaches and crystal clear sea.Free straw umbrellas. And you can rent pastries. That area is better to stay than Palm beach. Although spacious, 2 meters from the shore in Palm Beach theSeabed is decomposing..

reviews.title: Paradise on the Little Rock
reviews.text: Under appreciated and underrated. Despite being named as one of the world’s best beaches, many still miss enjoying it.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: I stayed at a hotel on Eagle Beach. A very beautiful beach, calm sea and not crowded. There are kiosks to sit at, but everything is paid (if your hotel is not facing the sea).

reviews.title: Residence of the most famous Fofoti Tree
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is one of the most famous beaches in Aruba because of the Fofoti Tree.I found it to be a beautiful beach, it wasn't crowded and there are kiosks for tourists.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Very good beach, the biggest attraction in the country is there due to the resort and movement it has. I don't like the beach, for me it's just walking around the urban area.

reviews.title: Eagle beach is changing...
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach that has up until now been a real haven for those who stay in Aruba.  It's still beautiful and worth a visit.  The fine white powdered sand and turquoise waters are rare jewels to behold!  It has been a quiet and peaceful area until recent years. Cruise ship buses are now bringing hordes of people at noon and dumping them onto Eagle beach all at once, right across from Oceania Resorts and MVC.  This, in addition to all of the new high rises, is changing the nature of the Aruba we have come to love.  I hope island politicians do what they can to protect this paradise before it is too late.

reviews.title: Best beach in Aruba, breathtaking and serene!
reviews.text: Breathtaking, beautiful serene beach, not too crowded, lovely crystal clean water, gentle waves, bring a water hammock float and just drift away, pure bliss! Beach bar nearby, chairs, and palapas available for shade (first come, first serve but some open up later in the day too). No noisy motorboats or constant watersports here.   No dumb rules, just enjoy the beach!

reviews.title: Commercial
reviews.text: You are only welcome here if you stay in the hotels on the beach. Beds cannot be rented if another guest shouts or is expensive. Very unwelcome feeling for locals or other guests.

reviews.title: Good option
reviews.text: It was the first beach we went to on the island and it is very beautiful, it is large, clean and its waters are excellent. Although I prefer other beaches.I recommend arriving early to have a good spot.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I spend my days on this beautiful beach. White sand and turquoise water. The beach is clean. You can lounge all day like I did or go jet skiing. The sunset is beautiful.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world
reviews.text: By far one of the best beaches in the world... spacious, generous parking space, coral sand, crystal clear waters... Divine

reviews.title: Very cute
reviews.text: We really liked this beach, the white sand, calm, not as rocky as Arashi beach. You can rent jet skis and boat rides, although we did not use them. Further ahead there is a very quiet beach that I loved.

reviews.title: What a paradise
reviews.text: We spent a few hours on this beach during a cruise stop. The colors of the sea are spectacular and the water is warm

reviews.title: Ocean was beautiful, some options for chairs/umbrellas, not so much for food
reviews.text: Aruba's beaches are beautiful no matter which one you pick. Amenities however are a big deal. Once dropped off by taxi from the cruise port across from Amsterdam Manor on Eagle beach we noticed there were some options, but we came in mid day and all the palapas in one area were all taken. We went to the area to our right and paid $50 US for the largest umbrella I've ever seen and chairs. So that was great! We didn't even mind the heavy price tag because a lot of people were turning their noses up to the high price and only five families were on this large swath of beach! The ocean in front of us was pretty empty which was great with us! We saw people with coolers, but they are tourists visiting on the island, not cruise ship tourists. Tough for us to bring food and drinks with us.Now the bad. There are no restrooms in this area (unless you eat/drink at the hotels across the street), no real restaurants unless you use the ones for the hotels there. If you went to the far end there was one bar area and that's where my husband found the drinks at a little red and green shack behind the straw palapas close to Amsterdam Manor. Their 4pm two for one local beer was great but otherwise expensive. This was the ONLY place that took cash everywhere else you must use you credit card.  We've been burnt by that before.ALSO NOTE: My husband and I decided to invest in a beach chair lock bag with combination lock to keep our valuables safe. Were we ever glad we did! We were in the ocean when we saw someone hovering over our chairs my husband swam and ran out of the ocean as fast as he could and scared him off. What if we had walked away on a beach walk and not had it. More than likely our valuables would have been gone if we didn't have that locked bag. The loose bag I brough only had sun lotions and books in it so no great loss but still. I understand you have to be careful no matter where you go, but my husband and I are big fans of a combination lock beach bag now!Next time we will be going to Palm beach or Arashi beah instead. Palm beach we now know has far more options although a little denser population on the beaches there are just better options for food and drinks, and their downtown area is just off that area, and from the youtube videos we saw after the fact would have been a better option for us. If you want a less crowded area Eagle beach would be fine for you, a lot of people still go to it, but I couldn't see  me spending a whole lot of time there since food options are limited.

reviews.title: Beautiful Caribbean Beach
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is one of the most enjoyable beaches in Aruba with a variety of recreational opportunities.  When we visited in February the weather was super nice and the waves were pretty calm.  Parking was relatively easy to find, and we walked on the beach one way and returned to the car by way of the paved path parallel to the beach.  Several resorts and pricey restaurants are located in the area.  The Fofoti trees on Eagle Beach are very photogenic, being permanently swayed towards the ocean by winds.  They make the perfect photo-op.  The beach is very wide with and very clean.  Eagle Beach offers beautiful Caribbean ocean views.

reviews.title: Waste of time
reviews.text: Looked forward to visiting what was touted one of best beaches in the world . Got better in UK . Yes blue sea white sand . Facilities poor bars poor would not waste time going again

reviews.title: Bad smell from sewage plant
reviews.text: It looks nice but unfortunately the smell was really bad several days in a row. After googling "sewage smell eagle beach", I learned there is a sewage plant nearby and it seems to have some problems. A shame that such a nice looking beach is spoiled by the smell.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach is Amazing and NOT crowded
reviews.text: Best beach experience. Not crowded and the palapa were free to visitors. As they advertised, the sand is white and soft and the water truly amazing. There were little fish swimming around us in the ocean.

reviews.title: Great day trip or excursion
reviews.text: Aruba was a cruise stop for us and after some research decided on Eagle Beach due to its beauty and location. We told a taxi the beach’s name and he dropped us off at Coco Loco Beach Bar where nearby we rented 4 chairs and 2 umbrellas for $100. Kinda pricey but we couldn’t provide our own so what ya gonna do. The beach is long and the sand is light beige. A lot like Destin, FL (but better) if you’re familiar with that area. The water is surprisingly so many beautiful shades of blue and very clean. Once in the water the sand felt almost like mud, which was kinda neat. Temp of the water was quite comfortable for Dec. We got drinks at Coco Loco and they had a bathroom for everyone to use. Overall great stop for a day.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever been to, although I also loved Baby Beach. A beach with a long stretch of white sand and several options of bars and hotels. Comparable to the northeast of Brazil, they are far superior to the beaches I saw in Europe. Only in the Caribbean and Brazil do we find this warm water and good bar options on the beaches. I was there in January 2017

reviews.title: Best beach on the island
reviews.text: One of the best beaches to visit the beach and sea is amazing. The only downfall is the high prices charged for beds and umbrellas

reviews.title: Great Beaches
reviews.text: We took a private tour to Eagle and Palm Beaches to enjoy the great beaches that Aruba has to offer.  Lots of low rise and high rise hotels along the way to satify everyones budget.  I think I liked the colourful Amsterdam Hotel the best.We then drove through Oranjestad and headed off to San Nicolsas to have a look at Baby Beach.  After spending 30 mins there we went back to San Nicholas to take pictures of the very colourful and beautiful wall murals that adorned many walls in the town.  Then it was back to Oranjestad.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach is beautiful, but bring cash!
reviews.text: Our cruise ship docked in Aruba for the day and after some shopping in the morning we decided to spend the afternoon at the beach. A few people recommended Eagle Beach, so we decided to check it out. My word of advice if you go is to bring a lot of cash. We rented chairs and an umbrella for $65. Umbrella and 2 chairs were $50, and each additional chair was $15. Renting an umbrella and chairs also gives you access to the bathroom and showers at Coco Loco bar. If you are going to be at the beach for any amount of time, I would suggest chairs and an umbrella. The shade is very limited. We took a taxi from the cruise port. It was $15 each way plus tip. Be aware it could be as much as $25 each way. It depends on the driver. You are definitely at their mercy on the way back to the ship. We enjoyed our afternoon but the beach is a bit rough so you will want to keep a really good eye on small children in and near the water. If I can answer any questions for you, please feel free to send me a message.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: A very nice beach, its landscapes and views are beautiful, however when I went there was a lot of current and it was difficult to swim with children, a very good place to do beach sports.

reviews.title: Mindblown
reviews.text: Absolutely stunning beach. The sunsets were incredible. We loved the rentable scooters and e-bikes along the beach as well!

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches
reviews.text: It was considered one of the most beautiful beaches in the worldIn fact, it is very beautiful, with white sand and clear waters.It's a much less crowded beach than Palm Beach, with less infrastructure, but it's worth visiting.I stayed in a condominium on this beach and it was worth it.

reviews.title: Aruba's most famous beach
reviews.text: Quiet beach, water a wonderful shade of blue, at this time it was cold, but with the hot sun it was great.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach: The Crown Jewel of the Caribbean!
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is the most expansive beach on the island boasting the softest sand and loads of amenities. We stay at the Costa Linda Beach Resort (Time Share) located at the widest point of the beach. The services are second to none and everything you want to do is close by. Facing the Caribbean to the right are jet skis, snorkeling, tubing, parasailing and more. All reasonably priced. It’s almost never crowded as most tourists end up in the high rise where all the big restaurants and shopping is done. But the low-rise? That’s where the magic is and Eagle Beach is the crown jewel. Spectacular views, the best photos and perfect sunsets! You have to experience it to really believe it!

reviews.title: Mama food truck!
reviews.text: This review is for Mamas food truck/ Truck di Mama and not the beach. The beach is great, sand, sun and sea. But, if you are there get to this food truck right across from Chalet de  Suisse. Get there early as they open at 11 and close when the food runs out, which it does. Portions, flavour, sauce, service all fantastic. We split a chicken, shrimp and fish platter, for one person it’s a good sized meal, we split it as we had been eating like crazy all vacation and were both satisfied with the quantity but super impressed with the quality. Shrimp was better than Zeerovers. Fish and chicken were healthy portions and seasoned with local flavours. The sauces are awesome!  The pink hot sauce (papaya I think) is the bomb. Definitely hit this place up. They aren’t on trip advisor but you can find some info I. The forums and on the google reviews.

reviews.title: Fourth time cruise stop
reviews.text: Our fourth time on a cruise stop in Aruba. The beach was just as we left it pre-covid. $15 cab from the cruise port. Beach is free but 2 chairs and umbrella was $50 all day. There was a steeper entry into the surf than I remember but if you walk the beach you can find an easy entry/exit spot. Maybe hurricane leftover. Nice sandy bottom, no seaweed.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach a bit more choppy than Palm Beach
reviews.text: Due to shaky weather mostly, not a fault of the beach I think, the waves were more choppy at Eagle Beach than they were at Palm Beach. But Palm Beach has a deeper (further away form the shore) sand shelf to break the waves than Eagle Beach.   Over a one week stay, we went to the beach 4 times, but the last time it was a lot smoother and easy to stand in the water without getting hit hard by a wave.  But getting a beach umbrella was easy at $25 for the day (or however long you stayed during the day) was reasonable.

reviews.title: The most beautiful in Aruba!!
reviews.text: This beach is a dream, one of the most beautiful in the Caribbean: white beach, crystal clear waters and absence of algae, thanks to the particular currents that wash the island! Those who go to this beach can choose tranquility by positioning themselves towards Manchebo and Divi, or they can try various water sports by approaching the Fofoti area.Beautiful!

reviews.title: Eagle beach, nice beach but I think it is very "inflated"
reviews.text: We were there on June 23, we stayed in a condominium 2 blocks from the beach. The area is pleasant although there are not many shops or rest compared to Palm Beach. Umbrellas can be used free of charge on the beach. A lot of wind, at times with sand flying that sometimes bothers a little. It is a very nice beach but the truth is, in my opinion, as I am lucky enough to see many beaches in the Caribbean, I think this one, like all of Aruba, is very well sold. This is a very expensive destination compared to others in the Caribbean and I think it is not worth what it costs, perhaps more than double that of other destinations.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Aruba
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach on the entire island! It is super extensive, white sand, turquoise water, super safe. You can leave your things without fear. They also have public straw umbrellas, which can be used free of charge and there is usually a place because there are few people. The best sunsets are seen from here. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Top 5 in the world
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, the most beautiful on the island and in the top 5 in the world, soft sand, like powder, remains cool in the sun, clean beach (except the few smokers who bury their cigarette butts in the sand)

reviews.title: The refreshing sand.
reviews.text: Many positive comments have already been written about this beach and without waste I think that having named it the best beach in the world is fair. I'm just going to mention something that I haven't read and that seems significant to me: Eagle Beach, Aruba has white sand that never gets warm; not even at noon. It is common to walk barefoot on the beach.

reviews.title: Beach erosion
reviews.text: Went to  Aruba in October, beach was totally eroded,dissapointed.stay at palm beach.Wish they would post current pictures.....beware!!

reviews.title: Great beach lousy services
reviews.text: Great beach with few amenities. I would have given it a 5 star review but the attitude of the chair rental guys and $55 dollars for ripped up  couple of chairs and an umbrella are the reason for the lesser review. This could be a real winner but they need to improve the customer service experience.

reviews.title: Congratulations!
reviews.text: A good hotel, good food, good service, very clean rooms, a hotel to return to and enjoy a little vacation. Thank you !

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This is a great beach. Sand is soft and water warm. It is a great place to stay for the day. Parking free. There is skidoo rentals for 80.00 for half hour. They also sell beach chairs. There is no shells or rocks in the water. Nice and smooth bottom.

reviews.title: Amazing and safe beach
reviews.text: Less glamorous than Palm Beach, it is a family beach, quiet and safe, but with all the beauty of Aruba's beaches. The calm sea with beautiful colors and the fine sand form a beautiful frame for the typical trees, the “fofoti”.As a Brazilian traveling alone, I really resisted leaving my things, including my wallet, passport and cell phone, unattended until I was in Eagle Beach. There, I really felt safe and swam for a long time away from my belongings, which remained untouched where I left them (which would certainly happen anywhere in Aruba).I listened to good music and really enjoyed the sea and the sun, but it was difficult to ignore the screams of “religious” in a microphone somewhere nearby, but we Brazilians also understood that.

reviews.title: people
reviews.text: very popular beach. super crowded, with nothing different. It has structure and is close to the resorts. Very calm water.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with plenty of space for everyone. Activities if you wish!Sunbeds & parasol.Beautiful sunset on the first floor!

reviews.title: Eagle Beach where memories are made❤️
reviews.text: 30+ years of staying at Amsterdam Manor Beach Resort on Eagle beach. My home away from home. Spectacular beach at an excellent resort. For many reasons it’s my happy place. If the opportunity presents itself come visit you’ll keep going back.❤️🌴

reviews.title: Beautiful beach and wonderful sea
reviews.text: A beautiful white sandy beach with a lovely cooling blue sea. It's super quiet. Here and there there are wicker parasols where you can sit, but you can also rent parasols and beds. Definitely recommended.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world
reviews.text: Best beach I've ever been to! Eagle Beach is an amazing beach with white sand, clear blue waters, and warm water swimming.

reviews.title: One of the pretties beaches we've been to in the Carribean
reviews.text: We stayed at Costa Linda right on Eagle Beach. Quite Expansive and clean w/ crystal clear water. We are usually pool types but this beach drew us everyday.

reviews.title: Great beach crappy chair and umbrella rentals
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! Not crowded. Easy taxi ride from the cruise port. The only issue we had was chair and umbrella rentals are OUTRAGEOUS… 50 bucks for 2 chairs and an umbrella and you can’t get 3 chairs it has to be 2 chairs per umbrella. The man selling was absolutely rude as well. Do yourself a favor and bring a blanket, there were shade trees that others were sitting under and didn’t have to pay for the umbrellas and chairs. There was a restroom at the little restaurant/bar at the beach but the line was really long.

reviews.title: Hard to find enough space to swim
reviews.text: Too many people along the shore and was very hard to find a space to swim.  Also the waterskis were very close to the swimmers

reviews.title: Strong Current
reviews.text: This is a popular cruise tourist beach.  Beware that the currents in Aruba are very strong, not just this beach but also others like Arashi also.  There was only one bathroom and the line took 20 minutes for women.  We only stayed one hour, which at first I thought would not be enough, but because the current was strong, it was enough for me.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach. Carry plenty of sun screens... and hydrate yourself often... avoid the midday sun

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with great views
reviews.text: This beautiful white sand beach offers amazing views, lots of space so you don't feel crowded and various bars etc to enjoy your day. Trees provide shade for free, the sun loungers and umbrellas cost a lot more. However, we spent a while just relaxing and people watching.

reviews.title: beautiful...water that is nice and warm...mostly calm/gentle waves
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, soft white sand, friendly helpers, and gorgeous sunsets. A great place to relax, read a book...not too commercial, not too crowded.

reviews.title: Sun& sea& sand 🌞🐢🐢🐢🇦🇼
reviews.text: I like Eagle Beach because it's perfect for tanning, white sand and the magical, calm emerald green water. But...Unfortunately there are too many annoying jet skis that make it difficult to take a picture yourself, jet skis everywhere.Street dogs also walked past a few times.In the afternoon Eagle Beach turns into a picnic area. The primitive ignorant people leave the rubbish there.

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: This is a very wonderful hotel with good food, there are toys for children, parties, there are water toys, and everyone who works in a hotel is very good.

reviews.title: Beautiful but not wow
reviews.text: Beautiful, long, equipped and worth experiencing and visiting at least once. If you stop here you could say that it is the best beach in Aruba but baby beach lagoon is even better. Overall a magical and beautiful beach.

reviews.title: Relaxation at its Best
reviews.text: Best beach in the World.  Even at home ( New York), I rather wait all year around to get here. The water is warm and clear most of the time and relaxing. The best Sundown picture Perfect you can have on a Portafolio or a phone screen.  It's unbelievable.

reviews.title: One of our favourite beaches
reviews.text: We love this beach for all that it is, calm blue waters excellent for swimming and soft white sand.  My wife and I go every year and we are never disappointed, the beach is certainly beautiful.  It can get busy but we always find a spot regardless of the time day.  Wether hotel/beach staff, other tourists or island residents we find people are respectful and mind their own business.  But we mostly love this beach because we can enjoy our vacation hassle-free of beach vendors and no one bothers us, we can socialize as much as we want or we can have our privacy, this is why we keep coming back to Eagle Beach.

reviews.title: Quiet and familiar plays
reviews.text: The beach is really very quiet. There are fewer people than in Palm Beach; however, it is necessary to pay for any chairs, umbrellas or related items. It's more of a family-friendly destination, although I feel like Aruba has become a family destination overall.

reviews.title: Nothing Special About this Beach
reviews.text: A nice beach but nothing special to make it stand out.  It was very crowded on the day we were there and a storm was rolling in (we did get to see a pretty impressive double rainbow).

reviews.title: Recommended
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, white sand and blue water. Often wonderfully quiet. There are chairs and umbrellas for rent

reviews.title: Service with a smile
reviews.text: A group of us had dinner at a restaurant called the Aquarius. We had the most spectacular waitress Adriana, and her team they went above and beyond it happened to be my birthday and they saying happy birthday to me as well. The meal was excellent I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Beauty from the beaches to the people
reviews.text: The most beautiful beech yet. The weather is amazing, the people are so inviting. Great shopping. The drinks are worth it ( no skimping in Aruba). No extra shots required !!

reviews.title: Awesome beach
reviews.text: This broad, long beach never seems crowded, with plenty of room for everyone.  A diversity of people are engaged in many activities.  It is a perfect beach for strolling along the water's edge, especially in the morning when the winds are not as strong.  Aruba does not allow individual vendors to walk along the beach and try and sell items, so the beach is hassle free.  There are a few kiosks with vendors for watersports. There seem to be fewer vendors for umbrellas now, so finding shade if you're a visitor is a challenge.  Some of the palapas are staked out before 7 am.  Come early if you want parking for a car. Areas for swimming are marked to exclude watercraft.  The beach slopes gradually into the water for easy entry, especially for kids.  Calm, clean water.  No big waves.  No seaweed.  Not much to see when snorkeling, though.  People of all ages from many different places enjoy this beach.  Everyone was respectful of the space of others.  Swimwear ranged from my g-string to some trendy thongs and cheeky bikinis, and all manner of styles for fun in the sun.  Good place to be yourself and enjoy your vacation.The summer brings much stronger winds.  A breeze of 20 to 30 kmh provides cooling, but when wind gusts reach 40 to 60 kmh it becomes unpleasant getting sandblasted.  At least the wind gusts are not constant.  The fine, powdery white sand doesn't get too hot.  Good to see loggerhead turtle nesting sites marked off and protected.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Wonderful, relaxing beach with calm water. Has ample parking and a few restaurants and bars on the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We went to Aruba on a Royal Caribbean cruise and visited this beach, it is one of the most beautiful beaches we have visited. While there we had lunch at a fast food restaurant Aruba Blue Beach bar and terrace, all very tasty. Back to the ship we take public transport, a mini van of those that pass by constantly.

reviews.title: We stayed in front of the beach, one of the best we saw in the Caribbean
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, ideal for walking, calmer than Palm Beach, beautiful and transparent water, there are the famous divi trees in Aruba, in my opinion the best next to Baby Beach

reviews.title: BEACH TIME
reviews.text: We stayed in resort directly across from the beach.  It was great.  Aruba owns all beaches and they are not private we were told.  Which is okay with me.  Get there early to get the chairs and palm umbrella.  They have people that will take drink and food orders. It was super crowded even the day 2 cruise ships arrived. .

reviews.title: Eagle beach is just WOW!!
reviews.text: Eagle beach is amazing!  Beautiful beach in Aruba, water is crystal clear.  There are beach chairs and umbrellas available to rent.

reviews.title: Beautiful pristine beach
reviews.text: What can I say this  beach is awesome.  Clear aqua water, talcum powder soft sand. (By the way you can’t take any home with you or shells or you will get a fine) enjoy the spotless clean area and walking looking at the fish. There are jet ski rentals available, and parasailing for the adventurous type.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach and cristal water
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach cristal water, perfect sand but a way too much off shore wind that with the sand doesn t make a very good combination.

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: Very nice but still a little crowded, The buses that we took from the island were very nice and not expensive.

reviews.title: White white sand, blue blue water
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand and turquoise water! Less crowded than the palm beach area and much quieter. Iconic Caribbean beach.

reviews.title: One Of the Most Beautiful
reviews.text: This is by far one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. If traveling to Aruba must check it out.

reviews.title: Stunning
reviews.text: One of the top rated beaches in the world!!Clean sandy with incredible shades of blue water.No better place to relax.

reviews.title: Eagle beach review
reviews.text: Stayed at an AirBnB very close to eagle beach. Very nice beach- beautiful water, fine sand and not too busy. Wife and I walked on the paved walkway near road in AM and hit the beach later in day.  Head south away from eagle and palm beach for even more seclusion.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE
reviews.text: It was a horrible experience, we spent close to $700 to go to this beach because we didn’t stay in the hotel, we were promised floats , snorkels and kayaks . We were given none of that all day , they had tons of floats in the back but the lazy worker refused to let us use just one . All of the cabanas were “booked” but there was literally no one over there . The managers name is Moon she is a disrespectful person . I highly recommend baby beach and not this one .

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is an absolutely beautiful beach.  One of my favorites in the Caribbean!  A must visit when in Aruba.

reviews.title: Beautiful but...
reviews.text: Arrived here via taxi from the carnival cruise port, 20 dollars..  dropped right at the beach by a beach bar, coco locoWalked onto a beautiful white sandy beach, we didn't hire beds as expensive for 4 of us but bought towels with us. The beach area was very busy, someone us on the sand, some hired bedsSea was gorgeous colour so had a dip and a swim about, again very busyWe then walked to the left towards the ports, the further you walk the quieter the beach, wish we'd headed that direction from the start! We took snorkels with us but not a good snorkeling beachFree WiFi by the beach bar!Taxi back sfter 2 hours sun, too hot and no shade for any longer!

reviews.title: Eagle Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach with white sands and marked off swimming areas. Need to arrive early to get a Palapa for shade. The sun is strong so use lots of reef safe suntan lotion. Chairs are available to rent.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach
reviews.text: The beach was amazing.  The best beach we have ever experienced.  The beach was located across from our hotel and the hotel would shuttle us to the entrance.  There was always lounge chairs available which were set up for us upon arrival.

reviews.title: was not impressed
reviews.text: Quiet beach with white sands and clear water, but beyond that, not amazing. Expensive to rent chairs and umbrella (which are really necessary for a full day trip). No bathrooms to be found, at least where we were. Very few nearby restaurants, etc. We like Palm Beach better even though it was more crowded.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: First time in a Aruba as a solo traveler. Eagle beach was my first stop really beautiful beach. Came every day to get a good spot under the umbrella trees. Recommend coming early to get you a spot under the Parasols  that are posted through out the beach

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Water is clear with amazing temperature! I enjoyed it very much. It is across the street from my hotel. It feels so peaceful In the early morning. The sunset is so beautiful. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: My Favorite Beach
reviews.text: What an amazing spot! You can rent the cabanas, chairs…it’s less touristy than palm and eagle with all the beauty. It was my favorite area. I loved Passions on the Beach for breakfast.

reviews.title: Voted best beach in the Carribean for a reason
reviews.text: Blue waters, white sand, seemingly endless stretch of beach - it gets pretty crowded over the weekends and during major holidays. Still worth going - try and watch the sunsets here - they are memorable!

reviews.title: Large uncrowded beach.
reviews.text: Spent an afternoon under a palapa. $20 per chair. Bring your own if you have them available from your hotel. Gorgeous Beach and water.

reviews.title: Incredible beach
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful and pristine beaches I have ever been to. Amazing sunsets. Breathtaking!!

reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text: Mmmmm not what I was expecting   The water was nice but it was super busy with equipment rental and we weren’t quite sure how to go about renting neach chairs and stuff.  I don’t know just an ok experience

reviews.title: Relax and enjoy the beach
reviews.text: The sand is very soft and white. The area is very relaxing and quiet. If you’re looking for more action and activities you should go to palm Beach which is not far

reviews.title: Eagle beach
reviews.text: Amazing white sand beach with warm crystal clear Caribbean blue water!   If there is a negative, it is windy at the beach.  Not enough wind to ruin your time

reviews.title: One happy Tourist on one happy island
reviews.text: This was our 3rd time to Aruba and it was a cruise stop. We remembered how amazing Eagle beach was the first time and figured we should spend most of our day there. It cost us $5 each to get on a bus that dropped us off there. We found a place that rented beach umbrellas, lounge chairs plus included water each. There was also an option to order food from the restaurant. The beaches here are some of the best in the world. I can see why the call it one happy island. I think it would be hard to be sad with these turquoise water and white sand beaches. The water was perfect!There wasn't too many people which was nice. but it does help that the beach goes on for miles.

reviews.title: Most beautiful beach in the world
reviews.text: Don’t forget to bring sun protection. It will be windy but that enhances the danger for sunburn. This is one of the best beaches in the world and it doesn’t disappoint. Water is beautiful. You want to be early if you want a lounge from the hotel.

reviews.title: 1000 shades of blue
reviews.text: The 1000 shades of blue.The colour of the water in Aruba is something really magical. We been in different islands of the Caribbean but Aruba has the best waters ever so far. The only similar one should be Anguilla. This beach is really for everyone, with plenty of space. there are chances to rent the sunbeds or bring the own one. the only negative things is the wind, sometimes can get really windy but the island has more other  beaches with no wind at all.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Eagle Beach in Aruba was awesome. The beach is beautiful. I recommend visiting this beach MORE THAN once. The water was clear and the beach area was not crowded at all.

reviews.title: #3 in the world for a reason!
reviews.text: White sand, picturesque views! Pure paradise! One happy island and there’s a reason why. The beaches, the sand, the people.

reviews.title: A piece of paradise
reviews.text: So looking forward to visiting this place and it didn’t disappoint!  Soft white cleans sands with crystal clear calm waters. Down side was a very expensive trip  example paying s50 for 2 su loungers and parasol, would 100% recommend this beautiful piece of paradise

reviews.title: It was great
reviews.text: Best beach! Crystal clear water, clean white sand. We had very peaceful relaxing time there and highly appreciate how clean is it.

reviews.title: Great beach day from cruise
reviews.text: Loved this beautiful beach!  Aruba was a stop on a cruise for us. Instead of booking an expensive shore excursion we took a public bus (clean, free wifi and just $5 round trip!) to Eagle Beach. The water was gorgeous and we throughly enjoyed a wonderful beach day. Can’t wait to go back!

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Clean beach. Water was refreshing. The security guy Ervin was great and made sure we were taking care of. The women who collect the money for the chairs were not as pleasant or communicative. It took us a very long time to get our change back

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach is extensive with clean white sand. The water is transparent and lovely. There aren’t a lot op restaurants to eat during lunch on a Sunday since they close Sundays.

reviews.title: Aruba the island with beautiful beaches.
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is a beautiful sandy beach. Beautiful contrast of the white sand and the blue sea water.The beauty of Aruba is that the government has decided by law that all beaches belong to the people. Everyone is allowed on every beach, even the beaches at the most expensive Hotels.

reviews.title: Beautiful but expensive
reviews.text: Amazing beach, white sand and clear blue water, what the Caribbean is famous for. We arrived off the cruise ship and local prices on loungers and umbrellas suddenly shot up, expect to pay up to $50 for a couple, unless you are happy to lie down under a tree. Also, no snorkelling on this beach. A bottle of beer $9 in a beach bar, wifi is available.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach just OK
reviews.text: First trip to Aruba.  Everything here is wonderful but we don’t see the hype about Eagle Beach.  Two different days with both morning and afternoon trips. Both times the water was murky (couldn’t see our feet in 2 foot of water) and the sand is just ok.  Water was kind of chilly as well.  Just not what we were expecting at all.  Honestly, the beach in Destin Florida blows Eagle Beach away in our opinion.

reviews.title: Aruba Eagle Beach chairs ???
reviews.text: On a Cruise day visit to Aruba, me and my wife choose to visit the Eagle beach. The beach is fantastic. The negative side of the visit was the hiring of 2 beach chairs with an umbrella. They charged us $ 50.00On Curaçao, the next visit, 2 chairs were $ 10.00. Other islands we have visited, none were near the price we paid on Aruba.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach!  Get there by  10 for an umbrella and chairs. The tiki huts are reserved for the timeshares across the street.

reviews.title: Nice!
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Big! Right in the heart of hotel row. Cabanas available to rent. Small walk-up grill to eat/get drinks at. Consistently busy: Some cigarette butts & beer caps in the sand. Great water, clear & good waves to play in.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with crystal clear water of many different colors, with a sugar-white sand beach.  The beach is a little steep in the tide area, making it tough for walking, but it is quite wide above the tide / wave zone.  Very few (if any) seaweed.  The north end of the beach had a bit of a sewage smell on the day we visited, but we are told that is not normal.

reviews.title: Beach House Paradise
reviews.text: Stayed at the Beach House Aruba.  Very quiet apartments away from the High Rise area.  We have stayed at the Beach House our last 10 visits to Aruba.

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: Natural beauty of the beach, the unbelievable aqua colors of the water and the welcoming nature of the people in Aruba. We stayed at the Costa Linda resort. It was exceptionally clean, well maintained and very friendly. We had a great massage while we were there as well. Would highly recommend a vacation in Aruba!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with soft white sand
reviews.text: Visited Aruba on a cruise ship, so caught a taxi to Eagle Beach (USD15 each way). Absolutely beautiful with soft white sand.

reviews.title: It’s a very nice beach to visit!
reviews.text: We visited Eagle beach back in December and it was fantastic! Aruba in a nutshell is a friendly place to visit. You can choose to stay at a hotel or off site. The people are very helpful if you go about and tour the island. Many other sites to see here also.

reviews.title: Great Trip
reviews.text: The weather is amazing all the time.   The breeze while on the beach or at the pool is nice.  The UTV excursion was great!

reviews.title: Top #2 Beach in the world
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Rated #2 top beach in the world. Lots of restaurants and bars near and at the beach.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach - Best on the island!
reviews.text: Great beach, always clean and friendly environment.  Hotels and resorts close to Eagle Beach is a must whenever we visit Aruba.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach is one of the best beaches in the world!
reviews.text: The beach is always clean and sea weed free.  The Tiki's are are owned by the government, however, you need to get there EARLY by 06:30am to get one.  The hotels (if you are staying at one) will give you a chaise or chair but be sue to bring your towel so you can be identified.  You can rent chaise lounges from "Julio Watersports" if you are not staying at Eagle Aruba or LaCabanna.  The drinks are reasonable during happy hour and staff will come around to get food orders if interested.  As always Tips are appreciated by the service staffs and I've been coming here for over 20 years and always had great experiences.  FYI...don't leave your Tiki unattended for too long as the security staff will remove your belongings!   ENJOY!

reviews.title: Peaceful and beautiful
reviews.text: We took a local bus to eagle beach, walked the “boardwalk”, got some chairs and had some drinks. Wonderful, beautiful beach, friendly and helpful people all around. . Hopped the bus back to Oranjestad and got back on our cruise ship. Great day.

reviews.title: Great Beach Day
reviews.text: Great beach to visit as a stop on a cruise. The water was calm closer to the shore but a little rougher (not much)  as you went out. Beautiful. If you are looking for the famous trees, when you are facing the water, they will be to the right - a bit of a walk - all the way around the crescent beach. You can rent chairs if you get there in time. I didn’t see many shady characters hanging around, but make sure you attach your backpack to the chair.If you set up camp on the right side of the concrete pillar, just know that watercraft come onshore around there. Renting a cab was an easy process. The drive was simple and didn’t take long.

reviews.title: Wonderful beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at a condominium complex within walking distance to Eagle beach and enjoyed the white sand, sea grape shade trees, & clear water.  There was always a strong breeze so expect a little blowing sand, but that didn’t detract at all from our enjoyment.

reviews.title: Superb beach, pristine water, surf can be treacherous at times
reviews.text: Shore breakers are prevalent at this beach so be careful. Witnessed many accidents. Overall the beach is beautiful, clean and pristine. Bathrooms and snack stand right at the beach as well as beach chairs and umbrellas, which go fast if you are not there early. Easy $15 cab fare one way from the port to the beach. Highly recommend experiencing this beach, very walkable beach, one could walk to Palm Beach down the way

reviews.title: Peaceful
reviews.text: Beautiful , wide white sand beach, gentle warm crystal water, lots of action available for fun seekers, but also great for serenity

reviews.title: Postcard Perfect Beach
reviews.text: We walked from the cruise port to the Arubus station and took the public bus to the Amsterdam Manor stop at Eagle Beach. The cost is $5 per person return if you purchase a card at the terminal kiosk. We arrived late and all the rental loungers were taken. Most of the loungers are owned by the resorts and only available to their guests. We found a shady spot under a palapas and parked for the day. The palapas are not owned by the resorts and anyone can sit under them. We had a delicious lunch from Passions on the Beach. It was a very simple bus journey back to the town center. I would recommend this beach highly but would certainly get there much earlier next time.

reviews.title: Eagle beach Aruba
reviews.text: Eagle beach has by far the clearest water to swim in. The beach was clean of seaweed.The beach consists of white fine sand. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.title: Clear blue water but full of big scary sharks
reviews.text: Clear blue water but full of big scary sharksI know they have a home in the sea but really scary when they brush past you, especially before lunch when you haven't had a cue drinks to calm the nerves

reviews.title: Amazingly blue water and white beach!
reviews.text: Eagle beach was beautiful the sand was white and the ocean was very blue colour. There was very little rocks in the sand it was mostly white sand.

reviews.title: Wow - what a beach
reviews.text: Eagle beach really is spectacular.  In relation to it's main competitor (Palm Beach), eagle beach seems to have more beach distance from the hotels to the water than Palm beach, Eagle's sand is softer than Palm, but there are some decent size waves that crash the beach making the first 20 feet of Eagle's water cloudier than Palm.

reviews.title: Gorgeous
reviews.text: I absolutely love this beach. I do think it’s very crowded when you’re around the resorts but if you walk a little bit further down where the construction is, it’s quiet. I assume that they’re building another resort, so in a few years, this beach will be packed. I hate how the resorts take all the space in the The beach and don’t leave any room for anyone else to just sit there quietly . Enjoy it while it lasts.

reviews.title: Best time ever
reviews.text: This beach is full of fun and great people. So, much to do here at this beach. But if you want to go to the beach and not be crowed down the beach toward uptown very nice peaceful spot.

reviews.title: Busy beach but beautiful ocean
reviews.text: Beautiful water beautiful white sand But it’s packed of people So if looking for a quite beach this is not for you

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Very long sandy beach near hotels and has snack shop.  We stopped here on a tour from a cruise ship but the wind was blowing very hard and we felt we were getting sand blasted so we spent our time up in the shelter of the snack shop.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean beach
reviews.text: My friends and I came to this beach every single day. It’s beautiful and plenty of places to sit in the shade if needed.

reviews.title: Favorite Beach on Aruba
reviews.text: Previous visit was a pre-COVID cruise. Found it right where I left it.  $5US per person cab ride each way from cruise pier. Chairs and umbrellas available. Restaurant and restrooms available One of my two favorite beaches in the caribbean.

reviews.title: Well Deserved Beach
reviews.text: This was a clean beach with soft, white sand and appears to be very popular with locals and tourists alike. When we went, it was Valentines Day evening and beach was essentially ours. There are no hotels on the beach. Highly recommend if possible.

reviews.title: Favorite Beach!
reviews.text: This is a great beach!  Of course, it's super long and spread out over many miles, which may be why it seems so uncrowded. This beach is much calmer than Palm Beach. It's  not always close to bathroom facilities or restaurants, though there are probably spots that are closer to these amenities, especially near the hotels/ condos. It has a nice sandy bottom and seems like a good place for families and kids.

reviews.title: Best beach in Aruba
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. South side has more open space but therefore stronger winds that can blow sand at you. North side is more crowded but you can get a lounger, just pay the guy a few bucks. Water is nice and kelp-free for most of he way.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean beach!
reviews.text: Eagle Beach is clean and the water is incredible! We stay at La Cabana so the walk is short but if we stayed anywhere else we would definitely go out of our way to spend the day here!

reviews.title: Great beach for relaxing and swimming.
reviews.text: No high-pressure or annoying vendors selling wares. Plenty of rentals, tour, eateries, resorts, and bars available. Safe place for families.

reviews.title: Eagle beach FTW!
reviews.text: At first we weren't sure what to pick - Eagle or Palm beach. After reading about both beaches, we booked an accommodation near Eagle beach and it was THE best decision ever!Lots of sand, space, open areas and beautiful clear blue water. It still had palapas and caffees etc, but it wasn't crowded. Later when we visited Palm Beach we were shocked at the difference - at Palm beach people where all crowded together, so much noise, the sand strip was quite narrow, everyone was swimming side by side because there were many jet ski areas and pier restaurants taking up the swimming space etc.TLDR:Eagle beach -  if you prefer vibing on your own and personal space, clear waters, lots of sand.Palm beach - if you don't mind people, a busy beach and want lots of different options for water activities/places to eat and drink.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: In my opinion, it is the best beach on the island. Quiet area without a lot of wild parties. Beautiful sand and surf.

reviews.title: Delightful beach
reviews.text: This is a long beach with great fine sand and clear water. It is easily reached by taxi from Oranjestad for $15 each way. We arrived about midday and all the loungers and beach umbrellas were taken but there is plenty of shade to be found under the trees backing the beach. It is not heavily commercialised with only the one bar at our end and a limited selection of water sports. However this is much nicer than Palm Beach which is backed by high rise hotels.

reviews.title: BEST BEACH ON ARUBA
reviews.text: Best beach on Aruba! Not crowded, white sand and water color to die for. Went to most of them and this one wins.

reviews.title: Worth a visit
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, crowded though. Hard to find a palapa. Expensive to rent an umbrella and beach chairs.

reviews.title: Amazing beach and water
reviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beach we have ever been to. Clear turquoise waters and white sands. The beach is wide and long and the water calm.Came here on a cruise and loved it. Easy to get to from the cruise port for $5/ person.There are bars and restaurants along the beach and even with 2 ships in town it didn't feel overly crowded.

reviews.title: Ricardos a gem of a find restaurant
reviews.text: ricardos is a small restaurant located on Eagle Beach right on the sand. All the food is prepped to order the staff fantastic the food outstanding and the price is moderate, my wife and I enjoy having dinner in the evening and watching the sun sink into the ocean. And in the mornings we enjoy having breakfast. Watching the sunrise the restaurant is small, but very romantic.

reviews.title: White Sands
reviews.text: White sands, clean, clear, calm water. Constant temps and light breeze. Lots of activities and lots of people. Never had trouble finding a spot thought.

reviews.title: It is Just Simply Perfect
reviews.text: We have stayed in Aruba a few times as both a couple and with family, at both Palm Beach and Eagle Beach.  The beaches here are impeccable.  The sand is white, powdery, soft, and exceptionally clean.  The water is crystal clear, and you can see your feet even when you are waist-deep (or deeper) as if you are looking through a pane of glass.  The weather is absolutely perfect, never varying by more than a few degrees.  Rain is minimal to non-existent.  This beach, along with the island in general, is an enduring exercise in vacation perfection, obviously thanks in large part to the island’s government and oversight.  My wife and I often don't like to vacation in the same place more than once, but rest assured we will continue to revisit this place.

reviews.title: More laid back beach
reviews.text: This beach has more of a local island vibe IMO.  The hotels are across the street and the beach has many access points.  It felt more like just a beach than the others that have the big hotels and high rise buildings right on them.

reviews.title: Beautiful and Refreshing
reviews.text: White soft sand and blue-green water as far as one can see. Many options to purchase chairs and umbrellas as well as food and drink. Service was friendly. Even though there were a lot of beach goers, we had sufficient space. It was a lovely day!

reviews.title: White Sand & Blue Sea - perfect
reviews.text: Fabulous white sand beach, clear waters.  Plenty of sunbeds & umbrellas for hire.  Not many beach bars so be sure to pitch up near one if you want drinks & food.  More expensive than some of the other islands but a fun day out.

reviews.title: Breathtaking!
reviews.text: The color of the water is exactly like it is in these photos...simply breathtaking! I can see why it is rated as one of the top beaches in the world. Def. more calm and relaxing compared to palm beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I wish there had been more seating late in the day. We went late with a cruise tour and there were no chairs or umbrellas left.

reviews.title: Great way to spend the day!!
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach. Great for walking. Public and resort usage. Palapa’s available on a first come first served basis. Lounge chairs available to rent or bring your own. Facilities on site. Water sport’s available for purchase. Beverages available for purchase. About a 4 km walk from the cruise port. Public transportation also available. Sunscreen is a must!!!

reviews.title: Great beach area with Lots of bars, shops and good food nearby
reviews.text: Great beautiful Beach, lots of bars and cafes, plenty to do. Big hotel chains, high rise  in Eagle Beach area, but still Classy

reviews.title: Gentle waves and clear waters
reviews.text: I visited Eagle Beach while taking a bus around the island with De Palm Tours, and everyone in my family loved it! As a Floridian, I've visited several beaches, but Eagle Beach is one of my favorites:)

reviews.title: Heaven!
reviews.text: I so enjoyed the beautiful white sand beach.  You have to go early to stake out your spot, but the security for each resort is very friendly and accommodating.  You can leave your stuff without worry for up to 1 1/2 hours.  Then security will remove it to a secure location.  The water was so refreshing to the body.  A bit cool on first dip, but once you're wet, it is amazing.

reviews.title: Crystal Clear Waters & Soft White Sand
reviews.text: Beautiful crystal blue waters, soft white sand, wide beach so there’s plenty of room to spread out. Certain spots along the beach had strong waves so watch where you decide to put your chairs and swim.

reviews.title: So Beautiful!
reviews.text: We loved Eagle beach! It was very clean, absolutely no seaweed. No rocks on the sand which was great because we noticed a lot of beaches in Aruba had rocks in the sand and water. Very relaxing and not as crowded as other ones we went to. The sunset on this beach was one of my favorites I seen in the Caribbean!

reviews.title: Family Beach
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach and much quieter than Palm Beach. It's the best beach for families with small children. There are playgrounds, snack bars, chairs and umbrellas to rent. Its less populated so there is room to spread out. This is also the beach where you'll find the Fototi tree that is popular in many Aruba vacation pics.

reviews.title: Eagle beach beautiful but rough
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but a bit rough and getting crowded but not as crowded as palm beach. Not a great beach for young children. Sometimes hard to get palapas.

reviews.title: Ocean waters
reviews.text: Eagle beach is one of the best! so warm and clean. Lots of friendly people and many water spots to do.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We stayed at ABC and absolutely loved this little section of the beach. Soft sand, clear waters, litter free 🌊🏖️

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We walked along Eagle Beach several mornings during our stay. I can’t say what it’s like later in the day, but around 7-8 in the morning it’s very peaceful.

reviews.title: It has captured us.
reviews.text: My wife and I have fell in love with Aruba. This beach is one reason why. The pristine sand, the moderate temperatures all play a part in why we vacation here at least once a year.

reviews.title: Truly one beautiful beach
reviews.text: The only downside was crazy jetskiers, but this is a really clean and beautiful beach.   The sunsets from this beach or spectacular.

reviews.title: Nice reprieve from the hotel crowds!
reviews.text: We wanted to escape the crowds at the high rises on Palm Beach, so we took a quick drive down to Eagle Beach arriving around 10:30 AM.  There were very few people there, and we had our choice of chairs and umbrellas which we rented for $40 (for 2) for the day.  A little pricey, but worth it if you don’t have your own gear.  As the beach filled up, we had people on either side of us but everyone was quiet and pleasant.  The sand and the water are remarkable.  Very calm, absolutely beautiful.  I don’t know that I would rank it #9 in the world, but it certainly was nice.  One note . . . The chair guy told us that it gets very crowded when cruise ships are in port.  There was only 1 today, so not bad.

reviews.title: Beautiful water
reviews.text: Beautiful water. We went to this beach as an excursion from the cruise we were on. We were told that this was a beautiful beach with all sorts of amenities. What a joke. We paid $19.99 per person with the cruise excision on our cruise. Then when we get to Eagle Beach we have to pay $10 per person to get a sun damage lounger to sit on. We were told that none of the umbrellas worked, so we would have to find shade to protect ourselves from the sun. We asked were the restrooms were and the guy told us that we could use the restroom at the hotel across the street. We went to the hotel across the street to get food from the restaurant and were told that the hotel was only available to customers staying at the hotel. The lady told us to go to the food truck. You could actually smell the grease in the food. We went to the bar to use the restroom and we were told that it cost $1.00.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Eagle Beach appears much quieter than other beaches we saw. It couldn't be more gorgeous. We were at Manchebo and while it was a bit of walk to the water from their lovely palapas, it was worth every stride.

reviews.title: Beautiful waters
reviews.text: We were lucky enough to have Eagle Beach as our main beach with our resort- La Cabana! Recommend staying at a Resort that gives you access to this incredible beach!!

reviews.title: Beach trip
reviews.text: October 4, 2022- Visited this beach on one of our cruise ports. Took the arubus for $2.50 US pp each way. Paid for a day pass to Paradise Beach Villas, across the street, which allowed us to use pool and bathroom access. A beautiful beach. Water so clean and clear

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: This is a nice stretch of beach to lay out an catch some sunshine or float around in the beautiful blue water.  We enjoyed a nice lunch at one of the bar/restaurants on the beach.

reviews.title: Relaxing
reviews.text: Eagle beach was the best beach for relaxing. Super soft sand and the water temperature was perfect. Plenty of shade offered under the cabana’s

reviews.title: Beautiful eagle beach
reviews.text: Clean. Water is amazing. So e seaweed but I think that was due to hurricanes being in the Caribbean. There is a slight incline so those with mobility issues should be aware.  Not a shell beach. Water sports kept well away from swimming.

reviews.title: Soft white sand
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful, with soft white sand. Please know that the palm straw palapas are free so don’t let locals try and charge you!

reviews.title: Favorite Beach
reviews.text: My husband and I went to Eagle Beach everyday during our honeymoon vacation!! Absolutely love this beach!!!

reviews.title: great for cruisers
reviews.text: We took the bus to Eagle Beach getting off at Amsterdam Manor. There was a huge downpour so we waited until it cleared. Some people vacated chairs so we were able to sit down under a Palapa. We didn't realize we were on AM chairs although you can go next door and rent some. I happened to have an orange watch which matched their wristbands so we weren't bothered. The water was lovely and the sand soft. Made for a great beach day off the ship. We took the bus back to the pier.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beaches I have ever been on.  From the white powdery sand to the crystal-clear water, you cannot go wrong here.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful, with soft white sand, however it gets crowded in certain areas when the cruises dock. Please know that the palm straw palapas are free so don’t let locals try and charge you!

reviews.title: Amazing Eagle Beach
reviews.text: Eagle Beach has the most amazing turquoise blue waters and white soft sand!  The beaches go on and on forever.  And better yet no seaweed!!  Like many other places in the Caribbean are infortunately experiencing.  Big open beach with lots of space and very minimal crowds.  Beautiful sunsets as it faces directly west. One of the best beaches I've ever seen.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL
reviews.text: the most beautiful beach I've seen.  I've sailed the carribeans a lot but Aruba is by far my most favorite

reviews.title: Excellent beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach. No seaweed or pebbles to worry about when getting in.  Buses available in front of the beach. Short walk to Super Foods grocery store. It has a hot food section and seating so you can grab a cheap lunch. Alternatively, many good beachfront restaurants. Don’t like the way they lock up the lounge chairs. Sometimes it takes a while to get the attendant to unlock it for you. Water always warm.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach with lovely cabanas.  Right across the street from La Cabana where we stayed.  Chairs also available.

reviews.title: Easy access by bus
reviews.text: The local bus goes there and it cost $2.60 U.S. per person per trip. it a nice beach you can bring your beach chair and sit under the palm tree. Need a romantic dinner  while watching the sunset there a restaurant on the beach that have nightly dinner. However, you need to make a reservation. You can also bring out the inner child in you by swinging on the swing on the beach or take part in one of the water sport offer by the locals.

reviews.title: Go see for yourself
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach I really enjoyed the relaxation the service the blue calming waters and the nightly sunsets which is very different. More space you’re not overwhelmed or crowded. It’s perfect

reviews.title: picture perfect
reviews.text: This beach lives up to its reviews, we spent everyday of our. 7 day vacation on the beach. The breeze is amazing the water is crystal clear and have you camera ready for the sunsets

reviews.title: great beach & plenty of it
reviews.text: Make sure and get there early if you want to be shaded under one of the few Palapas. But don't worry if you get there later because there is plenty of trees to get shaded under.Water is perfect for swimming and or just cooling off in.

reviews.title: Picture perfect beach.
reviews.text: What can you say about the white sands, crystal clear turquoise water with a rum punch in your hand watching the sun set right in front of you? Heaven on Earth.
