Will  be visiting again next year.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: This was off our hotel and it was amazing. Very clean and easily walkable. Accessible through several hotels.

reviews.title: Beautiful !!
reviews.text: This beach is amazing !! Very relaxing !! I also did the jet ski's which was fun. There are bars and food places right on the beach and places that rent chairs and umbrellas

reviews.title: Big beach
reviews.text: Great big beach.  Not crowded at all. Fantastic water as it was everywhere in Aruba.  Less vendors here compared to many other beaches.  Good for long walks or just hanging out.  Several resorts/condo litter this beach and have their own personal seating areas.

reviews.title: Amazing Beach But...
reviews.text: I am going to be the nay-sayer here with some caveats. I recently went to Aruba for the first time in October 2019, and the trip was amazing. I relied heavily on Trip Advisor and other sources to plan my trip. I had seen so many great reviews of Eagle Beach, and even reports that it's in the top 5 beaches in the world. I was very excited to try it out. I want to be clear that it is truly a beautiful beach, and there's nothing particularly wrong with it. In fact, all of the reviews that tout it as amazing are accurate, but, if I had it to do over again, I would have spent 100% of my beach time on Baby Beach. I went there later in my trip, and I found it to be far superior to Eagle Beach. The water is even calmer and you can wade out SUPER far because it's so shallow. The sand was even nicer, and it was less crowded since it's about 30 minutes away from the hotel high rise area. Plus, the cabanas, umbrellas and chairs were a little bit cheaper. There was a guy who came up to us and offered cabanas and chairs, and proceeded to bring us drinks and food all day delivered right to our cabanas. We paid $60 for a cabana which comes with two nice lounge chairs. So $30 per person for all day. Just don't forget to tip the guys for their service. The one downer is that there aren't a lot of food and drink options like there are on Eagle Beach. In fact, there is just one option: Big Mama's Grill. But the food and drinks are good, so it's not the end of the world, and like I said, if you get a cabana and chairs, the same guys that rent those work for Big Mama's so you can order from them and have anything you want delivered to you. Also, I should mention the bathroom situation at Baby Beach. You have to pay to use the bathroom unless you are a customer at Big Mama's since the bathroom is owned by the restaurant. There is a woman who sits in the bathroom and takes either money or bathroom tokens from paying customers.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach is Fantastic!
reviews.text: Great beach. Less commercial than Palm beach. Although there is development in process there's no big hotels yet. White sand, gentle entry to the sea. Beach chair and umbrella was a little high for us so we spread our beach cover on the soft sand, spent most of our time in the water, and stayed for a few hours. Sunscreen is a necessity. If you walk the beach to the point you might see some turtles at the right time of year.We took a taxi but the bus from Oranjestad is still cheap ($5 round trip).

reviews.title: Pristine White Sand
reviews.text: Incredible,  Beautiful soft white sand beach, with the right amount and size waves that enhance the warm clean clear tropical ocean experance.

reviews.title: Eagle Beach is Simply Beautiful!
reviews.text: This is our second visit to Aruba and Eagle Beach is our favorite spot! Beautiful sand, fantastic waves, gorgeous sunsets! Eagle Beach has it all! The security is top notch...we always felt safe and welcome! Definitely a 5 Star beach!

reviews.title: Great beach nice surf hot sun!
reviews.text: A Must go beach, very different from the east coast beaches. Sand is very soft, waves gentle. Sun is hot, be sure to bring a sunscreen or pay the price later...

reviews.title: Beautiful and Spacious Beach
reviews.text: We drove our rental car to this beach and parked in free parking right next to the beach.  Since it was already early afternoon we only paid $10 for a palapa and 2 beach chairs.  The beach is spacious which means less people around you.  The water is beautiful and calm.  Definitely the preferred beach if you want to avoid the more crowded but equally beautiful Palm Beach.

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text: I presented my wife with new wedding rings to mark our 25th anniversary.l asked her to spend another 25 with me at sunset on Eagle beach. It was beautiful. Oh yeah she said yes!

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: After cruising over a dozen times, we found the most beautiful beach. Not over crowed, white sand almost like baby powder!

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach anywhere!
reviews.text: The beach is pristine with soft white sand that’s pretty to look at and easy to navigate for walkers and swimmers alike. The water is warm and crystal clear. It’s hard to imagine how a beach could be more beautiful.

reviews.title: Absolutely Beautiful!!
reviews.text: Softest Sands, no vendors, very relaxing area away from Palm Beach craziness.  No beach shacks at South end, still unspoiled.

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: We walked over a mile from Divi hoping for good snorkeling. Seems the better place was further north. This was ok fpr spme fish viewing.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Very nice pretty place to relaxed and enjoy your self with a lot of activities for kids and adults great

reviews.title: Go!!!
reviews.text: ALL the beaches in Aruba are public and beautiful! I could (and have) walked for miles. What distinguishes the beaches in my option are what has sunk relatively close to the beach, and how many resorts are within vicinity.

reviews.title: Beach for a cruise
reviews.text: Very pretty wide beach. Not overly crowded, but there are a lot of people there. About 15 minutes and a $15 cab ride from cruise port. Chairs $10, toilet $1

reviews.title: Nicest beach in Aruba
reviews.text: Truly a treasure, if you visit this island you must walk this beach at least once! Very long, very wide, the sand is soft and clean. A great place to walk anytime in either direction. Nice spot for sunsets. Fewer people to be found here, plenty of places to park nearby and much less commercialism versus Palm. Pack a cooler, bring your beach chairs and lotion and have a great day on Eagle.

reviews.title: Absolutely the best
reviews.text: We stayed nearby.  All of the beaches we visited were great, but Eagle Beach was the best by far.  The sand is super soft and not hot at all.  There were a few people around, but there is plenty of space to spread out.  The water is crystal clear and it is gently sloped out with few waves.  If you’re looking to windsurf, this isn’t for you.  If you want to relax and float, Eagle Beach is it.

reviews.title: Best beach in the world
reviews.text: Eagle beach is just fantastic.  Nothing compares with the white  powder sand that stretches over 150 feet from our resort cabana to the water.  We travel a lot and this is by far the best beach anywhere.

reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text: From the cruise terminal, we went across the street to the Arubus terminal, bought a day pass($10) and hopped the bus to Eagle Beach, the bus driver told us he would drop us at the best spot on the beach(it's very large) and boy did he! the beach was phenomenal! Beautiful water, great sand, not too hot(we were there from 4-6pm) and not crowded. My kids(4 & 6) loved playing in the sand and snorkeling in the shallow waters, there were tons of tiny schooling fish to watch. Everyone we had talked to on the island said that Eagle Beach was one of the best, they weren't kidding. None of us wanted to leave, and we are already discussing going back to stay for a week!

reviews.title: Beautiful blue water
reviews.text: The sand was white and the water was so clear you could see thee bottom. It was not a lot of people on the beach.

reviews.title: Excellent quiet beach
reviews.text: A stretch of beach away from the tourists and the big hotels and almost empty. Plenty of parking space. Beach chairs for rent. Section along the beach only for bathers. There are a few jet-ski rentals along the beach. We had our beach-chairs, plenty of water and sandwiches with us. The beach is safe from pickpocketing this usually happens on the crowded beaches in front of the hotels, and there is always someone who can keep an eye on your goodies. There are various bus stops along the beach but the service can’t be trusted.

reviews.title: Best beach ever
reviews.text: Water crystal clear, warm like bath water and absolutely no waves, absolutely perfect beach in every single way!

reviews.title: Vacation!!!!!!!!!!  Oh yeah!
reviews.text: Very clean beach!  Clean white sand with hardly any shells, stones, and other debris. Clear warm water. Beautiful. Less populated than other beaches near resorts and hotels.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful colors in the water, gorgeous white sand beach. Loved every minute of it. This is the less busy section of the beach but there are still some watersports nearby.

reviews.title: espectacular beach!!!
reviews.text: Amazing beach! calm warm waters, clean beach, confortable beach chairs, it is ranked one of the top ten beaches in the world for a reason.!

reviews.title: Spectacular beach!!!
reviews.text: I am a beach lover and this one is extremely beautiful and very kid-friendly... there are some areas that are very populated because many of the hotels are along this beach but if you walk a little far toward the north of the island you will find a paradise... If you are like the one that likes water sport so stay in the hotel area.  Just be very aware any sport or water entertainment there is expensive... like 10 or 15 minutes in some kind of boat .. can be like 20$... but this is the bussines in the area. Also be aware you need to pay for the chairs ... the only thing you can take and no pay are the huts... those are free.. just go early... the beach is also easy reach by public transpostation..

reviews.title: Excellent Beach
reviews.text: This beach is everything it’s said to be. Absolutely beautiful, stunning, picture perfect. The swimming is great and the tiki huts are first come first served.

reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text: Very few beaches compare to Eagle Beach.  Soft, white sand lead into perfectly calm blue water.  There are plenty of good hotels and rentals and there is always a spot to lay out along this stretch of beach.  We stayed at the Divi less than a mile down the beach, which has a nice beach, but the main Eagle Beach area is much nicer and worth the walk.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: We stayed at the LaCabana on Eagle Beach. Beautiful views and miles of beach that you can walk. The water is so clear!

reviews.title: One of the best beaches
reviews.text: This is one of the best beaches i have ever been to clear blue water, white sand, fofoti tree, and i felt very safe

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful, amazing, super clean and white sand. I highly recommend it. It's a must go. I will definitely visit this beach again.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach.
reviews.text: Beautiful long white sand beach. Sea water is blue and very warm. Just an amazing beach to spend the day relaxing and soaking in the beauty.

reviews.title: Absolutely awesome
reviews.text: When my wife and I are in a rouble we stay at the Devi village and Eagle beach is our go to we love it there

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: A day at the beach is always a pleasure but most of all if it is a beach in aruba, pure clean water and amazing white sand.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful. I had a lovely time. The water felt like pool water. I cannot wait to go back and visit this beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: We was staying in Oranjestad so wanted to spend the day at eagle beach. It’s absolutely beautiful, the sand the clear water was amazing. We walked all the way along and back. We paid for sun loungers with a umbrella which cost 15 dollars each which I thought was quite expensive. Had a couple of drinks in passions and my husband popped down the road to the super market to have some food and drinks on the beach. Was a lovely but expensive trip.

reviews.title: Aruba Beaches
reviews.text: Eagle Beach in September is a great place to be if you don't like  crowds. The attendants were right there if you desired a chair or lounger.  You could keep your spot all day be leaving you possessions behind.

reviews.title: Passions on the Beach
reviews.text: Went to Passions last Friday at 6.00pm. It is a restaurant on the beach where you eat your meal at a table set on the sand on Eagle Beach. We ate and watched the sun set over the sea which was beautiful. The area is lit by flame torch lights and lights around the surrounding trees. There was a saxophonist playing soft music in the background. The food was good and it was an unforgettable experience. Would recommend a visit
